model_requirements.description: A Property & Casualty insurer underwriting personal and commercial lines. Prospects submit risk information, underwriters evaluate and price it, and quotes are bound into policies that renew, endorse, cancel, and reinstate over time. Policies carry coverages with limits, deductibles, exclusions, and conditions that attach to insured risks (properties, buildings, vehicles, drivers). Premium is booked as written, earned, unearned, and return transactions with charges, taxes, fees, and producer commission. Claims record loss events, claimants, and per-coverage exposures, with reserves, payments, recoveries, and expenses tracked as financial movements. Risk is distributed through agents and brokers and ceded through reinsurance treaties and facultative agreements, with catastrophe and geography used to aggregate exposure.

domains.name: party
domains.description: SSOT for all persons and organizations the insurer interacts with: policyholders, named/additional insureds, claimants, producers, adjusters, and payees. Owns identity, demographics, KYC, and deduplication.

products.name: party
products.description: SSOT master record for every person or organization the insurer interacts with. One row per party. Owns golden-record identity, KYC status, dedup keys, and MDM flags. Tax IDs and external keys live in identifier, not here.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate key for every person or organization in the MDM party master. One row per party. Role = MASTER_PARTY primary key.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Model Laws

attributes.name: master_party_id
attributes.description: References the surviving golden-record party_id when this record has been merged into another. Null if this record is itself the golden record. Supports MDM deduplication lineage.

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the party's primary mailing/residence address (street number and name). Used for policy issuance, billing, regulatory filings, and territory rating.

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the party's primary address (suite, apartment, unit, floor). Supplementary to address_line1 for complete mailing address.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality of the party's primary address. Used in territory rating, catastrophe aggregation, and regulatory jurisdiction determination.

attributes.name: clue_report_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Comprehensive Loss Underwriting Exchange (CLUE) Report Date
attributes.description: Date the most recent CLUE loss history report was ordered for this party. Used in personal lines underwriting to assess prior claims history. Governed by FCRA.

tag_set.value: Comprehensive Loss Underwriting Exchange (CLUE) Report Date

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the party's primary address (e.g., USA, CAN). Required for international commercial lines and OFAC/sanctions screening.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the party record was first created in the MDM system. Immutable audit field. RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED per MASTER_PARTY canonical category.
attributes.references: SOX; GLBA; NAIC Market Conduct; ISO 8601

attributes.name: credit_score
attributes.description: Insurance-based credit score used in personal lines rating (HO, PAP) where state-permitted. Sourced from credit bureaus under FCRA. Range typically 150–950. Null where prohibited by state DOI.
attributes.references: FCRA; NAIC Credit Scoring Model Law; State DOI; ISO

attributes.name: credit_score_date
attributes.description: Date the insurance credit score was last obtained from the credit bureau. Used to determine score freshness and re-pull schedules per FCRA and state DOI requirements.
attributes.references: FCRA; NAIC Credit Scoring Model Law; State DOI

attributes.name: date_of_birth
attributes.description: Date of birth for a natural person. Used in age-based rating, MVR eligibility, KYC identity verification, and OFAC/sanctions screening. Null for ORGANIZATION.

attributes.name: date_of_death
attributes.description: Date of death for a natural person, populated when confirmed. Triggers policy lifecycle actions (cancellation, beneficiary notification) and stops billing. Null if living or ORGANIZATION.

attributes.name: date_of_incorporation
attributes.description: Date the organization was legally incorporated or formed. Used to calculate years_in_business and validate commercial underwriting eligibility. Null for INDIVIDUAL.
attributes.references: ACORD 126; State Secretary of State filings; NAIC

attributes.name: do_not_contact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates the party has opted out of marketing and non-essential communications. Enforced in outbound campaign and billing communication workflows per TCPA and GLBA opt-out rules.
attributes.references: TCPA; GLBA Privacy Rule; CAN-SPAM; CCPA

attributes.name: family_name
attributes.description: Surname/family name of a natural person. Null for ORGANIZATION party type. Used in KYC, CLUE, MVR, and OFAC screening.

attributes.name: fraud_indicator_flag
attributes.description: Set to True when the SIU or fraud detection system has flagged this party for suspected fraudulent activity. Triggers enhanced review on new submissions and claims.
attributes.references: NAIC Fraud Reporting; ISO ClaimSearch; Fraud Detection/SIU System

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: Golden-record display name. For individuals: concatenated given + family name. For organizations: legal entity name. Primary IDENTITY_LABEL per MDM golden record.

attributes.name: gender
attributes.description: Self-reported gender of a natural person: M=Male, F=Female, X=Non-binary/Other, U=Unknown. Used in auto rating where state-permitted. Null for ORGANIZATION.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Rating Law; State DOI regulations; ACORD 125

attributes.name: given_name
attributes.description: First/given name of a natural person. Null for ORGANIZATION party type. Used in correspondence, KYC matching, and CLUE/MVR lookups.

attributes.name: golden_record_flag
attributes.description: True if this party record is the MDM-designated master (golden) record after deduplication. False for duplicate or candidate records pending merge resolution.
attributes.references: Customer/Party MDM; NAIC Market Conduct; ISO

attributes.name: kyc_status
attributes.description: Current KYC/AML verification status of the party. VERIFIED = identity confirmed; FAILED = verification failed; REVIEW = under enhanced due diligence. Required for GLBA and BSA/AML compliance.
attributes.references: GLBA; BSA/AML; FATF; NAIC Market Conduct; OFAC

attributes.name: kyc_verified_date
attributes.description: Date on which the party's identity was most recently verified through the KYC process. Used to determine re-verification schedules and compliance audit trails.
attributes.references: GLBA; BSA/AML; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: legal_entity_name
attributes.description: Registered legal name of an organization as filed with the state or federal authority. Null for INDIVIDUAL party type. Used in commercial lines underwriting and FEIN matching.

attributes.name: marital_status
attributes.description: Marital status of a natural person used in personal lines rating (HO, PAP). Null for ORGANIZATION. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SINGLE|MARRIED|DIVORCED|WIDOWED|SEPARATED|UNKNOWN — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Model Rating Law; ACORD 125; State DOI

attributes.name: naics_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code
attributes.description: NAICS code classifying the industry of an organization party. Used in commercial lines underwriting, CGL class rating, BOP eligibility, and actuarial segmentation.
attributes.references: US Census Bureau NAICS; ISO CGL; NAIC

tag_set.value: North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code

attributes.name: ofac_match_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) Match Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the party returned a potential match on the OFAC SDN or consolidated sanctions list. True triggers manual review and blocks policy binding until cleared.
attributes.references: OFAC SDN; BSA/AML; GLBA; NAIC Market Conduct

tag_set.value: Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) Match Flag

attributes.name: ofac_screened_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) Screened Date
attributes.description: Most recent date the party was screened against the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) list. Required for regulatory compliance before policy binding.
attributes.references: OFAC SDN List; BSA/AML; GLBA; NAIC

tag_set.value: Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) Screened Date

attributes.name: organization_type
attributes.description: Legal structure of an organization party. Drives commercial lines eligibility, CGL/BOP underwriting rules, and FEIN validation. Null for INDIVIDUAL. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CORPORATION|LLC|PARTNERSHIP|SOLE_PROP|TRUST|NONPROFIT|GOVERNMENT|OTHER — promote to

attributes.name: party_status
attributes.description: Current MDM lifecycle state of the party record. ACTIVE = in use; INACTIVE = no current relationships; DECEASED = confirmed death; MERGED = superseded by survivor; SUSPENDED = under review.
attributes.references: Customer/Party MDM; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: party_type
attributes.description: Discriminator distinguishing a natural person (INDIVIDUAL) from a legal entity (ORGANIZATION). Drives which subtype attributes are populated and which KYC rules apply.
attributes.references: ACORD AL3 Party Type; NAIC Model Law

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: US ZIP or ZIP+4 postal code for the party's primary address. Used in territory rating, catastrophe zone mapping, and USPS address validation.

attributes.name: preferred_contact_method
attributes.description: Party's stated preference for receiving communications: EMAIL, PHONE, MAIL, TEXT, or PORTAL. Drives outbound communication routing in PAS and billing systems.
attributes.references: GLBA; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; ACORD

attributes.name: preferred_language
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 language code (optionally with BCP-47 region tag, e.g., en-US, es-MX) indicating the party's preferred language for documents and communications.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1; NAIC Market Conduct; State DOI language access requirements

attributes.name: primary_email
attributes.description: Primary electronic mail address for the party. Used for policy documents, billing notices, FNOL acknowledgements, and regulatory correspondence. PRIMARY_CONTACT field per MASTER_PARTY role.
attributes.references: GLBA; GDPR Article 4; CAN-SPAM Act; ACORD

attributes.name: primary_phone
attributes.description: Primary telephone number in E.164 format. Used for FNOL intake, billing collections, underwriting contact, and fraud/SIU outreach.

attributes.name: privacy_opt_out_flag
attributes.description: Indicates the party has exercised their right to opt out of information sharing with non-affiliated third parties under GLBA/CCPA. Restricts data sharing in downstream systems.
attributes.references: GLBA Privacy Rule; CCPA; GDPR Article 21

attributes.name: sic_code
attributes.description: Four-digit SIC code for an organization party. Legacy classification used alongside NAICS in commercial underwriting, ISO rating, and NAIC statutory reporting.
attributes.references: OSHA SIC; ISO Rating; NAIC Annual Statement

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record that originated this party record (e.g., PAS = Guidewire PolicyCenter, CLAIMS = ClaimCenter). Used for MDM lineage and deduplication.
attributes.references: Customer/Party MDM; Guidewire PolicyCenter; Duck Creek

attributes.name: source_system_party_code
attributes.description: The party's native identifier in the originating operational system (e.g., Guidewire contact ID, ClaimCenter party ID). Enables cross-system reconciliation and MDM matching.
attributes.references: Customer/Party MDM; Guidewire PolicyCenter; Duck Creek

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state or territory code (USPS abbreviation) for the party's primary address. Determines applicable DOI jurisdiction, rate filings, and statutory requirements.
attributes.references: USPS State Abbreviations; NAIC; State DOI

attributes.name: state_of_incorporation
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code where the organization was legally incorporated. Relevant for surplus lines eligibility, admitted vs non-admitted determination, and regulatory filings.

attributes.name: tax_id_type
attributes.description: Classifies the tax identifier held in the party identifier table: Social Security Number (SSN), Federal Employer Identification Number (FEIN), Individual Taxpayer Identification Number (ITIN), or other.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the party record in the MDM system. Used for change data capture, audit trails, and downstream incremental loads.
attributes.references: SOX; GLBA; NAIC Market Conduct; ISO 8601

attributes.name: years_in_business
attributes.description: Number of years the organization has been in continuous operation. Used in commercial lines underwriting as a risk factor for BOP, CGL, and E&O eligibility.
attributes.references: ISO Commercial Lines Rating; ACORD 126; Underwriting Workbench

products.name: role
products.description: Assigns a role to a party with effective and expiration dates. One row per party-role assignment. Roles include policyholder, named insured, additional insured, claimant, producer, adjuster, and payee. Never embeds role on the party record.

attributes.name: role_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a party role assignment. One row per party-role assignment instance.

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Reference to the claim under which this role is assigned, when the role is claim-scoped (e.g., claimant, adjuster, payee on a specific claim).

attributes.name: commission_id

attributes.name: line_of_business_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.line_of_business. Business justification: Party roles (insured, agent, claimant) operate within specific LOB contexts. Underwriting rules, commission structures, and role eligibility vary by LOB.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party (person or organization) holding this role. Links to the Party master record.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Model Laws

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the policy under which this role is assigned, when the role is policy-scoped (e.g., policyholder, named insured, additional insured).

attributes.name: acord_role_code
attributes.description: Standardized ACORD data standard role code for this party role assignment. Enables interoperability with trading partners, MGAs, and reinsurers using ACORD XML/JSON.

attributes.name: assignment_reason
attributes.description: Business reason that triggered the creation of this role assignment. Supports audit trails and lifecycle analysis across the policy and claims lifecycle. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; Guidewire PolicyCenter; Guidewire ClaimCenter

attributes.name: consent_obtained_date
attributes.description: Date on which the required consent was obtained from the party for this role. Null if consent has not yet been obtained or is not required.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this party role assignment record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trails and data lineage per SOX and NAIC requirements.

attributes.name: do_not_contact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates that this party has requested no outbound contact in this role. Enforces compliance with TCPA, CAN-SPAM, and state do-not-call regulations.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this party role assignment becomes effective. Used to reconstruct roles in force at any given date, including the loss date.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which this party role assignment expires or is terminated. Null indicates the role is open-ended and currently active.

attributes.name: fraud_score
attributes.description: Numeric fraud risk score assigned to this party in this role by the fraud detection system. Higher values indicate greater fraud risk. Range 0.00 to 100.00.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Standards; Fraud Detection/SIU System

attributes.name: guardian_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this party is acting as a legal guardian for a minor or incapacitated insured in this role. Affects claims payment authorization and policy management.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Laws; State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: interest_type_code
attributes.description: Specifies the nature of the insurable interest held by the party in this role. Relevant for property and auto lines where multiple parties have financial interests.
attributes.references: ISO Forms; ACORD 140; NAIC Model Laws

attributes.name: is_consent_required
attributes.description: Flags whether this party role requires explicit consent for data processing or communications under GLBA, GDPR, or CCPA privacy regulations.

attributes.name: is_primary_role
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the primary instance of the role type for the associated policy or claim. True for the first named insured or lead claimant.

attributes.name: kyc_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether Know Your Customer identity verification has been completed for this party in this role. Required for producers and high-value policyholders.
attributes.references: GLBA; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; FinCEN AML

attributes.name: kyc_verified_date
attributes.description: Date on which KYC verification was completed for this party role. Used for compliance audit trails and periodic re-verification scheduling.

attributes.name: language_preference
attributes.description: Preferred language for communications with this party in this role, expressed as a BCP 47 language tag (e.g., en-US, es-MX). Supports regulatory plain-language requirements.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Standards; State DOI Plain Language Requirements

attributes.name: litigation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this party role is involved in active litigation related to a claim or policy dispute. Triggers legal hold and restricts certain automated communications.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Standards; Guidewire ClaimCenter

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or remarks entered by underwriters, adjusters, or administrators regarding this specific party role assignment. Supports audit and workflow context.

attributes.name: notification_preference

attributes.references: GLBA; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: ofac_match_flag

attributes.references: OFAC SDN List; NAIC Model Laws

attributes.name: ofac_screen_date
attributes.description: Most recent date on which the OFAC screening was performed for this party in this role. Supports periodic re-screening compliance requirements.
attributes.references: OFAC SDN List; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: ofac_screened

attributes.name: power_of_attorney_flag
