attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code associated with this contact point. Used for international dialing prefix resolution and regulatory jurisdiction mapping.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this contact point record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, GLBA data retention, and MDM lineage requirements.

attributes.name: do_not_contact_flag
attributes.description: Hard suppression flag indicating the party must not be contacted via this channel regardless of opt-in status. Overrides all outbound communication triggers.
attributes.references: GLBA; TCPA; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: do_not_contact_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why the do_not_contact_flag is set. Supports legal hold, regulatory order, and SIU fraud investigation suppression scenarios.
attributes.references: GLBA; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; SOX

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this contact point is considered active and valid for the party. Supports point-in-time reconstruction of contact data for policy and claims history.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Structured email address for the party when contact_type is email. Stored separately for validation, opt-in tracking, and GLBA compliance.
attributes.references: GLBA; GDPR Article 4; CCPA; CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: email_bounce_code
attributes.description: SMTP bounce code or classification (e.g., 550 hard bounce, 421 soft bounce) returned when an email delivery attempt failed. Used to update contact_status to bounced.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which this contact point ceases to be valid. Null indicates the contact point is currently active. Enables temporal querying of contact history.

attributes.name: is_preferred
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the party's overall preferred contact method across all contact types. Used by PAS and CMS to select the default outreach channel.

attributes.name: is_primary
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact point is the primary contact for the party within its contact_type. Only one record per party per contact_type should be primary.

attributes.name: is_verified_mobile
attributes.description: Indicates whether a phone contact point has been confirmed as a mobile/wireless number via carrier lookup. Critical for TCPA autodialer and text message compliance.

attributes.name: is_wireless
attributes.description: Indicates whether the phone number is a wireless (cell) number as determined by carrier lookup. Distinct from is_verified_mobile; set by automated number type detection.

attributes.name: language_preference
attributes.description: Preferred language for communications via this contact point in BCP 47 format (e.g., en-US, es-MX). Supports state DOI language access requirements.
attributes.references: State DOI Language Access Requirements; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: last_contact_date
attributes.description: Most recent date on which a successful outbound or inbound communication was recorded via this contact point. Used for contact recency analytics and dormancy detection.

attributes.name: last_contact_outcome
attributes.description: Result of the most recent communication attempt via this contact point (e.g., reached, no_answer, voicemail, bounced). Informs next-best-action in claims and billing.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes recorded by an agent or adjuster about this contact point (e.g., call-back instructions, seasonal address). Stored in PAS and CMS contact objects.

attributes.name: opt_in_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the party has affirmatively opted in to receive communications via this contact point. Required for GLBA and TCPA compliance tracking.

attributes.name: opt_in_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the party provided opt-in consent for this contact point. Retained as evidence of consent for GLBA and TCPA regulatory audits.

attributes.name: opt_out_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the party has explicitly opted out of communications via this contact point. Suppresses outbound contact in PAS, CMS, and Billing systems.

attributes.name: opt_out_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the party revoked consent or opted out for this contact point. Triggers suppression in all downstream communication systems.

attributes.name: phone_extension
attributes.description: Optional telephone extension appended to the phone number for commercial parties, brokers, or agency contacts in the Producer Management System.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Structured phone number in E.164 format for the party when contact_type is phone or sms. Used for FNOL intake, billing, and claims communication.

attributes.name: source_system_contact_code
attributes.description: Native identifier of this contact record in the originating operational system (e.g., Guidewire ContactID). Enables cross-system reconciliation and MDM deduplication.

attributes.name: subtype
attributes.description: Secondary classification refining the contact type (e.g., home, work, mobile, billing, claims, underwriting). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: home|work|mobile|billing|claims|underwriting|other — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for this contact point (e.g., America/New_York). Used to schedule compliant outbound calls within TCPA permitted calling hours.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this contact point record. Used for change data capture, MDM synchronization, and audit trail compliance.

attributes.name: usage_purpose
attributes.description: Business purpose for which this contact point is used (e.g., billing notices, claims FNOL, policy documents, marketing). Drives targeted communication routing.
attributes.references: GLBA; ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The actual contact point value: phone number, email address, fax number, SMS number, or postal address string depending on contact_type. Contains PII.

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the contact point was last verified through a validation process such as email ping, carrier lookup, or agent confirmation.

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: Method used to verify this contact point (e.g., carrier_lookup for phone, email_ping for email, agent_confirmed for manual review). Supports MDM data quality.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact point has been validated (e.g., email deliverability check, phone number validation via carrier lookup). Used in KYC and MDM.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Laws; Customer/Party MDM; GLBA

products.name: identifier
products.description: External and internal identifiers assigned to a party: SSN, FEIN, NPN, NAIC code, driver license, passport, PAS party ID, MDM golden ID. One row per identifier per party. Supports deduplication and cross-system matching.

attributes.name: identifier_id
attributes.description: Surrogate primary key uniquely identifying one party identifier record. One row per identifier per party. Grain: one row per external or internal identifier assigned to a party.

attributes.name: identifier_mdm_golden_party_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Master Data Management (MDM) Golden Party ID
attributes.description: The MDM golden record identifier assigned to the party after deduplication and survivorship processing. Links this identifier to the authoritative master party record across all source systems.
attributes.references: MDM Best Practices; GLBA; ACORD Data Standards

tag_set.value: Master Data Management (MDM) Golden Party ID

attributes.name: identifier_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party record that owns this identifier. Links the identifier back to the master party in the Customer/Party MDM.

attributes.name: identifier_pas_party_id
attributes.description: The party identifier as assigned by the Policy Administration System (Guidewire PolicyCenter or Duck Creek Policy). Used for cross-reference between the data lakehouse and the PAS.
attributes.references: Guidewire PolicyCenter; Duck Creek Policy; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: clue_report_ordered
attributes.business_glossary_term: Comprehensive Loss Underwriting Exchange (CLUE) Report Ordered Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a CLUE (Comprehensive Loss Underwriting Exchange) report has been ordered for this party identifier. Used in personal lines underwriting to retrieve prior loss history.
attributes.references: FCRA; LexisNexis CLUE; ISO A-PLUS; NAIC Underwriting Guidelines

tag_set.value: Comprehensive Loss Underwriting Exchange (CLUE) Report Ordered Flag

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this identifier record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX; GLBA; NAIC Annual Statement; SAP/SSAP

attributes.name: dedup_match_key
attributes.description: Normalized, standardized form of the identifier value used for fuzzy matching and deduplication in the Party MDM. Strips formatting characters (dashes, spaces) for consistent comparison.
attributes.references: MDM Best Practices; GLBA; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this identifier became valid and effective. Used for temporal queries to determine which identifier was active at a given point in time.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Model Laws

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which this identifier expires or ceases to be valid. Null for identifiers with no expiry (e.g., SSN, FEIN). Used for license renewal tracking and compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: NIPR; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; AAMVA

attributes.name: fraud_indicator
attributes.description: Flag set by the Fraud Detection/SIU system indicating this identifier has been associated with suspected or confirmed fraudulent activity. Triggers enhanced review in underwriting and claims.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Standards; NICB; SIU Best Practices; FCRA

attributes.name: identifier_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this identifier record: active (in use), inactive (superseded), expired (past validity), revoked (cancelled by issuing authority), pending_verification (awaiting confirmation).

attributes.name: is_masked
attributes.description: Indicates whether the identifier_value stored is a masked or tokenized representation rather than the full plaintext value. True when only last-4 digits or a token is stored for PCI/GLBA compliance.
attributes.references: GLBA; GDPR Article 25; CCPA; PCI DSS

attributes.name: is_primary
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the primary identifier for the party within its identifier type. True if this is the preferred or golden record identifier used for cross-system matching and deduplication.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; MDM Best Practices

attributes.name: issuing_authority
attributes.description: Name of the government agency, regulatory body, or internal system that issued this identifier (e.g., IRS, SSA, NIPR, state DMV, state DOI, NAIC, internal MDM system).

attributes.name: issuing_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country that issued this identifier (e.g., USA, CAN, GBR). Required for passports and foreign national identifiers.

attributes.name: issuing_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state or territory code of the jurisdiction that issued this identifier. Applicable for driver licenses, state-issued producer licenses, and state DOI registrations.
attributes.references: USPS State Abbreviations; NAIC; NIPR; AAMVA

attributes.name: kyc_status
attributes.description: Know Your Customer compliance status for this identifier as part of anti-money laundering and fraud screening. Tracks whether the identifier has passed identity verification per GLBA and BSA/AML requirements.
attributes.references: GLBA; BSA/AML; FinCEN; OFAC; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: license_class
attributes.description: Classification of the license associated with this identifier (e.g., producer license class: P&C, Life, Health; driver license class: A, B, C, M). Applicable for DLN and producer license identifier types.
attributes.references: NIPR; NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; AAMVA; State DOI

attributes.name: license_number
attributes.description: State-issued insurance producer license number or driver license number depending on identifier_type_code. For DLN type, used in MVR ordering and auto underwriting. For producer, used in DOI compliance.
attributes.references: NIPR; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; AAMVA; State DOI

attributes.name: license_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code of the jurisdiction under which the license was issued. Distinct from issuing_state_code when a producer holds licenses in multiple states.
attributes.references: NIPR; NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; State DOI; USPS

attributes.name: masked_value
attributes.description: Partially masked display version of the identifier for UI and reporting use (e.g., ***-**-1234 for SSN, **-***1234 for FEIN). Allows display without exposing the full sensitive value.
attributes.references: GLBA; GDPR Article 25; CCPA; PCI DSS

attributes.name: mvr_order_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent MVR was ordered for this driver license identifier. Used to determine MVR currency and whether a refresh is required per underwriting guidelines.
attributes.references: FCRA; AAMVA; DPPA; NAIC Auto Underwriting Guidelines

attributes.name: mvr_ordered
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) has been ordered for this driver license identifier. Applicable when identifier_type_code = DLN. Used in personal and commercial auto underwriting.
attributes.references: FCRA; AAMVA; DPPA (Driver Privacy Protection Act); NAIC

attributes.name: naic_company_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) Company Code
attributes.description: Five-digit NAIC company code assigned to an insurance carrier or reinsurer. Populated when identifier_type_code = NAIC_CODE. Used in statutory reporting and Schedule F/P filings.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement; NAIC Company Database; SAP/SSAP

tag_set.value: National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) Company Code

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments recorded by underwriters, compliance officers, or MDM stewards regarding this identifier (e.g., reason for revocation, manual override justification, discrepancy notes).
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Standards; SOX; MDM Best Practices

attributes.name: npn
attributes.description: NIPR-assigned National Producer Number for licensed insurance producers and agencies. Populated when identifier_type_code = NPN. Required for producer appointment and commission processing.
attributes.references: NIPR; NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; State DOI regulations

attributes.name: ofac_check_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) Check Status
attributes.description: Result of OFAC SDN (Specially Designated Nationals) screening for this identifier. Required for sanctions compliance. Cleared = no match; Flagged = potential match requiring review.
attributes.references: OFAC SDN List; BSA/AML; FinCEN; GLBA; Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX)

tag_set.value: Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) Check Status

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record that originated this identifier record (e.g., PAS for PolicyCenter, MDM for party master, PRODUCER_MGMT for agency system, FRAUD_SIU for SIU system).
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; SOX; NAIC Annual Statement

attributes.name: source_system_party_ref
attributes.description: The party or entity reference key as it exists in the originating source system. Enables cross-system reconciliation and deduplication between PAS, MDM, billing, and claims systems.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; MDM Best Practices

attributes.name: tin_match_status
attributes.description: Result of IRS TIN matching for SSN/FEIN identifiers. Used for 1099 reporting compliance and backup withholding determination. Values: matched, not_matched, pending, not_checked.
attributes.references: IRS TIN Matching Program; IRS Publication 1281; FATCA; SOX

attributes.name: tin_type
attributes.description: Specifies the type of IRS Taxpayer Identification Number: SSN (Social Security Number), FEIN (Federal Employer Identification Number), ITIN (Individual Taxpayer Identification Number), or EIN (Employer Identification Number).
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1635; IRS Form W-9; GLBA; FATCA

attributes.name: type_code
attributes.description: Classifies the kind of identifier: SSN (Social Security Number), FEIN (Federal Employer Identification Number), NPN (National Producer Number), NAIC Code, DLN (Driver License Number), PASSPORT, PAS_PARTY_ID, MDM_GOLDEN_ID.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this identifier record was last modified. Used for change data capture, incremental ETL processing, and audit trail maintenance per SOX and GLBA requirements.
attributes.references: SOX; GLBA; NAIC Annual Statement; SAP/SSAP

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The actual identifier string (e.g., SSN digits, FEIN digits, NPN number, driver license number, passport number, PAS party ID, MDM golden record ID). Stored encrypted at rest per GLBA and GDPR/CCPA.
attributes.references: GLBA; GDPR Article 4; CCPA; FCRA; IRS Publication 1635

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the identifier was last verified against the issuing authority or third-party source. Supports compliance audit trails and re-verification scheduling.
attributes.references: FCRA; GLBA; NIPR; IRS TIN Matching Program

attributes.name: verification_source
attributes.description: Name of the system or service used to verify this identifier (e.g., NIPR, IRS TIN Match, SSA, LexisNexis, Equifax, state DMV MVR, CLUE). Supports audit and compliance documentation.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether this identifier has been validated against the issuing authority or a third-party verification service (e.g., NIPR NPN check, IRS TIN match, SSA SSN verification, CLUE, MVR).
attributes.references: FCRA; GLBA; NIPR; IRS TIN Matching Program; SSA

products.name: relationship
products.description: Directed relationship between two parties: spouse, parent-subsidiary, named insured to additional insured, employer-employee. One row per relationship. Carries relationship type, effective dates, and primary-party flag.

attributes.name: relationship_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a directed party-to-party relationship record. One row per relationship instance in the Party MDM.

attributes.name: from_party_id
attributes.description: Surrogate key of the originating (subject) party in the directed relationship, e.g., the policyholder or parent organization.

attributes.name: party_group_id
attributes.description: Identifier for a commercial group or affiliated enterprise to which both parties belong. Supports group policy pricing, NAIC group reporting, and affiliated transaction rules.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement; NAIC Model Holding Company Act

attributes.name: household_id
attributes.description: Identifier linking parties that belong to the same household unit. Used for multi-policy household bundling, cross-sell analytics, and personal lines rating.
attributes.references: Customer/Party MDM; ISO Personal Lines Rating

attributes.name: to_party_id
attributes.description: Surrogate key of the target (object) party in the directed relationship, e.g., the additional insured or subsidiary organization.

attributes.name: relationship_category
attributes.description: Broad grouping of the relationship type: Personal (family/household), Commercial (business hierarchy), Legal (trust/guardianship), or Financial (guarantor/beneficiary).
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Model Laws

attributes.name: control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the from-party exercises a controlling interest over the to-party for regulatory group reporting and affiliated transaction disclosures.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Holding Company Act; SOX; RBC requirements

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this relationship record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX; Model Audit Rule (MAR); GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the relationship became or becomes legally and operationally effective. Used for point-in-time reconstruction of party relationships.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the relationship ceases to be effective. Null indicates an open-ended relationship with no scheduled end date.

attributes.name: fraud_indicator_flag
attributes.description: Flag set by the SIU or fraud detection system indicating this relationship has been flagged for potential fraud, e.g., staged household relationships to obtain discounts.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Standards; Fraud Detection/SIU System; FCRA

attributes.name: is_bidirectional
attributes.description: Indicates whether the relationship is symmetric (True) or strictly directed (False). Symmetric relationships such as spouse do not require a reciprocal row.

attributes.name: is_primary
attributes.description: Indicates whether the from-party is the primary party in this relationship type (e.g., primary named insured vs. additional insured). True = primary.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction governing the relationship. Supports international and surplus lines business.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; NAIC Model Laws; Solvency II

attributes.name: jurisdiction_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code of the jurisdiction governing the relationship. Drives state-specific underwriting rules, regulatory filings, and DOI compliance.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Laws; State DOI regulations; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: legal_basis_code
attributes.description: Legal instrument or authority establishing the relationship, e.g., MARRIAGE certificate, COURT_ORDER, CORPORATE_FILING. Required for KYC and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: GLBA; NAIC Model Laws; FCRA; GDPR Article 6

attributes.name: legal_basis_date
attributes.description: Date the legal instrument establishing the relationship was executed or issued, e.g., date of marriage, date of court order, date of corporate filing.

attributes.name: legal_basis_reference
attributes.description: Document reference number or identifier for the legal instrument establishing the relationship, e.g., marriage certificate number, court order docket number.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for underwriter or compliance officer annotations about the relationship, such as special circumstances, exceptions, or documentation notes.
attributes.references: Customer/Party MDM; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: ownership_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of ownership or controlling interest held by the from-party over the to-party. Applicable for parent-subsidiary and investor relationships. Range 0.00–100.00.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement; SOX; GAAP ASC 810

attributes.name: relationship_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the relationship record. ACTIVE means the relationship is in force; TERMINATED means it has ended; PENDING means awaiting verification.
attributes.references: Customer/Party MDM; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: role_from
attributes.description: The specific role the from-party plays within this relationship instance, e.g., POLICYHOLDER, PARENT, EMPLOYER. Complements relationship_type_code for granular role tracking.

attributes.name: role_to
attributes.description: The specific role the to-party plays within this relationship instance, e.g., ADDITIONAL_INSURED, SUBSIDIARY, EMPLOYEE. Enables multi-role party resolution.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record that originated this relationship record, e.g., MDM (Party MDM), PAS (PolicyCenter), CLAIMS (ClaimCenter).

attributes.name: source_system_relationship_code
attributes.description: Native identifier of this relationship record in the originating source system. Enables lineage tracing and reconciliation back to Guidewire PolicyCenter or Duck Creek.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Actual date the relationship was terminated or dissolved, which may differ from the scheduled expiration date (e.g., divorce decree date, corporate dissolution date).
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Model Laws

attributes.name: termination_reason_code
attributes.description: Coded reason explaining why the relationship was terminated. Supports audit, compliance, and underwriting eligibility re-evaluation.

attributes.name: type_code
attributes.description: Classifies the nature of the directed relationship between two parties. Drives underwriting, coverage eligibility, and KYC rules. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product for full list]
attributes.references: ACORD 125/126; NAIC Model Laws; Customer/Party MDM

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this relationship record was last modified in the data platform. Used for change data capture and incremental processing in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: SOX; Model Audit Rule (MAR); GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: uw_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this relationship has a material impact on underwriting eligibility or rating, e.g., a parent-subsidiary relationship affecting group pricing or a household relationship affecting multi-car discount.
attributes.references: ISO Rating Rules; NAIC Model Laws; Underwriting Workbench

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the relationship was last verified by the KYC/compliance process. Null if never verified.
attributes.references: GLBA; FCRA; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: KYC/AML verification status of the relationship. VERIFIED means supporting documentation has been reviewed and accepted by the underwriting or compliance team.
attributes.references: GLBA; FCRA; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: verified_by
attributes.description: Name or user identifier of the compliance officer or underwriter who verified the relationship. Supports audit trail and SOX controls.
attributes.references: SOX; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; Model Audit Rule (MAR)

products.name: kyc_verification
products.description: KYC and identity-verification record for a party. Tracks verification method, verification date, result (pass/fail/review), OFAC screening status, PEP flag, adverse-media flag, and the analyst who performed the check.

attributes.name: kyc_verification_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each KYC verification record. One row per KYC check performed on a party. Grain: one row per KYC verification event per party.

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Reference to the claim that triggered this KYC verification, when applicable (e.g., FNOL claimant screening or SIU referral). Null for verifications not associated with a specific claim.
attributes.references: GLBA, NAIC Market Conduct Standards, Fraud Detection

attributes.name: jurisdiction_geography_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophegeography.geography. Business justification: KYC regulatory compliance reporting requires tracking verification jurisdiction by state/country geography.

attributes.name: kyc_analyst_party_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the compliance analyst or underwriter who performed or reviewed this KYC verification. Required for manual review cases and audit accountability. Links to the Party or User record.
attributes.references: SOX, NAIC Market Conduct Standards, GLBA

attributes.name: kyc_override_approver_party_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the senior compliance officer or manager who approved the override of a KYC verification result. Populated only when override_reason is present. Supports SOX audit controls.
attributes.references: SOX, NAIC Market Conduct Standards, FinCEN CDD Rule

attributes.name: kyc_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party (person or organization) subject to this KYC verification. Links to the Party master record in the Party domain.

attributes.name: submission_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to coverage.submission. Business justification: KYC/OFAC screening performed during underwriting (pre-bind) requires linkage to submission for regulatory audit trail, SIU referral tracking, and compliance with AML requirements at

attributes.name: adverse_media_summary
attributes.description: Brief narrative summary of adverse media findings when is_adverse_media is true. Captures the nature of the negative news (e.g., fraud allegation, regulatory sanction) for analyst review and documentation.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendations, GLBA, NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: analyst_decision
attributes.description: Final decision made by the compliance analyst after reviewing the KYC verification results. APPROVE=cleared to proceed; REJECT=relationship declined; ESCALATE=referred to senior compliance; DEFER=pending additional info.
attributes.references: FinCEN CDD Rule, NAIC Market Conduct Standards, SOX

attributes.name: analyst_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the compliance analyst documenting the rationale for the decision, exceptions granted, or additional context observed during the KYC review process.
attributes.references: SOX, NAIC Market Conduct Standards, GLBA

attributes.name: beneficial_owner_count
attributes.description: Number of beneficial owners identified and verified for a legal entity party. Per FinCEN CDD Rule, includes all natural persons owning 25% or more equity interest plus one control person.

attributes.name: beneficial_owner_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the beneficial ownership of the party (for legal entities) has been verified per FinCEN CDD Rule requirements. Mandatory for legal entity customers with 25%+ ownership threshold.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this KYC verification record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail creation marker required for SOX and regulatory compliance reporting.

attributes.name: data_source_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the originating system or data source for this KYC verification record (e.g., MDM_KYC, PAS_UW, CLAIMS_FNOL). Supports data lineage and source-system reconciliation in the lakehouse.

attributes.name: due_diligence_level
attributes.description: Level of due diligence applied for this KYC verification. SIMPLIFIED=low-risk customers; STANDARD=normal CDD; ENHANCED=high-risk, PEP, or OFAC-adjacent parties. Aligns with FinCEN CDD Rule tiers.
attributes.references: FinCEN CDD Rule 31 CFR 1010.230, FATF Recommendations

attributes.name: escalation_reason
attributes.description: Narrative reason for escalating this KYC case to senior compliance or a Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) filing. Populated when analyst_decision is ESCALATE. Supports AML investigation workflow.
attributes.references: FinCEN SAR Filing Requirements, GLBA, BSA

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which this KYC verification result expires and a refresh is required. Drives periodic review scheduling. Null if the verification has no defined expiry per risk tier.
attributes.references: FinCEN CDD Rule, FATF Recommendations, NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: identity_document_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the identity document used during verification. An expired document may invalidate the KYC result and trigger a re-verification requirement.

attributes.name: identity_document_issuing_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the authority that issued the identity document used in verification. Used for sanctions screening and cross-border risk assessment.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1, OFAC SDN, FinCEN CDD Rule

attributes.name: identity_document_number
attributes.description: The document number from the identity document used for verification (e.g., passport number, driver license number, FEIN). Stored as restricted PII per GLBA and FCRA requirements.

attributes.name: identity_document_type
attributes.description: Type of identity document presented or verified during the KYC check. PASSPORT, DRIVERS_LICENSE, NATIONAL_ID, STATE_ID, MILITARY_ID for individuals; FEIN (Federal Employer Identification Number) for organizations.

attributes.name: is_adverse_media
attributes.description: Indicates whether adverse media (negative news coverage related to financial crime, fraud, sanctions, or regulatory action) was found for this party during the KYC screening process.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendations, NAIC Market Conduct Standards, GLBA

attributes.name: is_pep
attributes.description: Indicates whether the party has been identified as a Politically Exposed Person (PEP) — a current or former senior government official or close associate. Triggers enhanced due diligence requirements.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendations, FinCEN CDD Rule, GLBA

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the next periodic KYC review is scheduled for this party, based on risk tier and due diligence level. Drives compliance workflow queues and regulatory review cycle management.
attributes.references: FinCEN CDD Rule, FATF Recommendations, NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: ofac_hit_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) Hit Reference
attributes.description: OFAC SDN list entry reference number or identifier when a hit or potential hit is recorded. Populated only when ofac_screening_status is HIT or POTENTIAL_HIT. Used for regulatory escalation.

tag_set.value: Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) Hit Reference

attributes.name: ofac_screening_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) Screening Status
attributes.description: Result of screening the party against the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) and blocked persons list. CLEAR=no match; HIT=confirmed match; POTENTIAL_HIT=possible match requiring review.
attributes.references: OFAC SDN List, 31 CFR Part 500, FinCEN CDD Rule

tag_set.value: Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) Screening Status

attributes.name: override_reason
attributes.description: Documented reason when a KYC verification result is overridden by a compliance officer (e.g., false positive OFAC hit, known PEP with approved exception). Required for audit trail when verification_status is WAIVED.
attributes.references: SOX, NAIC Market Conduct Standards, FinCEN CDD Rule

attributes.name: pep_category
attributes.description: Classification of the PEP relationship when is_pep is true. DOMESTIC=domestic official; FOREIGN=foreign official; INTERNATIONAL_ORGANIZATION=IO official; CLOSE_ASSOCIATE=known associate; FAMILY_MEMBER=immediate family.

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the compliance analyst completed their manual review and recorded the analyst_decision. Distinct from verification_date which is when the automated check ran.
attributes.references: FinCEN CDD Rule, SOX, NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: risk_tier
attributes.description: Customer risk classification assigned as a result of the KYC process. Determines due diligence level, review frequency, and monitoring intensity. Aligns with FATF risk-based approach.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendations, FinCEN CDD Rule, GLBA

attributes.name: sar_filed
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) was filed with FinCEN as a result of this KYC verification finding. Triggers restricted access controls on the record per BSA requirements.
attributes.references: BSA 31 USC 5318(g), FinCEN SAR Filing Requirements

attributes.name: sar_reference_number
attributes.description: FinCEN-assigned reference number for the Suspicious Activity Report filed in connection with this KYC verification. Populated only when sar_filed is true. Strictly access-controlled.
attributes.references: BSA 31 USC 5318(g), FinCEN SAR Filing Requirements

attributes.name: siu_case_number
attributes.description: Case reference number assigned by the SIU system when this KYC verification triggered a fraud investigation referral. Populated only when siu_referral is true.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Insurance Fraud Act, Fraud Detection/SIU System

attributes.name: siu_referral
attributes.description: Indicates whether this KYC verification result triggered a referral to the Special Investigations Unit (SIU) for potential insurance fraud investigation. Integrates with the Fraud Detection/SIU System.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Insurance Fraud Act, NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: third_party_provider
attributes.description: Name of the external vendor or service used to perform the KYC verification (e.g., LexisNexis, Experian, Equifax, Refinitiv World-Check). Populated when verification_method is THIRD_PARTY_SERVICE.

attributes.name: third_party_reference_code
attributes.description: Unique transaction or case reference number returned by the third-party KYC provider for this verification. Used for reconciliation, dispute resolution, and audit trail with the external vendor.

attributes.name: trigger_event
attributes.description: Business event that initiated this KYC verification. NEW_BUSINESS=new policy application; RENEWAL=policy renewal; ENDORSEMENT=mid-term change; CLAIM_FNOL=first notice of loss; PERIODIC_REVIEW=scheduled refresh; RISK_CHANGE=risk profile change.
attributes.references: FinCEN CDD Rule, NAIC Market Conduct Standards, GLBA

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this KYC verification record. Tracks when analyst decisions, overrides, or status changes were last applied. Required for data lineage in the Silver layer.

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the KYC verification check was performed. Used for regulatory reporting, periodic review scheduling, and compliance audit trails.
attributes.references: FinCEN CDD Rule, GLBA, NAIC Annual Statement

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: Mechanism used to perform the verification. Examples: DOCUMENT_REVIEW=physical/digital ID doc; DATABASE_LOOKUP=internal/external data match; THIRD_PARTY_SERVICE=vendor API; BIOMETRIC=fingerprint/facial; CREDIT_BUREAU=bureau pull.

attributes.name: verification_result
attributes.description: Detailed outcome of the verification check. CLEAR=no issues found; MATCH=identity confirmed; NO_MATCH=identity not confirmed; PARTIAL_MATCH=partial data match requiring review; INCONCLUSIVE=insufficient data.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Current outcome or workflow state of this KYC verification. PASS=cleared; FAIL=failed check; REVIEW=manual review required; PENDING=in progress; EXPIRED=result past validity window; WAIVED=exempted per policy.
attributes.references: FinCEN CDD Rule, NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: verification_timestamp
attributes.description: Exact date and time the KYC verification was executed, including timezone offset. Provides precise audit trail for regulatory and compliance purposes beyond the calendar date.

attributes.name: verification_type
attributes.description: Category of KYC check performed. IDENTITY=identity document check; OFAC_SCREENING=sanctions list; PEP_SCREENING=politically exposed person; ADVERSE_MEDIA=negative news; EDU=enhanced due diligence; PERIODIC_REVIEW=scheduled refresh.
attributes.references: FinCEN CDD Rule, OFAC SDN, FATF Recommendations

attributes.name: watchlist_hit_detail
attributes.description: Description of any watchlist match found beyond OFAC screening, including the list name and entry reference. Populated when watchlist_screened is true and a match was identified.

attributes.name: watchlist_screened
attributes.description: Indicates whether the party was screened against applicable government and industry watchlists beyond OFAC (e.g., FBI Most Wanted, Interpol, EU Consolidated List, UN Sanctions). Supports comprehensive AML compliance.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendations, FinCEN CDD Rule, OFAC

products.name: consent_record
products.description: Captures explicit consent or opt-out events for a party: marketing, electronic delivery, telematics, credit pull, MVR pull. One row per consent event. Stores consent type, channel, timestamp, and regulatory basis (GLBA/CCPA/GDPR).

attributes.name: consent_record_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each consent or opt-out event record. One row per consent event per party per consent type. Primary key of this table.

attributes.name: consent_guardian_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Party record of the parent or legal guardian who provided consent on behalf of a minor. Null when is_minor is false or guardian consent is not required.

attributes.name: consent_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Party who granted, withheld, or revoked consent. Links to the Party master record in the Customer/Party MDM.

attributes.name: party_document_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the specific consent notice, privacy policy, or disclosure document presented to the party. Links to the Document & Forms Management system for audit retrieval.

attributes.name: prior_consent_record_id
attributes.description: Reference to the previous consent record that this event supersedes or replaces. Enables a linked-list audit chain of consent history for a party and consent type over time.

attributes.name: role_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific Party Role (policyholder, claimant, producer, etc.) under which consent was captured, enabling role-scoped consent tracking.

attributes.name: agent_npn
attributes.description: The National Producer Number (NPN) of the producer or agent who facilitated the consent capture on behalf of the party. Null for self-service digital channels.

attributes.name: consent_action
attributes.description: The action taken by the party on this consent event: granted (affirmative consent), revoked (withdrawal), opted_out (negative election), renewed (re-affirmation), or pending (awaiting confirmation).

attributes.name: consent_channel
attributes.description: The interface or channel through which the party provided or withdrew consent. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: web|mobile_app|ivr|agent|paper|email|sms|chat|kiosk — promote to reference product if more than 6 values needed]

attributes.name: consent_language
attributes.description: IETF BCP 47 language tag (e.g., en-US, es-MX) of the consent notice presented to the party. Supports multilingual compliance and state DOI requirements for non-English disclosures.

attributes.name: consent_method
attributes.description: The mechanism by which consent was obtained: opt_in (affirmative click/signature), opt_out (negative election), double_opt_in (confirmed via follow-up), implied (by contract), or written (signed document).

attributes.name: consent_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this consent record. Active means the consent is in force; superseded means a newer record has replaced it; expired means the consent lapsed past its expiration date.

attributes.name: consent_text_hash
attributes.description: SHA-256 hash of the exact consent notice text presented to the party. Provides tamper-evident proof of the specific language used, supporting regulatory audit without storing full text.

attributes.name: consent_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time (with timezone offset) when the party performed the consent action. This is the principal real-world event time, distinct from the record audit timestamp.

attributes.name: consent_type
attributes.description: Category of consent or opt-out captured. Examples: marketing communications, electronic policy delivery, telematics data collection, credit pull authorization, Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) pull, data sharing.

attributes.name: consent_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the consent notice, disclosure form, or privacy policy presented to the party at the time of consent. Enables tracking of which notice language was in effect.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this consent record was first written to the data store. Audit trail field distinct from consent_timestamp (the business event time). Set once and never updated.

attributes.name: credit_pull_permissible_purpose
attributes.description: The FCRA-defined permissible purpose for which a credit report pull is authorized (e.g., underwriting, rating, renewal). Required for FCRA compliance when consent_type is credit_pull.

attributes.name: data_categories_covered
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list of personal data categories covered by this consent (e.g., driving behavior, credit score, location data, health data). Required for GDPR Article 13 transparency.

attributes.name: data_use_purpose
attributes.description: Specific stated purpose for which data will be used under this consent (e.g., underwriting rating, claims processing, marketing, telematics scoring). Aligns with GDPR purpose limitation principle.

attributes.name: device_fingerprint
attributes.description: Hashed or tokenized identifier of the device used to submit consent. Supports fraud detection and non-repudiation for digital consent events. Stored as a hash, not raw device data.

attributes.name: do_not_contact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates the party has requested no contact for any purpose beyond contractual necessity. Distinct from suppression_flag which is channel/purpose-specific. Overrides all outreach.
attributes.references: TCPA, CCPA, State DOI Market Conduct

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this consent record is legally binding and operationally in force. May differ from consent_timestamp if there is a processing lag or future-dated activation.

attributes.name: electronic_delivery_format
attributes.description: The agreed electronic format for policy document delivery when consent_type is electronic_delivery. Populated per state e-delivery statutes and NAIC Model Electronic Transactions Act.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Electronic Transactions Act, State DOI

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this consent record expires and must be re-obtained. Null indicates open-ended consent with no scheduled expiry. Used for periodic re-consent workflows.

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: The IP address of the device from which the party submitted the consent action online. Used for fraud detection, audit, and jurisdictional determination. May be PII under GDPR/CCPA.

attributes.name: is_minor
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consenting party is a minor (under 18 or applicable age of majority). Triggers parental/guardian consent requirements under COPPA, GDPR Article 8, and state regulations.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction governing this consent record. Supports GDPR applicability determination for international or EU-exposed business.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code of the jurisdiction governing this consent record. Determines which state DOI regulations and privacy laws (e.g., CCPA for CA) apply to this consent event.

attributes.name: mvr_pull_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code of the DMV from which the Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) pull is authorized. Populated only when consent_type is mvr_pull. Drives state-specific MVR ordering.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the capturing agent, compliance officer, or system regarding special circumstances of this consent event (e.g., verbal consent noted, exception approved).

attributes.name: opt_out_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason provided by the party when revoking consent or opting out. Supports customer experience analysis and regulatory response documentation.

attributes.name: policy_number
attributes.description: The externally-known policy number associated with this consent event, when consent is captured in the context of a specific policy (e.g., telematics enrollment, electronic delivery election at bind).

attributes.name: proof_of_consent_ref
attributes.description: Reference to the stored evidence of consent (e.g., signed form scan ID, recorded call ID, e-signature token, screenshot hash). Supports regulatory audit and non-repudiation.

attributes.name: regulatory_basis
attributes.description: The primary legal or regulatory framework under which this consent was obtained or is required. Drives compliance reporting and data handling obligations. Examples: GLBA, CCPA, GDPR, FCRA, TCPA.

attributes.name: revocation_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the party revoked or withdrew consent. Null if consent has not been revoked. Supports GDPR right-to-withdraw and CCPA opt-out audit trails.

attributes.name: source_transaction_code
attributes.description: The unique transaction or session identifier from the originating source system at the time consent was captured. Enables cross-system audit trail reconciliation.

attributes.name: suppression_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this party is suppressed from the associated data use (e.g., marketing suppression list, do-not-call registry). Drives downstream campaign and outreach exclusion logic.

attributes.name: telematics_program_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the telematics or usage-based insurance (UBI) program for which consent was obtained. Populated only when consent_type is telematics. Links to the telematics program configuration.

attributes.name: third_party_sharing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consent authorizes sharing of the party's data with third parties (e.g., reinsurers, data vendors, ISO/CLUE). Drives GLBA opt-out and CCPA sale-of-data controls.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this consent record was last modified in the data store (e.g., status updated to superseded or expired). Supports audit trail and change data capture.

attributes.name: verification_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the consent event was independently verified (e.g., double opt-in confirmation received). Null if verified_flag is false or verification is not required.

attributes.name: verified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consent event has been independently verified (e.g., double opt-in email confirmation received, recorded call reviewed). Supports quality assurance and regulatory defensibility.

products.name: merge_event
products.description: MDM deduplication event that merges a survivor party with one or more duplicate parties. One row per merge operation. Stores survivor party, merged party, merge date, merge reason, and the operator who approved the merge.

attributes.name: merge_event_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each Master Data Management (MDM) party merge event. One row per merge operation in the Party MDM deduplication process.

attributes.name: merge_approved_by_party_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the Party (operator/user) who reviewed and approved the merge decision. Required for audit trail and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX); NAIC Market Conduct Standards; GLBA

attributes.name: merge_reversed_by_party_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the Party (operator/user) who authorized and executed the reversal of this merge event. Null if no reversal has occurred.

attributes.name: merge_survivor_party_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the Party record designated as the golden/survivor record after the merge. All downstream references are repointed to this party.
attributes.references: Customer/Party MDM — Deduplication Module; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: primary_merged_party_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the Party record identified as the duplicate and absorbed into the survivor. This party is retired after the merge operation completes.
attributes.references: Customer/Party MDM — Deduplication Module; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: affected_billing_account_count
attributes.description: Number of billing accounts linked to the merged party that were consolidated under the survivor party as part of this merge operation.

attributes.name: affected_claim_count
attributes.description: Number of claims linked to the merged (duplicate) party that were repointed to the survivor party as a result of this merge operation.

attributes.name: affected_policy_count
attributes.description: Number of active or historical policies linked to the merged (duplicate) party that were repointed to the survivor party as a result of this merge operation.

attributes.name: batch_run_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the MDM deduplication batch job run that generated this merge event, if the merge was produced by an automated batch matching process rather than a real-time request.

attributes.name: conflict_resolution_notes
attributes.description: Operator-entered notes describing how conflicting attribute values between the survivor and merged party were resolved. Null if no conflicts were detected.
attributes.references: Customer/Party MDM — Deduplication Module; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this merge event record was first created in the data platform. Serves as the audit trail creation marker per SOX and GLBA requirements.

attributes.name: data_conflict_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether conflicting attribute values (e.g., different addresses, DOBs, or contact details) were detected between the survivor and merged party records during the merge.

attributes.name: fraud_indicator_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Fraud Detection or SIU system flagged this merge event as potentially suspicious, such as an attempt to obscure a party's claims or underwriting history.
attributes.references: Fraud Detection / SIU System; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; FCRA

attributes.name: kyc_review_completed_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Know Your Customer (KYC) Review Completed Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the post-merge KYC review has been completed for the survivor party. Relevant only when kyc_review_required_flag is true.
attributes.references: GLBA; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; Customer/Party MDM — KYC Module

tag_set.value: Know Your Customer (KYC) Review Completed Flag

attributes.name: kyc_review_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Know Your Customer (KYC) Review Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the merge triggered a KYC re-verification requirement for the survivor party, typically when identity attributes differ between the two records.
attributes.references: GLBA; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; Customer/Party MDM — KYC Module

tag_set.value: Know Your Customer (KYC) Review Required Flag

attributes.name: match_rule_set
attributes.description: Identifier or name of the matching rule set or algorithm version applied by the MDM engine to compute the match score (e.g., RULE_SET_V3_NAME_DOB_SSN).

attributes.name: match_score
attributes.description: Probabilistic similarity score (0.00–100.00) produced by the MDM matching algorithm comparing the survivor and merged party records. Higher scores indicate stronger duplicate confidence.

attributes.name: merge_approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when an authorized operator approved the merge operation. Null if the merge is automated and requires no human approval step.
attributes.references: Customer/Party MDM — Deduplication Module; SOX; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: merge_channel
attributes.description: The processing channel through which the merge was initiated: batch deduplication job, real-time event trigger, API call from an integrated system, or manual entry via the MDM user interface.

attributes.name: merge_executed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the merge operation was physically applied in the MDM system, retiring the duplicate party and consolidating records under the survivor.
attributes.references: Customer/Party MDM — Deduplication Module; GLBA; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: merge_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code classifying the root cause of the duplicate. Drives reporting on data quality issues and MDM process improvement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product if codes expand]
attributes.references: Customer/Party MDM — Deduplication Module; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: merge_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative explaining the specific circumstances that led to the duplicate party records and the rationale for selecting the survivor record.

attributes.name: merge_request_code
attributes.description: Externally visible business identifier for the merge request ticket or workflow instance, as assigned by the MDM or deduplication system (e.g., MDM-2024-00123).

attributes.name: merge_requested_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the merge request was first submitted into the MDM workflow queue, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset.

attributes.name: merge_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the merge operation. Pending awaits approval; approved is authorized but not yet executed; completed is fully applied; reversed is undone; failed encountered an error.

attributes.name: merge_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the merge was initiated manually by an operator, triggered automatically by the MDM matching engine, or surfaced as a system suggestion pending human review.

attributes.name: merged_party_pre_merge_status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of the duplicate party record immediately before the merge was executed. Preserved for audit and potential reversal.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: General free-text notes entered by the operator or MDM system regarding this merge event, including any special handling instructions or escalation context.

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the merge of these party records triggers a regulatory notification obligation, such as under GLBA, GDPR/CCPA, or state DOI market conduct requirements.
attributes.references: GLBA; GDPR Article 17; CCPA; State DOI Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_sent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the required regulatory notification has been dispatched following the merge. Relevant only when regulatory_notification_required_flag is true.
attributes.references: GLBA; GDPR Article 17; CCPA; State DOI Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation of why a completed merge was reversed. Null if no reversal has occurred. Required for data governance and audit compliance.
attributes.references: Customer/Party MDM — Deduplication Module; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: reversal_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when a completed merge was reversed (un-merged). Null if the merge has not been reversed. Supports audit trail for erroneous merges.

attributes.name: siu_referral_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this merge event was referred to the Special Investigations Unit (SIU) for further review due to suspected fraud or identity manipulation.
attributes.references: Fraud Detection / SIU System; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system that originated or triggered the merge request (e.g., MDM for the party master, PAS for the policy system, CLAIMS for the claims system).
attributes.references: Customer/Party MDM — Deduplication Module; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: source_system_merge_ref
attributes.description: The native identifier or transaction reference for this merge event as recorded in the originating source system, enabling cross-system traceability.

attributes.name: survivor_party_pre_merge_status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of the survivor party record immediately before the merge was executed. Preserved for audit and potential reversal.

attributes.name: survivor_selection_basis
attributes.description: Criterion used to designate the survivor record: most recently updated, most data-complete, most associated policies, operator override, or system default rule.
attributes.references: Customer/Party MDM — Deduplication Module; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this merge event record was last modified in the data platform. Tracks status transitions, reversals, and operator updates for audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX; GLBA; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

products.name: segment
products.description: Business segmentation classification assigned to a party: personal lines, commercial lines, preferred, standard, non-standard, high-net-worth. One row per segment assignment per party. Supports underwriting appetite and marketing targeting.

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a party segment assignment record. One row per segment assignment per party. Primary key of the segment table.
attributes.references: NAIC Data Standards; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: line_of_business_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.line_of_business. Business justification: Customer segmentation strategies (preferred, standard, non-standard) are defined per LOB with distinct underwriting appetite, pricing tiers, and profitability targets.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party record being segmented. Links this segment assignment to the Party master in the Party domain SSOT.

attributes.name: assigned_by
attributes.description: User ID or system process name that created or last modified this segment assignment. Supports audit trail and SOX compliance for underwriting decisions.
attributes.references: SOX; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; Model Audit Rule (MAR)

attributes.name: assignment_method
attributes.description: Method by which this segment was assigned to the party: automated rules engine, manual underwriter override, predictive model scoring, or imported from external system.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Standards; ISO Rating Standards

attributes.name: assignment_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason explaining why this segment was assigned or changed (e.g., credit score improvement, loss history review, annual re-segmentation cycle). Supports audit and compliance.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Standards; SOX; MAR

attributes.name: cat_zone
attributes.description: Catastrophe zone designation for the party's primary location. Used in CAT XL treaty cession eligibility, PML aggregation, and reinsurance bordereaux reporting.
attributes.references: RMS RiskLink; AIR Touchstone; NAIC CAT Reporting

attributes.name: clue_indicator
attributes.description: Summary indicator of the party's CLUE loss history report result at time of segmentation. Influences underwriting tier and rate plan. CLUE is a LexisNexis product used in P&C underwriting.
attributes.references: FCRA; LexisNexis CLUE; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: segment_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the segment classification (e.g., PERS_PREF, COMM_STD, HNW). Used in rating, underwriting appetite rules, and marketing targeting.
attributes.references: ISO Rating Standards; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this segment assignment record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, SOX compliance, and data lineage tracking per MAR requirements.
attributes.references: SOX; MAR; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; GLBA

attributes.name: credit_score_band
attributes.description: Banded credit quality tier derived from the party's insurance credit score at time of segmentation. Used in personal lines rating and underwriting eligibility per state DOI rules.
attributes.references: FCRA; NAIC Model Credit Scoring Law; State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: distribution_channel
attributes.description: Distribution channel through which the party was acquired or is primarily serviced. Influences commission schedules, marketing campaigns, and segment-level profitability analysis.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Standards; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this segment assignment is in effect for the party. Supports point-in-time reconstruction of the party's segment at any policy effective date or loss date.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Laws; SAP; IFRS 17; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: employee_count_band
attributes.description: Banded employee headcount of the commercial party at time of segmentation. Relevant for WC, EPLI, and GL class plan assignment and underwriting appetite screening.
attributes.references: NCCI Workers Compensation; ISO GL Rating Manual

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which this segment assignment expires or is superseded. Null indicates the assignment is currently open-ended and active. Enables temporal querying of segment history.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Laws; SAP; IFRS 17; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: fraud_indicator
attributes.description: Fraud risk classification for the party as flagged by the SIU/Fraud Detection system. Influences underwriting acceptance, claims handling, and regulatory reporting obligations.
attributes.references: NAIC SIU Reporting Guidelines; State DOI Fraud Regulations; GLBA

attributes.name: kyc_status
attributes.description: Current KYC verification status of the party as recorded in the Party MDM. Drives underwriting eligibility and compliance holds. Required under GLBA and state DOI market conduct rules.
attributes.references: GLBA; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; FCRA; Customer/Party MDM

attributes.name: loss_ratio_band
attributes.description: Banded historical loss ratio for the party at time of segmentation. Derived from actuarial reserving data. Informs renewal pricing, tier migration, and non-renewal decisions.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP; Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP)

attributes.name: market_segment
attributes.description: Marketing-oriented segment grouping used for campaign targeting and distribution channel alignment. Distinct from underwriting tier; reflects revenue and growth strategy.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Standards; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: mvr_indicator
attributes.description: Summary indicator of the party's MVR result at time of segmentation. Applicable for personal and commercial auto lines. Drives tier assignment and surcharge eligibility.
attributes.references: DPPA (Driver's Privacy Protection Act); NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: naics_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code
attributes.description: NAICS industry classification code for commercial party segments. Used in commercial lines underwriting appetite, SIC/NAICS-based eligibility rules, and actuarial class plan assignment.
attributes.references: US Census Bureau NAICS; ISO Commercial Lines Rating; NAIC Annual Statement

attributes.name: segment_name

attributes.name: party_type_at_assignment

attributes.name: policy_count_band

attributes.name: preferred_program_code

attributes.name: profitability_tier

attributes.name: regulatory_classification

attributes.name: revenue_band

attributes.name: review_date

attributes.name: risk_score

attributes.name: segment_status

attributes.name: segment_type

attributes.name: sic_code

attributes.name: source_system_ref

attributes.name: state_of_domicile

attributes.name: territory_code

attributes.name: tier

attributes.name: tiv_band

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.name: uw_appetite_flag

attributes.name: years_as_customer

products.name: party_document

attributes.name: clue_report_number

attributes.name: party_document_description

attributes.name: effective_date

attributes.name: expiry_date

attributes.name: file_format

attributes.name: issuing_authority

attributes.name: kyc_verification_method

attributes.name: language_code

attributes.name: party_document_status

attributes.name: party_document_type

attributes.name: policy_number
attributes.description: Policy number to which this document is associated, if applicable (e.g., a declarations page or endorsement form). Null for party-level documents not tied to a specific policy.

attributes.name: purge_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date on which the document is eligible for deletion or archival per the retention_category policy. Null for permanent retention documents.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Laws; SOX; GLBA; GDPR Article 17

attributes.name: received_date
attributes.description: Calendar date the document was received by the insurer from the party or source system. Used for SLA tracking and KYC timeliness.

attributes.name: rejection_reason

attributes.name: retention_category
attributes.description: Records retention classification governing how long the document must be kept per regulatory and statutory requirements (e.g., NAIC, state DOI, SOX, GLBA).
attributes.references: NAIC Model Laws; SOX; GLBA; State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: source_system_doc_code
attributes.description: Native document identifier from the originating operational system (e.g., Guidewire PolicyCenter document GUID). Enables lineage tracing back to the system of record.

attributes.name: storage_uri
attributes.description: Fully qualified URI pointing to the document file in the document management or object storage system (e.g., S3 path, SharePoint URL). Confidential due to access control.

attributes.name: submission_number
attributes.description: Underwriting submission number to which this document is associated (e.g., ACORD application submitted for a new risk). Null for documents not tied to a submission.

attributes.name: subtype

attributes.name: tags

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Human-readable name or label for the document (e.g., 'John Smith Passport', 'ACORD 125 Commercial Lines Application'). Used for display and search.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this document record was last modified in the Silver layer. Tracks status changes, verification updates, and version replacements.
attributes.references: SOX; MAR; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: verified_by

attributes.name: verified_date

attributes.name: version_number

products.name: loss_payee
products.description: Loss payee or mortgagee interest attached to a party and a policy or insured risk. One row per interest. Stores interest type (mortgagee, loss payee, additional insured), lender name, loan number, and effective dates.

attributes.name: loss_payee_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each loss payee or mortgagee interest record. One row per interest attachment on a party and policy or insured risk.

attributes.name: coverage_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to coverage.coverage. Business justification: Loss payees (mortgagees, lienholders) are often specific to individual coverages rather than entire policies. Mortgagee on building coverage, lienholder on auto physical damage.

attributes.name: insured_risk_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific Insured Risk (property, vehicle, etc.) to which this loss payee interest is attached. Null when attached at policy level only.

attributes.name: lender_address_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to party.address. Business justification: Loss payee embeds lender address fields that should be normalized to the address table. The address table is the SSOT for all addresses.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Party record representing the lender, mortgagee, or loss payee entity holding the financial interest.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Policy to which this loss payee interest is attached. Null when interest is attached at insured risk level only.

attributes.name: acord_form_type
attributes.description: ACORD standard form type used to evidence this loss payee or mortgagee interest (e.g., ACORD 25 Certificate of Liability, ACORD 28 Evidence of Property Insurance).
attributes.references: ACORD Forms Library; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: cancellation_notice_date
attributes.description: Date on which the cancellation or non-renewal notice was sent to this loss payee or mortgagee. Required for regulatory compliance and audit.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Cancellation Law; State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: cancellation_notice_sent
attributes.description: Indicates whether the required cancellation or non-renewal notice has been sent to this loss payee or mortgagee per the policy terms and state regulations.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Cancellation Law; State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: certificate_issue_date
attributes.description: Date on which the Certificate of Insurance (CoI) was issued to this loss payee or mortgagee. Used for compliance tracking and renewal notifications.

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: Certificate of Insurance (CoI) number issued to this loss payee or mortgagee as evidence of coverage per ACORD 28 or equivalent form.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this loss payee interest record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; GLBA

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to monetary fields on this loss payee record. Defaults to USD for domestic US policies.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this loss payee or mortgagee interest becomes active and enforceable on the policy or insured risk.
attributes.references: ACORD 28; NAIC Model Law; ISO Forms

attributes.name: endorsement_number
attributes.description: Policy endorsement number under which this loss payee or mortgagee interest was added or modified on the policy.

attributes.name: escrow_account_number
attributes.description: Lender escrow account number used to collect and remit insurance premium payments on behalf of the mortgagor. Supports billing integration with lender.
attributes.references: RESPA (Real Estate Settlement Procedures Act); GLBA; Guidewire BillingCenter

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which this loss payee or mortgagee interest expires or is removed. Null indicates the interest remains active through the policy term.

attributes.name: form_number
attributes.description: ISO or proprietary form number of the loss payable or mortgagee endorsement attached to the policy (e.g., ISO CP 12 18, PP 03 03).
attributes.references: ISO Forms Library; ACORD Forms Library; DOI Filing

attributes.name: interest_rank
attributes.description: Ordinal rank of this interest when multiple loss payees or mortgagees exist on the same insured risk (e.g., first mortgagee = 1, second mortgagee = 2).

attributes.name: interest_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the loss payee or mortgagee interest record. Drives whether the interest is honored in claims payment and certificate issuance.

attributes.name: interest_type
attributes.description: Classification of the financial interest held by the party on the policy or insured risk. Drives certificate of insurance (CoI) and claims payment routing.
attributes.references: ACORD 28 (Evidence of Property Insurance); ISO Forms; NAIC Model Law

attributes.name: joint_payee_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether claim payments must be made jointly to both the insured and this loss payee or mortgagee rather than solely to the insured.
