attributes.name: lender_email
attributes.description: Email address of the lender or mortgagee institution used for electronic certificate of insurance delivery and claims payment notifications.

attributes.name: lender_fein
attributes.description: IRS-assigned Federal Employer Identification Number (FEIN) of the lending institution. Required for tax reporting on claim payments and 1099 issuance.

attributes.name: lender_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the lending institution, mortgagee, or lienholder as it must appear on the policy declarations and loss payment instruments.

attributes.name: lender_phone
attributes.description: Primary contact telephone number for the lender or mortgagee institution used for claims notification and certificate of insurance correspondence.

attributes.name: lender_reference_number
attributes.description: Secondary lender-assigned reference or account number (e.g., investor loan number, servicer reference) distinct from the primary loan number.

attributes.name: loan_number
attributes.description: Lender-assigned loan or mortgage account number associated with the insured risk. Used to route claim payments and satisfy lender reporting requirements.

attributes.name: loss_payable_clause_type
attributes.description: Type of loss payable clause attached to the policy for this interest: Standard, Lenders (protects lender independently), Open, or Union mortgage clause.

attributes.name: naic_lender_code

attributes.description: NAIC-assigned code identifying the lender or financial institution for statutory reporting and Schedule F bordereaux purposes.

attributes.description: Free-text underwriter or policy service notes regarding special conditions, lender instructions, or exceptions applicable to this loss payee interest.

attributes.name: notification_days

attributes.name: notification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lender or mortgagee must be notified of policy changes, cancellations, or non-renewals per the loss payable clause or lender agreement.

attributes.name: payment_payable_to
attributes.description: Full legal name(s) as they must appear on claim payment instruments (checks or EFT) issued jointly or solely to this loss payee or mortgagee.

attributes.name: payment_threshold_amount

attributes.name: premium_billed_to_lender
attributes.description: Indicates whether the insurance premium is billed directly to the lender via escrow rather than to the policyholder. Drives billing system routing.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this loss payee interest record originated (e.g., PAS for PolicyCenter, MDM for Party Master).

attributes.name: source_system_ref_code

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

products.name: license

attributes.description: Sequential term number within the policy lifecycle. First term is 1, increments with each renewal.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement, Policy Administration System

attributes.name: payment_plan_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the premium payment plan. Examples: annual, semi-annual, quarterly, monthly.

attributes.name: policy_year
attributes.description: Policy year for actuarial and loss reserving analysis. Derived from term effective date.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Schedule P, Actuarial Reserving System

attributes.name: rate_effective_date
attributes.description: Effective date of the rate table used to price this term. Required for regulatory rate filings.
attributes.references: Rating Engine, State DOI Rate Filings

attributes.name: rate_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the rating algorithm used to price this term. Enables rate change analysis.

attributes.name: reinstatement_date
attributes.description: Date when a cancelled term was reinstated. Null if term was never reinstated.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement, Policy Administration System

attributes.name: renewal_accepted_date
attributes.description: Date when the insured accepted the renewal offer. Null if renewal was not accepted.

attributes.name: renewal_offer_date
attributes.description: Date when renewal offer was extended to the insured. Used for renewal cycle tracking.
attributes.references: Policy Administration System, NAIC Model Laws

attributes.name: renewal_type
attributes.description: Classification of the renewal process. Indicates whether renewal was automatic, manual, or conditional.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Laws, Policy Administration System

attributes.name: term_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the policy term. Indicates whether the term is active, expired, or cancelled.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement, Policy Administration System

attributes.name: underwriting_company_code
attributes.description: NAIC company code of the insurer underwriting this term. Used for statutory reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement, NAIC Company Database

attributes.name: underwriting_company_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the insurance company underwriting this term.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement, NAIC Company Database

attributes.name: written_premium_amount
attributes.description: Total written premium for this term. Represents the full premium charged for the term period.

products.name: policy_transaction
products.description: Lifecycle event applied to a policy term. One row per transaction. Type (NB, REN, END, CAN, RI, NR) with type-specific attributes: effective/processed date, reason code, premium impact, cancellation basis and return-premium method, reinstatement lapse

attributes.name: policy_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the policy transaction. Primary key. One row per transaction event applied to a policy term.

attributes.name: claimfinancials_accounting_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to claimfinancials.accounting_period. Business justification: Every policy transaction (new business, endorsement, cancellation, reinstatement) must be booked to an accounting period for written/earned premium accounting, statutory

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: Transactions record premium changes in transaction currency—FK to currency master enables FX translation for accounting entries, multi-currency GL posting, and audit trails.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the underwriter who approved or processed this transaction. Links to party role for audit and workflow tracking.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent policy contract. Links this transaction to the overarching policy lifecycle.

attributes.name: policy_term_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific policy term period affected by this transaction.

attributes.name: primary_prior_transaction_policy_transaction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the immediately preceding transaction in the policy lifecycle. Enables transaction chain reconstruction.

attributes.name: producers_producer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the producer or agent of record at the time of this transaction. Used for commission calculation and distribution tracking.

attributes.name: accounting_date
attributes.description: Date when the transaction is recognized for accounting and statutory reporting purposes. May differ from effective and processed dates.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP, GAAP, IFRS 17, NAIC Annual Statement

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the transaction was approved. Distinct from processed and effective timestamps.

attributes.name: cancellation_basis
attributes.description: Legal or business basis for cancellation. Determines regulatory notice requirements and return premium method. Null for non-cancellation transactions.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Laws, State DOI Cancellation Regulations

attributes.name: cancellation_type_code
attributes.description: Method used to calculate return premium for cancellations: flat (no return), short_rate (penalty), pro_rata (proportional). Null for non-cancellation transactions.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Laws, State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: commission_impact_amount
attributes.description: Net change in producer commission resulting from this transaction. Used for commission settlement and payables.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this transaction record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record lifecycle.

attributes.name: document_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference to the generated policy document, declarations page, or endorsement form associated with this transaction.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the transaction becomes effective and changes take effect on the policy. Critical for loss date reconstruction.

attributes.name: endorsement_description
attributes.description: Business description of the endorsement changes. Summarizes coverage, limit, or risk modifications. Null for non-endorsement transactions.

attributes.name: endorsement_form_number
attributes.description: ISO or proprietary form number attached to this endorsement transaction. Null for non-endorsement transactions.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the transaction or its effects expire. Applicable for term-bounded endorsements or temporary changes.

attributes.name: is_backdated_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the effective date is prior to the processed date. Used for audit and compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Laws, State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: is_midterm_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transaction occurred mid-term (between policy inception and expiration). True for endorsements, cancellations, reinstatements.

attributes.name: is_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transaction represents a policy renewal. True for REN transaction type, false otherwise.

attributes.name: issued_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the transaction was issued and documents were generated. Marks final commitment.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this transaction record was last updated. Audit trail for record lifecycle.

attributes.name: policy_year
attributes.description: Policy year in which this transaction occurred. Used for loss ratio analysis and actuarial reserving by policy year cohort.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Schedule P, Actuarial Standards

attributes.name: processed_date
attributes.description: Date when the transaction was processed and recorded in the system. May differ from effective date.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the business reason for the transaction. Type-specific: endorsement reason, cancellation cause, reinstatement justification.
attributes.references: ISO Reason Code Tables, NAIC Standards

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative explanation of why the transaction was initiated. Supplements the reason code with context.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_date
attributes.description: Date when regulatory filing was submitted. Null if no filing required or not yet filed.
attributes.references: State DOI Regulations, NAIC Model Laws

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transaction requires filing with state Department of Insurance or other regulatory body.
attributes.references: State DOI Regulations, NAIC Model Laws

attributes.name: reinstatement_lapse_days
attributes.description: Number of days the policy was lapsed before reinstatement. Used for underwriting and pricing adjustments. Null for non-reinstatement transactions.

attributes.name: reinsurance_cession_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transaction triggers reinsurance cession under treaty or facultative agreements.
attributes.references: Reinsurance Agreement Standards, NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: requires_underwriting_review_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transaction triggered underwriting referral or manual review based on risk appetite rules.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the originating system for this transaction. Supports multi-system integration and data lineage.

attributes.name: source_transaction_id
attributes.description: Original transaction identifier from the source system. Enables traceability back to operational system of record.

attributes.name: transaction_number
attributes.description: Business-facing transaction number displayed on declarations pages and endorsements. Externally visible identifier.

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the transaction. Tracks progression from draft through issuance or reversal.

attributes.name: type_code
attributes.description: Type of policy transaction: NB (New Business), REN (Renewal), END (Endorsement), CAN (Cancellation), RI (Reinstatement), NR (Non-renewal).

attributes.name: voided_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating why the transaction was voided. Null for active transactions.

attributes.name: voided_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the transaction was voided or reversed. Null for active transactions.

attributes.name: written_premium_change_amount
attributes.description: Net change in written premium resulting from this transaction. Positive for increases, negative for returns. Used for premium accounting and statutory reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Schedule P, SAP/SSAP, IFRS 17

products.name: policyholder
products.description: Association between a policy and the party acting as named insured/policyholder. One row per policyholder per policy. Carries role type, effective/expiration dates, and primary-insured flag.

attributes.name: policyholder_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the policyholder data product (auto-inserted during validation).

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party acting as policyholder or named insured on this policy.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the policy contract to which this policyholder is associated.

attributes.name: policy_term_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to policy.term. Business justification: Policyholders can change by term (named insured changes on renewal, ownership transfers). The effective_date and expiration_date attributes on policyholder indicate term-level tracking is needed.

attributes.name: policyholder_policy_transaction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the policy transaction that added this policyholder to the policy.

attributes.name: policyholder_removed_by_transaction_policy_transaction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the policy transaction that removed this policyholder from the policy. Null if still active.

attributes.name: role_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific party role record capturing the policyholder relationship with effective dates.

attributes.name: additional_insured_endorsement_code
attributes.description: ISO or carrier-specific endorsement form code granting additional insured status to this party.

attributes.name: billing_responsibility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this policyholder is responsible for premium payment. True if responsible, false otherwise.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason this policyholder association was cancelled or removed from the policy.

attributes.name: certificate_holder_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this party should receive a Certificate of Insurance. True if certificate holder, false otherwise.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this policyholder record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this policyholder association becomes active and binding on the policy contract.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this policyholder association ends. Null for open-ended associations.

attributes.name: holder_sequence
attributes.description: Ordinal position of this policyholder within the policy, used for display and reporting order.

attributes.name: holder_type
attributes.description: Classification of the policyholder role on the policy contract.

attributes.name: interest_type
attributes.description: Nature of the insurable interest this party holds in the covered risk or property. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Owner|Lessee|Mortgagee|Lienholder|Bailee|Trustee|Other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: is_primary_insured
attributes.description: Indicates whether this party is the primary named insured on the policy. True if primary, false otherwise.

attributes.name: loan_number
attributes.description: Loan or mortgage account number associated with this policyholder when acting as mortgagee or lienholder.

attributes.name: loss_payable_clause_type
attributes.description: Type of loss payable clause governing payment priority and rights for this policyholder.
attributes.value_regex: Standard Mortgagee|Loss Payee|Lender Loss Payee|Contract of Sale|None

attributes.name: mailing_address_same_as_primary_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Mailing Address Same as Primary Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this policyholder uses the same mailing address as the primary insured. True if same, false otherwise.

tag_set.value: Mailing Address Same as Primary Flag

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this policyholder record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: notice_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this party must receive policy notices such as cancellation or non-renewal. True if required, false otherwise.

attributes.name: ownership_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of ownership or interest this policyholder has in the insured risk. Null if not applicable.

attributes.name: policyholder_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this policyholder association on the policy contract.

attributes.name: rank_order
attributes.description: Priority ranking for loss payment when multiple loss payees or mortgagees exist. Lower numbers indicate higher priority.

attributes.name: relationship_to_primary
attributes.description: Nature of the relationship between this policyholder and the primary named insured. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Spouse|Domestic Partner|Child|Parent|Sibling|Business Partner|Landlord|Tenant|Contractor|Vendor|Other — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-form notes or special instructions related to this policyholder association.

attributes.name: waiver_of_subrogation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the insurer has waived subrogation rights against this party. True if waived, false otherwise.

products.name: policy_interest
products.description: Additional interests on a policy (additional insured, loss payee, mortgagee, lienholder). One row per interest per policy term. Captures interest type, party reference, certificate number, effective dates, and notification requirements per ISO/ACORD

attributes.name: policy_interest_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the additional interest record. Primary key.

attributes.name: building_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to riskexposure.building. Business justification: Commercial property mortgagees and loss payees attach at building-level granularity for multi-building locations.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party who holds this interest on the policy.

attributes.name: policy_term_id
attributes.description: Reference to the policy term to which this interest is attached.

attributes.name: primary_policy_transaction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the policy transaction that added this interest to the policy term.

attributes.name: property_risk_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to riskexposure.property_risk. Business justification: Mortgagees, loss payees, and additional insureds attach to specific commercial properties for loss payment routing, subrogation waiver, and certificate issuance.

attributes.name: vehicle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to riskexposure.vehicle. Business justification: Lienholders and lessors attach to specific financed or leased vehicles for loss payee endorsements and total loss settlement.

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address of the interest holder for certificate mailing and notification purposes.

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for suite, unit, or building information.

attributes.name: blanket_additional_insured_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the interest is covered under a blanket additional insured endorsement.

attributes.name: certificate_issue_date
attributes.description: Date the certificate of insurance was issued to the interest holder.

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: Certificate number issued to the interest holder as evidence of coverage.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City of the interest holder's mailing address.

attributes.name: contact_email
attributes.description: Email address for the interest holder contact for certificate delivery and notifications.

attributes.name: contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary contact person at the interest holder organization for policy and certificate matters.

attributes.name: contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary phone number for the interest holder contact.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the interest holder's address.

attributes.name: coverage_scope
attributes.description: Description of the scope of coverage provided to the interest holder, including any limitations or conditions.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this interest record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the interest becomes effective on the policy term.

attributes.name: endorsement_form_number
attributes.description: ISO or carrier-specific form number of the endorsement that adds this interest to the policy.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the interest expires or is removed from the policy term. Nullable for open-ended interests.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this interest record was last updated.

attributes.name: loan_number
attributes.description: Loan or mortgage account number associated with the interest, typically for mortgagees or lienholders.

attributes.name: policy_interest_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the party holding the interest as it appears on the policy or certificate.

attributes.name: notification_days
attributes.description: Number of days advance notice required for policy changes or cancellations, typically 10, 30, or 60 days.

attributes.name: notification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the interest holder must be notified of policy changes, cancellations, or non-renewals.

attributes.name: policy_interest_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the interest on the policy.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the interest holder's mailing address.

attributes.name: primary_noncontributory_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether coverage is primary and non-contributory with respect to the interest holder's own insurance.

attributes.name: rank_order
attributes.description: Priority ranking of the interest for loss payment purposes. Lower numbers indicate higher priority.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-form notes or special instructions related to the interest holder, coverage requirements, or certificate issuance.

attributes.name: state_province_code
attributes.description: Two-letter state or province code for the interest holder's address.

attributes.name: type_code
attributes.description: Type of interest: Additional Insured (AI), Loss Payee (LP), Mortgagee (MORT), Lienholder (LIEN), Lessor, Trustee.

attributes.name: waiver_of_subrogation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the insurer has waived subrogation rights against the interest holder.

products.name: policy_form

attributes.name: policy_form_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the policy form attachment record. Primary key.

attributes.name: policy_document_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical or digital document storage location for the form PDF or image.

attributes.name: policy_term_id
attributes.description: Reference to the policy term to which this form is attached.

attributes.name: acord_form_flag

attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a standard ACORD form (true) or not (false).

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date the form was approved by the state Department of Insurance for use.

attributes.name: attachment_reason_code
attributes.description: Coded reason for attaching this form: regulatory requirement, risk mitigation, customer request, underwriting referral, rate modification, or coverage enhancement.

attributes.name: attachment_sequence
attributes.description: The order in which this form is attached to the policy term, used for precedence and document assembly.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time this form attachment record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: edition_date
attributes.description: The edition date of the form as published by ISO or the carrier, indicating the version in use.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date this form attachment becomes effective on the policy term.

attributes.name: expiration_date

attributes.name: filing_number
attributes.description: The state Department of Insurance filing number or SERFF tracking number for this form.

attributes.name: form_category
attributes.description: High-level category of the form indicating the major coverage area it addresses. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: coverage|liability|property|auto|workers_comp|umbrella|inland_marine|crime|professional_liability — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: form_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the coverage, exclusion, or condition provided by this form.

attributes.name: form_name
attributes.description: The full descriptive name of the form (e.g., Homeowners 3 Special Form, Commercial General Liability Coverage Form).

attributes.name: form_number

attributes.name: form_status

attributes.name: form_type

attributes.name: language

attributes.name: lob_code
attributes.description: The line of business code this form applies to (e.g., HO, PAP, CGL, CA, WC).

attributes.name: mandatory_flag

attributes.name: modified_timestamp

attributes.name: premium_amount

products.name: line

attributes.name: line_id

attributes.name: classification_code_id

attributes.description: Indicates whether the shared limit applies before or after deductibles are satisfied.

attributes.name: coverage_scope
attributes.description: Defines the scope of coverages included within the shared limit group boundary.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the shared limit group record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the shared limit group definition becomes effective for policy binding and coverage attachment.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the shared limit group definition expires and is no longer available for new policy terms.

attributes.name: group_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the shared limit group used in policy documents and underwriting systems.

attributes.name: group_description
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of the shared limit group purpose, scope, and coverage aggregation rules.

attributes.name: group_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the shared limit group for business user identification and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: group_type
attributes.description: Classification of how the shared limit is applied across coverages within the group.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the shared limit group record was most recently updated.

attributes.name: limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum aggregate limit amount shared across all coverages within this group.

attributes.name: limit_basis
attributes.description: Basis on which the shared limit is calculated and applied across the policy term.

attributes.name: limit_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the shared limit amount.

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: Insurance line of business to which this shared limit group applies.

attributes.name: maximum_reinstatements
attributes.description: Maximum number of times the shared limit can be reinstated within a single policy term.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional underwriting notes, special instructions, or business context for the shared limit group configuration.

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this shared limit group structure requires state insurance department approval before use.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_number
attributes.description: State insurance department filing reference number for the approved shared limit group structure.

attributes.name: reinstatement_premium_rate
attributes.description: Premium rate charged as a percentage of the original limit when the shared limit is reinstated.

attributes.name: reinstatement_provision_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shared limit can be reinstated after partial or full exhaustion during the policy term.

attributes.name: shared_limit_group_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the shared limit group in the underwriting and policy administration system.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of the shared limit group definition to track changes and maintain historical configurations.

products.name: rating_rule_set
products.description: Master reference table for rating_rule_set. Referenced by rating_rule_set_id.

attributes.name: rating_rule_set_id
attributes.description: Primary key for rating_rule_set

attributes.name: parent_rule_set_id
attributes.description: Reference to a parent rating rule set when this rule set is a specialized or derived version, enabling hierarchical rule set structures.

attributes.name: actuarial_basis
attributes.description: Description of the actuarial data, loss experience, and statistical methods underlying the development of this rating rule set.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the regulatory authority approved this rating rule set for use.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current regulatory and internal approval state of the rating rule set within its lifecycle.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the regulatory authority or internal approver who authorized this rating rule set.

attributes.name: calculation_formula
attributes.description: Proprietary formula or expression defining how this rating rule set computes its output, stored as text or reference to formula library.

attributes.name: catastrophe_load_percentage
attributes.description: Additional premium percentage loaded into rates to cover expected catastrophe losses for the jurisdiction and line of business.

attributes.name: coverage_type
attributes.description: Specific coverage type within the line of business that this rating rule set applies to, such as liability, collision, or comprehensive.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system process that created this rating rule set record.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this rating rule set record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: credibility_factor
attributes.description: Statistical weight assigned to this rating rule set based on the volume and reliability of underlying loss data.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this rating rule set becomes active and available for use in premium calculations.

attributes.name: expense_provision_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of premium allocated to cover underwriting expenses, commissions, and overhead within this rating rule set.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which this rating rule set ceases to be valid for new business, nullable for open-ended rule sets.

attributes.name: filing_date
attributes.description: Date on which this rating rule set was submitted to the regulatory authority for approval.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rating rule set is currently active and available for use in premium calculations.

attributes.name: is_default
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rating rule set is the default choice for its line of business and jurisdiction when no specific rule set is selected.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Two-letter state or province code indicating the regulatory jurisdiction where this rating rule set is approved for use.

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: Insurance line of business to which this rating rule set applies, defining the product scope.

attributes.name: loss_cost_multiplier
attributes.description: Factor applied to advisory loss costs to derive final premium rates, incorporating expenses, profit, and contingencies.

attributes.name: loss_ratio_target
attributes.description: Target loss ratio that this rating rule set is designed to achieve, expressed as a decimal proportion of premium to losses.

attributes.name: maximum_premium_amount
attributes.description: Ceiling premium amount enforced by this rating rule set, capping exposure on high-risk policies.

attributes.name: minimum_premium_amount
attributes.description: Floor premium amount enforced by this rating rule set, ensuring minimum revenue per policy.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, implementation guidance, or special instructions related to this rating rule set.

attributes.name: priority_order
attributes.description: Numeric sequence defining the order in which this rating rule set is applied when multiple rule sets are chained in a rating workflow.

attributes.name: profit_margin_percentage
attributes.description: Target profit margin built into the premium rates calculated by this rating rule set, expressed as a percentage.

attributes.name: rating_algorithm
attributes.description: Mathematical approach used by this rule set to calculate premium factors or rates.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_number
attributes.description: Official filing reference number assigned by the state insurance department for this rating rule set approval.

attributes.name: rounding_rule
attributes.description: Method for rounding calculated premium amounts to the nearest cent or dollar as specified by this rule set.

attributes.name: rule_set_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the rating rule set, used for external reference and integration.

attributes.name: rule_set_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the rating rule set, including its business logic, application scope, and calculation methodology.

attributes.name: rule_set_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the rating rule set describing its purpose and scope.

attributes.name: rule_set_type
attributes.description: Classification of the rating rule set by its functional purpose in the premium calculation workflow.

attributes.name: trend_factor
attributes.description: Adjustment factor applied to historical loss data to project future loss costs, accounting for inflation and claim severity trends.

attributes.name: updated_by_user
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system process that last modified this rating rule set record.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this rating rule set record was last modified.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Semantic version identifier for this rating rule set, tracking revisions and updates over time.

domains.name: premium
domains.description: Transactional ledger for all premium activity. Owns Premium Transaction (one row per financial transaction: Written, Earned, Unearned, Return) tied to Policy, Policy Term, Coverage, Insured Risk, and Accounting Period, with Charge, Tax, Fee, and
domains.references: NAIC SAP Premium Accounting / ACORD Premium Model

products.name: premium_transaction
products.description: Premium Transaction: A financial transaction recording premium movements (Written, Earned, Unearned, Return). GRAIN: One row per financial transaction. Grain: one row per financial transaction.
products.reference: ACORD Premium Transaction / SAP Written Premium Ledger

attributes.name: premium_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each premium financial movement record. Grain: one row per financial premium movement (Written, Earned, Unearned, Return). Primary key.

attributes.name: calendar_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.calendar. Business justification: Premium transactions posted to accounting periods require calendar dimensions for fiscal/accident/policy year reporting.

attributes.name: cat_model_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophegeography.cat_model_version. Business justification: Premium transactions link to catastrophe model versions for pricing validation, rate adequacy monitoring, actuarial review of catastrophe loads, and regulatory filing

attributes.name: cat_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophegeography.cat_zone. Business justification: Premium transactions require catastrophe zone assignment for exposure aggregation, PML calculations, concentration monitoring, and rate adequacy analysis.

attributes.name: catastrophe_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophegeography.catastrophe_event. Business justification: Premium transactions must track catastrophe event attribution for loss ratio analysis, reinsurance bordereaux reporting, regulatory Schedule P filings, and post-event

attributes.name: catastrophegeography_peril_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophegeography.peril. Business justification: Premium transactions must identify covered peril for statutory line-of-business reporting, reinsurance treaty allocation, actuarial loss triangles, and Schedule P development.

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to claims.claim. Business justification: Retrospectively-rated policies (workers comp, general liability) adjust premium based on actual claim experience during the policy term.

attributes.name: claimfinancials_accounting_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the accounting period in which this premium transaction is recognized for statutory and GAAP reporting purposes.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP, US GAAP, IFRS 17, NAIC Annual Statement

attributes.name: coverage_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific coverage line within the policy term to which this premium transaction is allocated. Enables per-coverage premium analytics.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: Premium transactions record amounts in specific currencies. Multi-currency operations require proper FK for FX validation, conversion, and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: geography_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophegeography.geography. Business justification: Premium transactions require geographic attribution for statutory state pages, territorial profitability analysis, regulatory reporting, and geographic concentration

attributes.name: insured_risk_id
attributes.description: Reference to the insured risk or exposure unit (property, vehicle, driver) to which this premium transaction is allocated.

attributes.name: line_of_business_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.line_of_business. Business justification: Normalize lob_code string to FK reference to shared.line_of_business master data. Premium transaction currently stores lob_code as string; replacing with FK enables consistent LOB

attributes.name: original_transaction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original premium transaction that this record reverses or corrects. Populated only when reversal_indicator is True. Supports audit trail.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the policy under which this premium transaction was generated. Links the premium ledger entry to the master policy record.

attributes.name: policy_term_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific policy term (time-bounded period) to which this premium transaction belongs. Enables reconstruction of premium in force at any date.

attributes.name: policy_transaction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the policy transaction (New Business, Renewal, Endorsement, Cancellation, Reinstatement) that triggered this premium movement.

attributes.name: producers_producer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the producer (agent or broker) associated with this premium transaction for commission settlement and distribution channel reporting.

attributes.name: quote_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to coverage.quote. Business justification: Premium transactions originate from bound quotes; accounting audit trail requires quote reference for rate reconciliation, variance analysis between quoted and booked premium, and

attributes.name: rating_worksheet_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to coverage.rating_worksheet. Business justification: Premium transactions reference rating worksheets for rate reconciliation, audit defense of filed rates, and regulatory compliance verification.

attributes.name: submission_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to coverage.submission. Business justification: Premium transactions trace to originating submission for source-of-business reporting, producer commission attribution by submission channel, and new-business vs renewal premium

attributes.name: unit_of_measure_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.unit_of_measure. Business justification: Premium transactions record exposure amounts measured in units (vehicles, payroll, sales).

attributes.name: audit_basis
attributes.description: Exposure basis used for auditable policies (e.g., WC, CGL) to determine final earned premium: Payroll, Revenue, Units, Receipts, or None for non-auditable policies.

attributes.name: ceded_written_premium
attributes.description: Portion of gross written premium ceded to reinsurers under treaty or facultative agreements. Used for Schedule F and reinsurance bordereaux reporting.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 62, NAIC Schedule F, IFRS 17

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Internal cost center or profit center code to which this premium transaction is allocated for management accounting and segment reporting purposes.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this premium transaction record was first created in the source system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: days_in_force
attributes.description: Number of days the coverage was in force during the accounting period for this premium transaction. Used in pro-rata earning and exposure calculations.

attributes.name: direct_billed_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this premium is billed directly to the policyholder (True) or through the producer/agency (False = agency billed). Drives billing workflow routing.

attributes.name: earned_premium
attributes.description: Portion of written premium recognized as earned for the accounting period based on pro-rata or other earning methodology. Core input to loss ratio (LR) calculation.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 53, NAIC Annual Statement Schedule P, IFRS 17

attributes.name: earning_method
attributes.description: Method used to recognize written premium as earned over the policy period: Pro-Rata (daily), 1/365, 1/24 (monthly), Flat (fully earned at inception), or Other.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this premium transaction takes effect for coverage and financial recognition purposes. Used to reconstruct premium in force at any given date.

attributes.name: endorsement_type
attributes.description: Type of endorsement premium adjustment: Additional (increase), Return (decrease/credit), Flat (no change), Audit (audit-based adjustment), or None for non-endorsement transactions.
attributes.references: Guidewire PolicyCenter, Duck Creek Policy, ACORD

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the premium coverage period ends for this transaction. Used for unearned premium (UEP) calculation and pro-rata earning.

attributes.name: exposure_amount
attributes.description: Quantitative exposure measure (e.g., payroll dollars, vehicle count, property TIV) underlying the premium calculation. Used for rate adequacy and actuarial analysis.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code to which this premium transaction is posted in the statutory and GAAP accounting systems. Required for financial close and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: Oracle/SAP GL, SAP/SSAP, SOX, US GAAP

attributes.name: gross_written_premium
attributes.description: Total gross written premium amount for this transaction before cessions, taxes, fees, and commissions. Core ledger amount for statutory and GAAP reporting.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 53, NAIC Annual Statement Schedule P, IFRS 17

attributes.name: net_written_premium
attributes.description: Written premium net of reinsurance cessions. NWP = GWP minus ceded written premium. Used for net retention reporting and RBC calculations.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 53, NAIC Annual Statement, RBC

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments entered by underwriters, billing staff, or system processes to explain the reason for or context of this premium transaction.

attributes.name: payment_plan_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the installment or payment plan under which this premium is billed (e.g., Annual, Semi-Annual, Quarterly, Monthly, Pay-As-You-Go).

attributes.name: posted_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this premium transaction was posted to the general ledger and accounting system. Distinct from the business event date.

attributes.name: pro_rata_factor
attributes.description: Decimal factor (0.0 to 1.0) representing the proportion of the policy period elapsed as of the accounting period end date. Used to compute earned premium.

attributes.name: rate
attributes.description: The rate applied to the exposure base to calculate the premium for this transaction. Expressed per unit of exposure (e.g., per $100 payroll, per $1000 TIV).
attributes.references: ISO ERC, Earnix, State DOI rate filings

attributes.name: rate_effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the rate used for this premium transaction became effective. Required for rate adequacy monitoring and DOI rate filing compliance.
attributes.references: State DOI, ISO ERC, NAIC Model Laws

attributes.name: return_premium
attributes.description: Premium amount returned to the policyholder due to cancellation, mid-term endorsement reduction, or audit adjustment. Negative financial movement in the ledger.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this premium transaction is a reversal of a previously posted transaction. True = reversal entry; False = original entry.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record that originated this premium transaction (e.g., PAS for PolicyCenter, BILLING for BillingCenter, RATING for rating engine).
attributes.references: Guidewire PolicyCenter, Duck Creek Policy, Internal Data Governance

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code where the risk is located or the policy is written. Required for state-level statutory reporting and DOI filings.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement, State DOI, ISO

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: The business event date on which this premium movement was generated or triggered (e.g., policy effective date, endorsement effective date, cancellation date).

attributes.name: transaction_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable identifier for this premium transaction as assigned by the Policy Administration System or billing system. Used in bordereaux and reconciliation.
attributes.references: ACORD, Guidewire PolicyCenter, Duck Creek Policy

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the premium transaction in the accounting ledger: Pending (awaiting posting), Posted (booked to GL), Reversed, Voided, or Error.

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Classification of the premium financial movement: Written (new/renewed/endorsed), Earned (pro-rata recognition), Unearned (UEP reserve), Return (cancellation/endorsement credit), or Adjustment.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 53, NAIC Annual Statement, IFRS 17

attributes.name: unearned_premium
attributes.description: Portion of written premium not yet earned as of the accounting period end date. Represents the UEP reserve liability on the balance sheet.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 53, NAIC Annual Statement, IFRS 17

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this premium transaction record was last modified. Supports audit trail, change detection, and incremental data loading.

attributes.name: coverage_transaction_id
attributes.description: Reference to coverage.coverage_transaction.coverage_transaction_id.

products.name: premium_accounting_period
products.description: Reference calendar period (month, quarter, year) used to bucket premium, loss, and expense transactions for statutory and GAAP reporting. Supports CY, AY, and PY views required by Schedule P and IFRS 17.
products.reference: NAIC Accounting Period / IFRS 17 Coverage Period

attributes.name: premium_accounting_period_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the accounting period record. Role: REFERENCE_LOOKUP — this is a calendar reference table; canonical minimums for transactional roles do not apply.

attributes.name: prior_period_premium_accounting_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the immediately preceding accounting period of the same type. Supports period-over-period comparisons and loss development triangle chaining.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P, ASOP No. 43, SAP SSAP No. 55

attributes.name: accident_year_ay
attributes.description: Accident Year (AY) associated with this period for loss development and IBNR reserving. Losses are assigned to the AY in which the loss event occurred.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P, Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP) No. 43

attributes.name: actuarial_reserve_cutoff_date
attributes.description: Date through which loss and IBNR reserve data is included in the actuarial reserve study for this period. Aligns with the loss triangle evaluation date.
attributes.references: ASOP No. 43, NAIC Schedule P, SAP SSAP No. 55

attributes.name: bordereaux_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the reinsurance premium and loss bordereaux for this period must be submitted to reinsurers, per treaty and facultative agreement terms.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F, Reinsurance Management System (SICS/Sapiens ReinsurancePro), SAP SSAP No. 62

attributes.name: calendar_year_cy
attributes.description: Calendar Year (CY) in which this period falls. Used for CY loss ratio, CY written premium, and Schedule P CY diagonal reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P, SAP SSAP No. 55, GAAP ASC 944-40

attributes.name: close_date
attributes.description: Date on which the accounting period was officially closed for premium, loss, and expense transaction posting. Null if the period has not yet been closed.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 55, SOX Section 302, NAIC Annual Statement Instructions

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for premium and financial transactions posted in this period, e.g., USD. Supports multi-currency statutory reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217, NAIC Annual Statement, IFRS 17, SAP SSAP No. 23

attributes.name: days_in_period
attributes.description: Total number of calendar days in this accounting period. Used as the denominator in pro-rata Earned Premium (EP) and Unearned Premium (UEP) calculations.

attributes.name: earned_premium_basis
attributes.description: Method used to calculate Earned Premium (EP) within this period: PRO_RATA (proportional to days), DAILY (day-by-day), or MONTHLY (full-month convention).
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 55, GAAP ASC 944-605, NAIC Annual Statement Instructions

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Last calendar date of the accounting period (inclusive). Defines the upper bound for bucketing premium, loss, and expense transactions into this period.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement, IFRS 17 paragraph 22, SAP SSAP No. 55

attributes.name: filing_status
attributes.description: Status of the statutory filing associated with this period: NOT_FILED, FILED, ACCEPTED, REJECTED, or AMENDED. Tracks compliance with NAIC and State DOI submission requirements.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions, State DOI, NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: fiscal_month
attributes.description: Month number (1–12) within the fiscal year. Null for QUARTERLY or ANNUAL period types. Used for monthly premium booking and earned premium calculations.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement, SAP SSAP No. 55

attributes.name: fiscal_quarter
attributes.description: Quarter number (1–4) within the fiscal year. Null for MONTHLY or ANNUAL period types. Used for quarterly statutory and GAAP reporting.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Four-digit fiscal year to which this period belongs, e.g., 2024. Aligns with the statutory reporting year for NAIC Annual Statement filing.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement, SAP SSAP No. 55, SOX Section 302

attributes.name: gl_period_code
attributes.description: Corresponding period code in the General Ledger (GL) system (Oracle/SAP), used to reconcile premium transactions to the statutory and GAAP trial balance.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 55, GAAP ASC 944, SOX Section 404, Oracle/SAP GL module

attributes.name: is_current_period
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the currently active accounting period for premium transaction posting. True for exactly one OPEN period at any given time.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 55, NAIC Annual Statement Instructions

attributes.name: is_ifrs17_reporting_period
attributes.description: Indicates whether this period is used for IFRS 17 Insurance Contracts reporting, including Contractual Service Margin (CSM) and Loss Component calculations.

attributes.name: is_statutory_filing_period
attributes.description: Indicates whether this period corresponds to a statutory filing deadline (quarterly or annual NAIC statement). Drives automated Schedule P and Schedule F generation.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions, SAP SSAP No. 55, State DOI filing requirements

attributes.name: lock_date
attributes.description: Date on which the period was hard-locked, preventing any further journal entries or premium transaction postings. Null if not yet locked.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 55, SOX Section 302, Model Audit Rule (MAR)

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or commentary about this accounting period, such as restatement explanations, special adjustments, or regulatory correspondence references.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302, Model Audit Rule (MAR), NAIC Annual Statement Instructions

attributes.name: parent_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent period in the hierarchy, e.g., a monthly period's parent is its quarter, a quarterly period's parent is its annual period.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement, SAP SSAP No. 55, GAAP ASC 270

attributes.name: period_code
attributes.description: Business-facing unique code identifying the period, e.g., 2024-01 for January 2024, 2024-Q1 for first quarter, or 2024-ANNUAL for full year.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement, SAP SSAP No. 55, GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: period_name
attributes.description: Human-readable label for the period, e.g., 'January 2024', 'Q1 2024', or 'Full Year 2024', used in reports and dashboards.

attributes.name: period_status
attributes.description: Current state of the period in the financial close cycle: OPEN (transactions may post), CLOSED (soft close), LOCKED (hard close, no further postings), REOPENED (unlocked for adjustment).
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 55, SOX Section 302, NAIC Annual Statement Instructions

attributes.name: period_type
attributes.description: Granularity of the period: MONTHLY for a single calendar month, QUARTERLY for a three-month quarter, ANNUAL for a full calendar year.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement, SAP SSAP No. 55, IFRS 17 paragraph 22

attributes.name: policy_year_py
attributes.description: Policy Year (PY) associated with this period. Groups premium and losses by the year in which the policy was written, used for PY loss development triangles.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P, ASOP No. 43, SAP SSAP No. 55

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_deadline
attributes.description: Statutory deadline by which the NAIC Annual or Quarterly Statement covering this period must be filed with the applicable State Department of Insurance (DOI).
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions, State DOI filing requirements, SAP SSAP No. 55

attributes.name: reopen_date
attributes.description: Date on which a previously closed or locked period was reopened for corrective adjustments. Null if the period has never been reopened.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 55, SOX Section 302, Model Audit Rule (MAR)

attributes.name: reopen_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for why a closed or locked period was reopened, e.g., audit adjustment, restatement, or regulatory correction. Null if never reopened.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302, Model Audit Rule (MAR), NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: reporting_basis
attributes.description: Accounting basis under which this period is used: SAP (Statutory Accounting Principles), GAAP (US Generally Accepted Accounting Principles), or IFRS17 (IFRS 17 Insurance Contracts).
attributes.references: NAIC SAP SSAP No. 55, GAAP ASC 944, IFRS 17, SOX Section 302

attributes.name: schedule_p_year_type
attributes.description: Designates which Schedule P year-type view this period supports: CY (Calendar Year), AY (Accident Year), or PY (Policy Year), per NAIC Annual Statement Part 2 requirements.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P, SAP SSAP No. 55, NAIC Annual Statement Instructions

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: First calendar date of the accounting period (inclusive). Defines the lower bound for bucketing premium, loss, and expense transactions into this period.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement, IFRS 17 paragraph 22, SAP SSAP No. 55

products.name: charge
products.description: Child of Premium Transaction. One row per charge component (base premium, surcharge, credit, minimum premium) within a transaction. Enables granular decomposition of gross written premium by rating element and LOB.
products.reference: ISO Rating Element / Guidewire PolicyCenter Charge

attributes.name: charge_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the charge component within a premium transaction.

attributes.name: calendar_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.calendar. Business justification: Charges posted to accounting periods. FK enables period-based charge analysis, fiscal year reporting, and ensures charges align with calendar dimensions for financial statements.

attributes.name: catastrophe_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophegeography.catastrophe_event. Business justification: Individual rating charges (wind surcharges, earthquake deductible buybacks) are event-specific for post-catastrophe pricing adjustments, experience rating, and

attributes.name: catastrophegeography_peril_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophegeography.peril. Business justification: Individual charges (earthquake coverage, flood buyback, wind deductible) are peril-specific for pricing transparency, regulatory compliance, coverage verification, and claims

attributes.name: claimfinancials_accounting_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the accounting period in which this charge is recognized.

attributes.name: coverage_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the coverage to which this charge applies, if coverage-specific.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: Charges have amounts denominated in currency. FK enables currency validation, FX conversion for consolidated reporting, and ensures charge amounts reference valid active currencies for

attributes.name: geography_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophegeography.geography. Business justification: Individual charges require geographic assignment for tax calculation, surplus lines allocation, territorial rating factors, and jurisdictional compliance.

attributes.name: insured_risk_id

products.name: account

attributes.description: Reference to the accounting period this item is recognized in for financial reporting and statutory filings.

attributes.description: Reference to the payment plan this item is billed under. Null for full-pay or direct-bill policies.

attributes.name: policy_term_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific policy term period this charge applies to. Supports effective dating.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date this invoice item expires. Aligns with the policy term or coverage expiration date.

attributes.name: gl_account_code

attributes.name: installment_number

products.name: payment_plan

attributes.name: line_of_business_id

attributes.name: payment_plan_description
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of the payment plan terms, conditions, and intended use for underwriter and agent reference.

attributes.name: display_order
attributes.description: Numeric sequence controlling the presentation order of payment plans in user interfaces and quote proposals.

attributes.name: down_payment_minimum_amount

attributes.name: down_payment_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of total premium required as initial down payment at policy binding expressed as decimal.

attributes.name: effective_date

attributes.name: expiration_date

attributes.name: external_plan_code

attributes.name: grace_period_days

attributes.name: installment_fee_amount

attributes.name: installment_fee_percentage

attributes.name: installment_frequency

attributes.name: late_payment_fee_amount

attributes.name: maximum_premium_amount

attributes.name: minimum_premium_amount
attributes.description: Minimum total policy premium required to qualify for this payment plan. Policies below this threshold must pay in full.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the payment plan record was last updated reflecting configuration or status changes.

attributes.name: number_of_installments
attributes.description: Total count of scheduled payment installments in the plan excluding the down payment.

attributes.name: plan_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the payment plan template used for external reference and billing system integration.

attributes.name: plan_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the payment plan displayed to policyholders and agents.

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the payment plan indicating availability for new policies.

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the payment plan structure indicating how premium is collected.

attributes.name: policy_type_code
attributes.description: Policy type classification code restricting plan availability to specific policy forms or packages.

attributes.name: producer_commission_impact_flag

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_reference

attributes.name: reinstatement_fee_amount

attributes.name: returned_payment_fee_amount

products.name: installment_schedule

attributes.description: Indicates whether this installment is enrolled in automatic payment processing.

attributes.name: billing_period_end_date

attributes.name: billing_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the billing period covered by this installment.

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: Date on which this installment was cancelled. Null if not cancelled.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this installment schedule record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this installment.

attributes.name: delinquency_days

attributes.name: down_payment_flag

attributes.name: notice_type
attributes.description: Type of notice sent to the policyholder regarding this installment. Null if no notice sent.

attributes.name: outstanding_amount
attributes.description: The remaining unpaid balance on this installment. Calculated as scheduled amount minus paid amount.

attributes.name: paid_amount
attributes.description: The actual amount paid against this installment. May differ from scheduled amount due to partial payments or adjustments.

attributes.name: payment_channel

attributes.name: payment_method

products.name: returned_payment

attributes.name: processed_by_user_code

products.name: delinquency

attributes.name: cancellation_effective_date

attributes.name: cancellation_notice_date

attributes.name: cancellation_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the specific cancellation reason, typically non-payment or payment plan default.

attributes.name: collections_agency_flag

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: days_past_due

attributes.name: delinquency_status

attributes.description: External identifier used by collections agencies or third-party systems to reference this delinquency.

attributes.name: first_missed_installment_date

attributes.name: first_notice_date
attributes.description: Date the first delinquency notice was sent to the policyholder.

attributes.name: grace_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days allowed after the due date before the account is marked delinquent, per policy terms and state law.

attributes.name: grace_period_end_date
attributes.description: Date the grace period expired, after which the account was marked delinquent.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this delinquency record was last updated.

attributes.name: last_notice_date
attributes.description: Date the most recent delinquency or cancellation notice was sent.

attributes.name: late_fee_amount
attributes.description: Late payment fees assessed during the delinquency period, per state regulations and policy terms.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting collections actions, policyholder communications, and resolution details.

attributes.name: notice_sent_count
attributes.description: Total number of delinquency notices sent to the policyholder during this delinquency event.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the delinquency event, used in collections correspondence and workflow tracking.

attributes.description: Portion of the total amount due that is overdue and subject to collections action.

attributes.name: payment_plan_default_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the delinquency was caused by a payment plan default.

attributes.name: reversal_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative explanation of why the suspense item was reversed.

attributes.name: source_system_code

attributes.description: Detailed narrative explanation of why the item was placed into suspense, providing context beyond the reason code.

attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; ISO Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: agreement_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name or title of the reinsurance agreement (e.g., '2024 Property CAT XL Layer 1'). Used for human-readable identification in reports and workbenches.

attributes.name: agreement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique reference number assigned to the reinsurance agreement by the cedant or reinsurance management system. Used in bordereaux and Schedule F reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; ACORD Standards; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: agreement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the reinsurance agreement. Active indicates the agreement is in force and cessions may be made. Expired indicates the term has ended with no renewal.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: agreement_type
attributes.description: Broad classification of the reinsurance arrangement: Treaty (automatic cession under standing contract), Facultative (individual risk negotiation), or Facultative-Obligatory.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R; ISO Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: arbitration_clause
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agreement contains a mandatory arbitration clause for dispute resolution in lieu of litigation. True if arbitration is required.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Laws; ISO Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: attachment_point_amt
attributes.description: The loss threshold at which the reinsurance layer attaches and begins to respond for XOL and CAT XL treaties. Expressed in agreement currency. Null for proportional treaties.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; ISO Reinsurance Standards; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: authorized_status
attributes.description: Regulatory authorization status of the lead reinsurer in the cedant's domicile state: Authorized, Unauthorized, Certified (under NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law), or Reciprocal.
attributes.references: NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law; SAP SSAP No. 62R; State DOI

attributes.name: cat_event_scope
attributes.description: Defines the loss aggregation basis for CAT XL treaties: Per Risk, Per Occurrence, Per Event (hours clause), or Aggregate. Determines how losses from a single CAT event are combined.
attributes.references: ISO Reinsurance Standards; RMS RiskLink; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: cedant_legal_entity
attributes.description: Legal name of the ceding company (cedant) that is transferring risk under this agreement. Corresponds to the licensed insurance entity on the NAIC Annual Statement.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Annual Statement

attributes.name: cedant_naic_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cedant National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) Company Code
attributes.description: Five-digit NAIC company code identifying the cedant legal entity. Required for NAIC Schedule F statutory reporting and regulatory filings.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; NAIC Annual Statement Instructions

tag_set.value: Cedant National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) Company Code

attributes.name: ceding_commission_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of ceded premium returned to the cedant as a ceding commission under proportional (QS/Surplus) treaties to offset acquisition and overhead costs.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F; ISO Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: cession_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of risk ceded to reinsurers under a Quota Share treaty (e.g., 25.0000 = 25%). Null for XOL and non-proportional treaties where cession is loss-triggered.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F; ISO Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: collateral_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reinsurer is required to post collateral (LOC, trust, funds withheld) due to unauthorized/alien reinsurer status. Drives Schedule F credit allowance.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F; State DOI Requirements

attributes.name: collateral_type
attributes.description: Type of collateral posted by the reinsurer: Letter of Credit (LOC), Trust Account, Funds Withheld, Cash, or None. Required for unauthorized reinsurer credit under SAP SSAP No. 62R.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F; State DOI Requirements

attributes.name: coverage_basis
attributes.description: Defines which losses are covered: Losses Occurring (loss event in treaty period), Risks Attaching (policy incepting in treaty period), or Claims Made (claim reported in treaty period).
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; ISO Reinsurance Standards; IFRS 17

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the reinsurance agreement record was first created in the reinsurance management system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOX; GLBA; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: deposit_premium_amt
attributes.description: Initial premium paid by the cedant at inception of the treaty year, subject to adjustment at year-end based on actual subject premium. Used in ROL and premium settlement calculations.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F; ISO Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the reinsurance agreement expires and no new cessions may be made. Null for evergreen or open-ended agreements. Used in Schedule F run-off reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R; IFRS 17

attributes.name: funds_withheld
attributes.description: Indicates whether the cedant withholds ceded premium reserves rather than remitting to the reinsurer. Affects Schedule F credit and collateral requirements under SAP SSAP No. 62R.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: governing_law
attributes.description: Legal jurisdiction whose laws govern interpretation and enforcement of the agreement (e.g., 'New York', 'England and Wales'). Required for dispute resolution and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Laws; SAP SSAP No. 62R; Solvency II

attributes.name: hours_clause_hrs
attributes.description: Number of consecutive hours within which losses from a single occurrence are aggregated for CAT XL recovery purposes (e.g., 72 hours for wind, 168 hours for flood). Null if not applicable.
attributes.references: ISO Reinsurance Standards; RMS RiskLink; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: inception_date
attributes.description: The date on which the reinsurance agreement becomes effective and cessions may begin. Aligns with the treaty year start for annual treaties.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R; IFRS 17

attributes.name: insolvency_clause
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agreement contains an insolvency clause ensuring reinsurer obligations survive cedant insolvency. Required under SAP SSAP No. 62R for credit as reinsurance.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Model Laws; State DOI Requirements

attributes.name: lead_reinsurer_naic_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Lead Reinsurer National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) Company Code
attributes.description: Five-digit NAIC company code for the lead reinsurer. Required for Schedule F counterparty identification and credit risk assessment under SAP SSAP No. 62R.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; SAP SSAP No. 62R

tag_set.value: Lead Reinsurer National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) Company Code

attributes.name: lead_reinsurer_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the lead reinsurer on the agreement. For syndicated treaties, this is the lead market that sets terms. Used in bordereaux and Schedule F counterparty reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: limit_amt
attributes.description: Maximum amount the reinsurer will pay per risk, per occurrence, or in aggregate under this agreement. Defines the top of the reinsurance layer for XOL treaties.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F; ISO Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: loss_corridor_pct
attributes.description: Loss ratio band within which the cedant retains losses before the reinsurer re-engages, used in Stop Loss and aggregate structures. Null if no loss corridor provision.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; ISO Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: minimum_premium_amt
attributes.description: Minimum reinsurance premium guaranteed to the reinsurer regardless of actual subject premium volume. Protects reinsurer against cedant portfolio shrinkage.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; ISO Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: offset_clause
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agreement permits mutual offset of amounts owed between cedant and reinsurer. Relevant for credit risk management and Schedule F balance netting.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: profit_commission_pct
