attributes.description: Percentage of reinsurer profit returned to the cedant under a profit commission clause. Calculated on the treaty year result after losses and expenses. Null if no profit commission.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; ISO Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: program_layer
attributes.description: Identifies the layer within a multi-layer reinsurance program (e.g., 'Layer 1', 'Layer 2', 'Top Layer'). Used to sequence layers for loss allocation and PML modeling.
attributes.references: ISO Reinsurance Standards; RMS RiskLink; Verisk AIR Touchstone

attributes.name: reinstatement_count
attributes.description: Number of times the reinsurance limit may be reinstated after a loss exhausts the layer. Common in CAT XL treaties. Zero indicates no reinstatement provision.
attributes.references: ISO Reinsurance Standards; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: reinstatement_premium_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the original reinsurance premium charged to reinstate the limit after a loss. Expressed as a percentage of the annual deposit premium (e.g., 100% = pro-rata reinstatement).
attributes.references: ISO Reinsurance Standards; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: retention_amt
attributes.description: The cedant's net retained amount per risk or per occurrence before reinsurance responds. For XOL, this is the attachment point (SIR). For QS, this is the retained share in currency.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F; ISO Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: retrocession_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this agreement is a retrocession (reinsurer ceding risk to another reinsurer) rather than a primary cession from the cedant. Affects Schedule F netting.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: rol_pct
attributes.description: Rate on Line expressed as a percentage: reinsurance premium divided by the reinsurance limit. Key pricing metric for XOL and CAT XL layers used in actuarial and underwriting analysis.
attributes.references: ISO Reinsurance Standards; SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC ORSA

attributes.name: signed_date
attributes.description: The date the reinsurance agreement was formally executed and signed by all parties. May differ from inception date for retroactive or late-signed treaties.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: territory_scope
attributes.description: Geographic scope of risks covered by the agreement (e.g., 'USA and Canada', 'Worldwide excluding War Zones'). Drives exposure aggregation and CAT model alignment.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; ISO Reinsurance Standards; RMS RiskLink

attributes.name: treaty_type
attributes.description: Sub-classification for Treaty agreements: Quota Share (QS), Excess of Loss (XOL), Stop Loss (SL), Catastrophe Excess of Loss (CAT XL), Surplus Share, or Other. Null for Facultative agreements.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R; ISO Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: unl_basis
attributes.description: Defines how Ultimate Net Loss is calculated for recovery purposes: Gross (before other RI), Net of Inuring RI (after lower layers), or Net of All RI. Critical for layered program structures.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; ISO Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the reinsurance agreement record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking, audit compliance, and incremental data pipeline processing.
attributes.references: SOX; GLBA; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

products.name: treaty
products.description: Defines a proportional or non-proportional treaty under a reinsurance agreement. One row per treaty. Captures treaty type (QS/XOL/SL/CAT XL), layer, retention, limit, ROL, and UNL basis.

attributes.name: treaty_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a reinsurance treaty record. Primary key. One row per treaty under a reinsurance agreement.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: Treaty financial terms require currency master for exchange rate application, premium settlement, and multi-currency reporting.

attributes.name: intermediary_agency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to producers.agency. Business justification: Treaties track intermediary/broker by name; should formalize as FK to agency. Enables broker performance analysis on treaty placements, commission tracking for reinsurance intermediation

attributes.name: line_of_business_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.line_of_business. Business justification: Treaty structuring, rate adequacy analysis, and regulatory reporting require LOB master for NAIC line codes, loss ratio targets, and treaty applicability rules.

attributes.name: reinsurer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reinsurance.reinsurer. Business justification: Treaty has denormalized reinsurer attributes (reinsurer_name, reinsurer_naic_code, reinsurer_share_pct). Adding FK to reinsurer master and removing redundant name and NAIC code.

attributes.name: ri_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent reinsurance agreement under which this treaty is placed. Links treaty to the master agreement record.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: aggregate_deductible
attributes.description: Cumulative loss amount the cedant must absorb before aggregate stop loss or aggregate XOL reinsurance attaches. Also known as the annual aggregate retention.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; ISO Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: aggregate_limit
attributes.description: Maximum total reinsurance recovery across all occurrences during the treaty period. Caps cumulative recoveries for aggregate XOL and Stop Loss treaties.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; ISO Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: attachment_point
attributes.description: Dollar amount at which reinsurance coverage attaches for XOL and CAT XL treaties. Losses below this threshold are retained by the cedant. Null for proportional treaties.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; ISO Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: authorized_reinsurer_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reinsurer is authorized/accredited in the cedant's domicile state. Affects credit for reinsurance on the statutory balance sheet per NAIC requirements.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Law on Credit for Reinsurance; SAP SSAP No. 62R; State DOI

attributes.name: brokerage_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of ceded premium paid to the reinsurance intermediary as brokerage commission. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0250 = 2.5%).
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: catastrophe_event_type
attributes.description: Peril type covered by a CAT XL treaty. Restricts recovery eligibility to specified catastrophe perils. Null for non-CAT treaties. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WINDSTORM|EARTHQUAKE|FLOOD|WILDFIRE|HAIL|ALL_PERILS|OTHER — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: RMS RiskLink; AIR Touchstone; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: ceding_commission_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of ceded premium returned to the cedant as ceding commission under a proportional treaty. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.3000 = 30%). Null for XOL treaties.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: cession_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of risk ceded to reinsurers under a Quota Share treaty. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.7500 = 75%). Null for non-proportional treaties.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: collateral_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reinsurer must post collateral (letter of credit or trust fund) to support credit for reinsurance on the cedant's statutory balance sheet.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Law on Credit for Reinsurance; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: coverage_basis
attributes.description: Defines which losses are covered: Risks Attaching (policies incepting in treaty period), Losses Occurring (losses occurring in treaty period), or Claims Made.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; ISO Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this treaty record was first created in the reinsurance management system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOX; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: deposit_premium
attributes.description: Provisional premium paid at treaty inception, subject to adjustment at year-end based on actual subject premium. Common in proportional and adjustable XOL treaties.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the treaty becomes binding and cessions may attach. Policies with inception on or after this date are eligible for cession under this treaty.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the treaty expires and no new cessions may attach. Null for evergreen treaties. Used in Schedule F period-end calculations.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: hours_clause
attributes.description: Maximum number of consecutive hours within which losses from a single catastrophe event are aggregated for recovery purposes (e.g., 72 hours for windstorm, 168 hours for flood).
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; ISO CAT Reinsurance Standards; RMS RiskLink

attributes.name: inception_year
attributes.description: Calendar year in which the treaty incepted. Used for underwriting year (UY) and policy year (PY) loss triangle segmentation in actuarial reserving.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: layer_number
attributes.description: Sequential layer number within a tower of XOL or CAT XL protection (e.g., Layer 1, Layer 2). Distinguishes multiple treaties in the same program year.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; Sapiens ReinsurancePro Treaty module

attributes.name: limit
attributes.description: Maximum reinsurance recovery available under this treaty per occurrence or in aggregate. Defines the top of the layer for XOL/CAT XL treaties.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: loss_corridor_lower
attributes.description: Lower bound of the loss ratio corridor retained by the cedant in a Stop Loss treaty. Expressed as a decimal loss ratio (e.g., 0.7000 = 70%). Null for non-SL treaties.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; ISO Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: loss_corridor_upper
attributes.description: Upper bound of the loss ratio corridor at which Stop Loss reinsurance attaches. Expressed as a decimal loss ratio (e.g., 0.9000 = 90%). Null for non-SL treaties.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; ISO Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: minimum_premium
attributes.description: Minimum reinsurance premium guaranteed to the reinsurer regardless of ceded subject premium volume. Protects reinsurer against low-volume years.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; Sapiens ReinsurancePro Treaty module

attributes.name: treaty_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the treaty (e.g., 'Property CAT XL Layer 1 2024'). Used for human identification in reinsurance management system and bordereaux.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; Sapiens ReinsurancePro Treaty module

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier assigned to the treaty by the cedant or reinsurer. Used in bordereaux reporting and Schedule F filings.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; ACORD 790; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: occurrence_limit
attributes.description: Maximum reinsurance recovery per single occurrence or event under this treaty. Distinct from aggregate limit. Applies to per-occurrence XOL and CAT XL structures.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; ISO Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: placement_pct
attributes.description: Total percentage of treaty capacity placed with all reinsurers combined. A value less than 1.0000 indicates a partially placed treaty with net retained gap.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; Sapiens ReinsurancePro Treaty module

attributes.name: premium
attributes.description: Total reinsurance premium ceded to reinsurers under this treaty for the treaty period. For QS treaties, this is the ceded written premium. For XOL, this is the flat or deposit premium.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: profit_commission_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of treaty profit returned to the cedant as profit commission under a sliding scale or profit-sharing arrangement. Null if no profit commission applies.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; Sapiens ReinsurancePro Treaty module

attributes.name: reinstatement_count
attributes.description: Number of times the treaty limit may be reinstated after a loss exhausts the layer. Common in CAT XL treaties. Zero indicates no reinstatements available.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; ISO Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: reinstatement_premium_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the original treaty premium charged to reinstate the treaty limit after a loss. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 1.0000 = 100% pro-rata reinstatement).
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; ISO Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: reinsurer_share_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the treaty capacity subscribed by the lead reinsurer. For fully placed treaties this may be 100%; for syndicated treaties it reflects the lead line.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: retention_amount
attributes.description: The cedant's net retained loss amount before reinsurance attaches. For XOL, this is the attachment point per occurrence. For QS, this is the retained percentage expressed as a dollar floor.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: retention_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of risk retained by the cedant under a proportional (QS or Surplus) treaty. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.2500 = 25%). Null for non-proportional treaties.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: retrocession_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this treaty is a retrocession arrangement (reinsurer ceding risk to another reinsurer). True = retrocession; False = standard cedant-to-reinsurer treaty.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: rol_pct
attributes.description: Rate on Line expressed as a decimal: treaty premium divided by treaty limit. Key pricing metric for XOL and CAT XL treaties used in reinsurance pricing analytics.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; ISO Reinsurance Standards; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: subject_premium_basis
attributes.description: Defines the premium base used to calculate ceded premium under proportional treaties: Gross Written Premium (GWP), Net Written Premium (NWP), Direct Premium Written (DPW), or Net Earned.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: territory
attributes.description: Geographic scope of risks covered by this treaty (e.g., 'USA', 'USA and Canada', 'Worldwide Excluding'). Defines eligible cession geography for bordereaux reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: treaty_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the treaty. Controls whether new cessions can be written against it and whether recoveries are eligible.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: treaty_type
attributes.description: Classification of the treaty structure: Quota Share (QS), Excess of Loss (XOL), Stop Loss (SL), Catastrophe Excess of Loss (CAT XL), or Surplus. Drives cession and recovery calculation logic.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R; ISO Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: unl_basis
attributes.description: Defines how Ultimate Net Loss (UNL) is calculated for recovery purposes: gross of inuring reinsurance, net of inuring reinsurance, net of salvage/subrogation, or full UNL.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; ISO Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this treaty record in the reinsurance management system. Supports change tracking and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; SAP SSAP No. 62R

products.name: treaty_layer
products.description: Individual attachment/exhaustion layer within an XOL or CAT XL treaty. One row per layer per treaty. Stores attachment point, limit per occurrence, annual aggregate limit, and reinstatement terms.

attributes.name: treaty_layer_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a single attachment/exhaustion layer within an XOL or CAT XL reinsurance treaty. One row per layer per treaty.

attributes.name: cat_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophegeography.cat_zone. Business justification: Treaty layers often have zone-specific attachment points and limits for concentration management, regulatory capital calculations, and underwriting guidelines.

attributes.name: coverage_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to coverage.coverage_type. Business justification: Treaty layers often restrict coverage by type (e.g., layer covers only general liability, not property).

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: Layer limits and premiums are currency-denominated; currency master provides exchange rates for multi-currency treaty structures and ensures consistent financial reporting across layers.

attributes.name: ri_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent reinsurance agreement under which this layer is structured. Links the layer to its governing treaty contract.

attributes.name: treaty_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reinsurance.treaty. Business justification: treaty_layer represents individual attachment/exhaustion layers within a treaty. Currently only references ri_agreement, but should also reference the parent treaty.

attributes.name: parent_treaty_layer_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier of the immediately underlying treaty layer in a multi-layer tower. Null for the first layer above the cedant retention.

attributes.name: accounting_basis
attributes.description: Basis on which losses are covered: losses_occurring (losses that occur during the treaty period) or risks_attaching (policies attaching during the treaty period).
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Annual Statement; IFRS 17

attributes.name: annual_aggregate_deductible
attributes.description: Cumulative loss amount the cedant must retain across all occurrences before the annual aggregate limit of this layer begins to respond.

attributes.name: annual_aggregate_limit
attributes.description: Maximum total dollar amount recoverable from reinsurers under this layer across all occurrences within the treaty year. Null if no aggregate cap applies.
attributes.references: Reinsurance Management System (SICS/Sapiens ReinsurancePro); SAP/SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: attachment_point
attributes.description: Dollar amount of loss per occurrence at which this reinsurance layer begins to respond. Losses below this threshold are retained by the cedant.
attributes.references: Reinsurance Management System (SICS/Sapiens ReinsurancePro); NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: broker_reference
attributes.description: Reinsurance broker's reference number or slip identifier for this layer as used in placement correspondence and market submissions.

attributes.name: cedant_retention_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of loss within this layer retained by the cedant (co-participation). Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.1000 = 10%). Remainder is ceded to reinsurers.
attributes.references: Reinsurance Management System (SICS/Sapiens ReinsurancePro); NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: ceded_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of loss within this layer ceded to reinsurers. Equals 1 minus cedant_retention_pct. Stored explicitly for bordereaux and Schedule F reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this treaty layer record was first created in the reinsurance management system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: deposit_premium
attributes.description: Provisional premium paid at inception of the treaty layer, subject to adjustment at year-end based on actual subject premium earned.
attributes.references: Reinsurance Management System (SICS/Sapiens ReinsurancePro); SAP/SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this treaty layer becomes binding and coverage obligations commence. Used to determine which layer applies to a given loss date.

attributes.name: exhaustion_point
attributes.description: Dollar amount at which this layer is fully exhausted, equal to attachment_point plus layer_limit. Stored explicitly for bordereaux reporting and PML tower analysis.
attributes.references: Catastrophe Modeling Platform (RMS RiskLink/AIR Touchstone); NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which this treaty layer expires and coverage obligations cease. Nullable for evergreen or continuous layers.

attributes.name: hours_clause
attributes.description: Maximum number of consecutive hours within which losses from a single catastrophic event are aggregated as one occurrence (e.g., 168 for windstorm, 72 for earthquake).
attributes.references: ISO Reinsurance Standards; Catastrophe Modeling Platform (RMS RiskLink/AIR Touchstone)

attributes.name: index_basis
attributes.description: Name or description of the index used for the index clause (e.g., CPI, Marshall & Swift construction cost index). Null if index_clause_flag is false.

attributes.name: index_clause_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an index or stability clause applies to this layer, adjusting the attachment point and limit in line with an inflation or price index.

attributes.name: layer_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code identifying this layer as referenced in bordereaux, reinsurer slips, and Schedule F filings.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: layer_limit
attributes.description: Maximum dollar amount recoverable from reinsurers under this layer for a single occurrence or event. Defines the exhaustion point as attachment_point + layer_limit.
attributes.references: Reinsurance Management System (SICS/Sapiens ReinsurancePro); NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: layer_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name for this layer (e.g., '1st XOL Layer', '2nd CAT XL Layer') used in reinsurer communications and internal reporting.

attributes.name: layer_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for underwriter or reinsurance analyst notes regarding special terms, conditions, or exceptions applicable to this layer not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: layer_number
attributes.description: Sequential ordinal position of this layer within the treaty tower, starting at 1 for the first layer above the retention. Used to reconstruct the full tower order.

attributes.name: layer_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the treaty layer indicating whether it is actively in force, expired, cancelled, pending placement, or suspended.

attributes.name: layer_type
attributes.description: Classification of the reinsurance layer structure. XOL=Excess of Loss, CAT_XL=Catastrophe Excess of Loss, QS=Quota Share, SL=Stop Loss, WORKING=working layer, CLASH=clash cover.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Laws; ISO Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: lob_scope
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list of Lines of Business covered by this layer (e.g., HO, PAP, CGL, BOP). Defines the subject business eligible for recovery under this layer.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement; NAIC Line of Business Codes

attributes.name: loss_corridor_lower
attributes.description: Lower bound of a loss corridor within this layer where the cedant retains losses. Used in structured XOL layers with embedded retentions.

attributes.name: loss_corridor_upper
attributes.description: Upper bound of a loss corridor within this layer where the cedant retains losses. Losses above this bound revert to reinsurer coverage within the layer.

attributes.name: loss_occurrence_definition
attributes.description: Contractual definition of a single occurrence for this layer (e.g., 168-hour clause for windstorm, 72-hour clause for earthquake). Critical for CAT XL aggregation.
attributes.references: ISO Reinsurance Standards; Reinsurance Management System (SICS/Sapiens ReinsurancePro)

attributes.name: minimum_premium
attributes.description: Minimum reinsurance premium guaranteed to reinsurers for this layer regardless of subject premium volume. Protects reinsurers against low-volume scenarios.

attributes.name: peril_scope
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list of perils covered by this layer (e.g., WIND, QUAKE, FLOOD, FIRE, ALL). Determines which catastrophe events trigger recovery under this layer.
attributes.references: ISO Reinsurance Standards; Catastrophe Modeling Platform (RMS RiskLink/AIR Touchstone)

attributes.name: placed_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of this layer that has been placed with reinsurers. A value less than 1.0 indicates the layer is not fully subscribed.
attributes.references: Reinsurance Management System (SICS/Sapiens ReinsurancePro); NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: profit_commission_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of underwriting profit returned to the cedant by reinsurers under a profit commission clause for this layer. Expressed as a decimal.

attributes.name: reinstatement_basis
attributes.description: Basis on which reinstatement premium is calculated: pro_rata (proportional to loss), flat (fixed percentage), or free (no additional premium charged).

attributes.name: reinstatement_count
attributes.description: Number of reinstatements available for this layer after a loss exhausts the layer limit. Zero indicates no reinstatements; null indicates unlimited reinstatements.

attributes.name: reinstatement_premium_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the original layer premium charged per reinstatement to restore the layer limit after a loss. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 1.0000 = 100% pro-rata).
attributes.references: Reinsurance Management System (SICS/Sapiens ReinsurancePro); ISO Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: reinsurance_premium
attributes.description: Gross reinsurance premium payable by the cedant to reinsurers for this layer for the treaty period. Used in bordereaux and Schedule F premium reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP/SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Annual Statement

attributes.name: retrocession_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this layer is a retrocession layer (reinsurance of reinsurance) rather than a direct cession from the primary insurer.
attributes.references: Reinsurance Management System (SICS/Sapiens ReinsurancePro); NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: rol_pct
attributes.description: Rate on Line expressed as a decimal; the reinsurance premium for this layer divided by the layer limit. Key pricing metric for XOL and CAT XL layers.
attributes.references: Reinsurance Management System (SICS/Sapiens ReinsurancePro); ISO Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: signed_line_pct
attributes.description: Total signed line percentage across all reinsurers participating in this layer after signing-down from written lines. Should sum to placed_pct.

attributes.name: sliding_scale_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a sliding scale commission arrangement applies to this layer, where the ceding commission varies inversely with the loss ratio.

attributes.name: subject_premium_basis
attributes.description: Premium base used to calculate the reinsurance premium for this layer. GWP=Gross Written Premium, NWP=Net Written Premium, DPW=Direct Premium Written, NEP=Net Earned Premium, GEP=Gross Earned Premium.

attributes.name: territory_scope
attributes.description: Geographic territory covered by this layer (e.g., USA, USA_GULF, NATIONWIDE). Defines the geographic boundary of eligible subject business for this layer.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement; Catastrophe Modeling Platform (RMS RiskLink/AIR Touchstone)

attributes.name: unl_basis
attributes.description: Defines how Ultimate Net Loss is calculated for recovery under this layer: gross of all recoveries, net of other recoveries, or net of underlying reinsurance.
attributes.references: Reinsurance Management System (SICS/Sapiens ReinsurancePro); SAP/SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this treaty layer record. Used for change tracking, audit compliance, and incremental data loading.

products.name: fac_agreement
products.description: Facultative reinsurance agreement covering a single risk or policy. One row per FAC placement. Captures cedant, reinsurer, ceded percentage, premium rate, inception/expiry, and the linked policy or submission.

attributes.name: fac_agreement_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate primary key for the facultative reinsurance agreement. One row per FAC placement covering a single risk or policy.

attributes.name: catastrophe_event_id
attributes.description: Reference to a catastrophe event record if this FAC placement was triggered or influenced by a specific CAT event exposure.
attributes.references: Catastrophe Modeling Platform (RMS RiskLink / Verisk AIR Touchstone)

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: Facultative certificates are often in foreign currencies; currency master provides exchange rates for premium settlement, collateral valuation, and financial reporting.

attributes.name: fac_broker_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party record for the reinsurance intermediary/broker who placed this FAC agreement on behalf of the cedant.
attributes.references: Customer/Party MDM; Reinsurance Management System (SICS/Sapiens ReinsurancePro)

attributes.name: fac_cedant_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party record representing the ceding insurer (Pc_Insurance) transferring risk under this FAC agreement.
attributes.references: Customer/Party MDM; NAIC Annual Statement Schedule F

attributes.name: fac_reinsurer_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party record representing the assuming reinsurer accepting the ceded risk under this FAC placement.
attributes.references: Customer/Party MDM; NAIC Annual Statement Schedule F

attributes.name: line_of_business_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.line_of_business. Business justification: Facultative certificates require LOB master for Schedule F reporting, reinsurer authorization by line, and collateral requirement calculations.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the underlying policy whose risk is being ceded under this facultative agreement.
attributes.references: Policy Administration System (PAS - Guidewire PolicyCenter / Duck Creek Policy)

attributes.name: producers_producer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to producers.producers_producer. Business justification: Facultative certificates are often placed by individual producers who negotiate coverage with reinsurers.

attributes.name: quote_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to coverage.quote. Business justification: Facultative underwriting evaluates quote terms (limits, deductibles, pricing) before issuing certificates. Reinsurers review quote details to price fac participation.

attributes.name: reinsurer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reinsurance.reinsurer. Business justification: fac_agreement has reinsurer_party_id pointing to generic party table, but also needs FK to specialized reinsurer master for reinsurer-specific attributes (ratings, authorization status

attributes.name: ri_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent reinsurance agreement record under which this facultative placement is administered.

attributes.name: riskexposure_insured_risk_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to riskexposure.insured_risk. Business justification: Facultative reinsurance is placed on specific high-value or unusual individual risks. Underwriters submit detailed risk characteristics to reinsurers for facultative quotes.

attributes.name: submission_id
attributes.description: Reference to the underwriting submission associated with this FAC placement, used when the FAC is placed prior to policy binding.

attributes.name: uw_decision_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to coverage.uw_decision. Business justification: Facultative reinsurers require underwriting decision context (risk tier, referral reasons, conditions, decline rationale) to assess participation and price fac certificates.

attributes.name: uw_referral_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to coverage.uw_referral. Business justification: High-risk submissions triggering underwriting referrals often require facultative reinsurance.

attributes.name: agreement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the FAC agreement. Tracks progression from offer through binding, active coverage, and termination.
attributes.references: Reinsurance Management System (SICS/Sapiens ReinsurancePro); NAIC Model Laws

attributes.name: authorized_reinsurer_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reinsurer is authorized/accredited in the cedant's state of domicile. Affects Schedule F credit and collateral requirements.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Schedule F; State DOI Regulations; NAIC Model Laws

attributes.name: bound_date
attributes.description: Date on which the reinsurer formally bound coverage under this facultative agreement, confirming acceptance of the ceded risk.

attributes.name: broker_commission_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of ceded premium payable to the reinsurance broker as intermediary commission for placing this FAC agreement.
attributes.references: Reinsurance Management System (SICS/Sapiens ReinsurancePro); SAP/SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the facultative agreement was cancelled, if applicable. Null for agreements that run to natural expiry.
attributes.references: Reinsurance Management System (SICS/Sapiens ReinsurancePro); SAP/SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: ceded_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum dollar amount of loss the reinsurer will pay under this FAC agreement. Represents the reinsurer's liability cap for the placement.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Annual Statement Schedule F

attributes.name: ceded_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the original risk ceded to the reinsurer under this FAC agreement, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.5000 = 50%). Applies to pro-rata placements.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Annual Statement Schedule F

attributes.name: ceded_premium_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of premium ceded to the reinsurer under this FAC agreement. Reduces net written premium (NWP) for the cedant.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Annual Statement Schedule F; GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: ceding_commission_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of ceding commission receivable from the reinsurer. Calculated as ceded premium multiplied by the ceding commission rate.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Annual Statement Schedule F

attributes.name: ceding_commission_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of ceded premium returned to the cedant by the reinsurer as a ceding commission to offset acquisition and administrative costs.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Annual Statement Schedule F

attributes.name: collateral_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of collateral posted by the reinsurer (letter of credit or trust) to secure obligations under this FAC agreement.
attributes.references: NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law; NAIC Annual Statement Schedule F

attributes.name: collateral_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reinsurer is required to post collateral (letter of credit or trust fund) due to unauthorized status under NAIC credit for reinsurance rules.
attributes.references: NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law; State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this FAC agreement record was first created in the reinsurance management system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.
attributes.references: SOX; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; GLBA

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the facultative reinsurance coverage expires. Typically co-terminus with the underlying policy expiration date.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Schedule F; SAP/SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: fac_certificate_number
attributes.description: Certificate number issued by the reinsurer confirming acceptance of the facultative placement. Used for claims recovery and bordereaux reconciliation.
attributes.references: ACORD Standards; Reinsurance Management System (SICS/Sapiens ReinsurancePro)

attributes.name: fac_premium_rate
attributes.description: Rate applied to the ceded limit or TIV to derive the FAC reinsurance premium. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.005000 = 0.50%). Also known as Rate on Line (ROL) for XOL placements.

attributes.name: fac_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier assigned to this FAC placement, used in bordereaux reporting and reinsurer correspondence. Unique per placement.
attributes.references: ACORD Standards; Reinsurance Management System (SICS/Sapiens ReinsurancePro)

attributes.name: fac_type
attributes.description: Structural type of the facultative placement: pro-rata (quota share basis) or excess of loss. Determines how premium and losses are shared.

attributes.name: gross_written_premium
attributes.description: Total gross written premium on the underlying policy before cession. Basis for calculating the ceded reinsurance premium.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Annual Statement Schedule F; GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: inception_date
attributes.description: Date on which the facultative reinsurance coverage becomes effective. Must align with or precede the underlying policy effective date.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Schedule F; SAP/SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: loss_participation_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of losses the cedant participates in alongside the reinsurer under profit-sharing or loss-sensitive FAC structures.
attributes.references: Reinsurance Management System (SICS/Sapiens ReinsurancePro); SAP/SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: original_insured_tiv
attributes.description: Total Insured Value of the underlying risk at the time of FAC placement. Used to calculate ceded exposure and Rate on Line (ROL).
attributes.references: ISO Property Rating; Catastrophe Modeling Platform (RMS/AIR)

attributes.name: placement_basis
attributes.description: Basis on which the FAC agreement responds: risks attaching (policies incepting during the period) or losses occurring (losses during the period).

attributes.name: reinstatement_premium_rate
attributes.description: Rate applied to the original FAC premium to calculate the reinstatement premium payable when the ceded limit is reinstated after a loss.

attributes.name: reinstatement_provision
attributes.description: Indicates whether the FAC agreement includes a reinstatement provision allowing the ceded limit to be restored after a loss, typically for XOL placements.
attributes.references: ISO Reinsurance Standards; Reinsurance Management System (SICS/Sapiens ReinsurancePro)

attributes.name: reinsurer_share_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the FAC placement accepted by this specific reinsurer. Relevant when a single FAC risk is placed with multiple reinsurers (co-reinsurance).
attributes.references: Reinsurance Management System (SICS/Sapiens ReinsurancePro); SAP/SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: reinsurer_underwriter_name
attributes.description: Name of the underwriter at the assuming reinsurer who accepted and bound this FAC placement.

attributes.name: retention_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of loss retained by the cedant (Pc_Insurance) before the reinsurer's liability attaches. Applies to excess-of-loss FAC placements.

attributes.name: retrocession_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this FAC agreement is a retrocession (reinsurance of reinsurance), where the cedant is itself a reinsurer passing risk further.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Annual Statement Schedule F

attributes.name: schedule_f_category
attributes.description: NAIC Schedule F classification of the reinsurer for statutory reporting: authorized, unauthorized, certified, or reciprocal jurisdiction reinsurer.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Schedule F; NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law

attributes.name: slip_reference
attributes.description: Market slip or cover note reference number associated with this FAC placement, used in London Market or broker-placed reinsurance transactions.
attributes.references: ACORD Standards; Reinsurance Management System (SICS/Sapiens ReinsurancePro)

attributes.name: special_conditions
attributes.description: Free-text description of any special terms, conditions, exclusions, or warranties specific to this facultative placement not captured in structured fields.
attributes.references: Reinsurance Management System (SICS/Sapiens ReinsurancePro); ACORD Standards

attributes.name: underwriter_name
attributes.description: Name of the cedant's underwriter responsible for placing and managing this facultative reinsurance agreement.
attributes.references: Underwriting Workbench; Reinsurance Management System (SICS/Sapiens ReinsurancePro)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this FAC agreement record was last modified in the reinsurance management system. Supports audit trail and change tracking.
attributes.references: SOX; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; GLBA

products.name: reinsurer
products.description: Master record for each reinsurance counterparty (assuming company, Lloyd's syndicate, or pool). One row per reinsurer. Stores legal name, NAIC code, AM Best rating, domicile, and authorized/unauthorized status for Schedule F credit.
products.reference: Reinsurer / Assuming Company / NAIC Schedule F Reinsurer

attributes.name: reinsurer_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each reinsurance counterparty record. Primary key of the reinsurer master table. One row per reinsurer entity.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: Reinsurer credit limits and collateral are currency-denominated; currency master provides exchange rates for credit monitoring, collateral adequacy assessment, and multi-currency reinsurer

attributes.name: parent_reinsurer_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the parent reinsurer entity for group-level exposure aggregation, credit limit monitoring, and group Schedule F reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC ORSA

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to party.party. Business justification: Reinsurer entities are parties requiring KYC, address, contact, and identifier management. Multiple reinsurance products already use reinsurer_party_id FK to party.party, but reinsurer table

attributes.name: am_best_outlook
attributes.description: AM Best rating outlook indicating the likely direction of the reinsurer's financial strength rating over the medium term. Informs counterparty risk monitoring.
attributes.references: AM Best Rating Services; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: am_best_rating
attributes.description: AM Best Financial Strength Rating (FSR) assigned to the reinsurer. Used in underwriting guidelines to validate counterparty credit quality and treaty eligibility thresholds.
attributes.references: AM Best Rating Services; NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: am_best_rating_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current AM Best Financial Strength Rating was assigned or last affirmed. Used to assess rating currency and trigger counterparty review workflows.
attributes.references: AM Best Rating Services; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the reinsurer was most recently approved by the internal credit committee for new cession activity. Supports counterparty governance audit trails.
attributes.references: NAIC ORSA; SAP SSAP No. 62R; SOX

attributes.name: approval_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current internal approval for the reinsurer expires and must be renewed by the credit committee. Drives counterparty review scheduling.
attributes.references: NAIC ORSA; Internal Reinsurance Credit Policy

attributes.name: approved_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reinsurer has been formally approved by the cedant's internal credit and counterparty risk committee for placement of new reinsurance agreements.
attributes.references: NAIC ORSA; SAP SSAP No. 62R; Internal Reinsurance Credit Policy

attributes.name: authorization_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reinsurer is authorized, unauthorized, certified, or accredited in the cedant's domicile state. Determines Schedule F credit for reinsurance and collateral obligations.
attributes.references: NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law (#785); SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: broker_intermediary_name
attributes.description: Name of the reinsurance broker or intermediary through which business is placed with this reinsurer. Used for commission tracking and intermediary credit risk assessment.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; ACORD Standards; Reinsurance Management System

attributes.name: reinsurer_code
attributes.description: Internal alphanumeric code assigned to uniquely identify the reinsurer within the Reinsurance Management System for bordereaux and cession processing.

attributes.name: collateral_amount
attributes.description: Total USD amount of collateral currently posted by the reinsurer. Used in Schedule F credit calculations and counterparty exposure monitoring.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law (#785)

attributes.name: collateral_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reinsurer is required to post collateral (letter of credit, trust fund, or funds withheld) to support Schedule F credit for unauthorized reinsurers.
attributes.references: NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law (#785); SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: collateral_type
attributes.description: Type of collateral arrangement posted by the reinsurer to secure Schedule F credit. Applicable to unauthorized and certified reinsurers per NAIC Model Law #785.
attributes.references: NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law (#785); SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the reinsurer master record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX compliance requirements.

attributes.name: credit_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum aggregate ceded exposure (in USD) approved for this reinsurer by the internal credit committee. Enforced at cession booking to prevent counterparty concentration breaches.
attributes.references: NAIC ORSA; RBC requirements; Internal Reinsurance Credit Policy

attributes.name: domicile_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction where the reinsurer is legally domiciled. Used for Schedule F foreign reinsurer classification and credit determination.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: domicile_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state or territory code where the reinsurer is domiciled, if a domestic entity. Used for state-level authorization and credit for reinsurance analysis.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; State DOI regulations; NAIC Model Law #785

attributes.name: federal_excise_tax_exempt_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reinsurer is exempt from US Federal Excise Tax on reinsurance premiums under a tax treaty or qualified jurisdiction status per IRC Section 4371.
attributes.references: IRC Section 4371; IRS; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: fein
attributes.description: IRS-assigned Federal Employer Identification Number (FEIN) for the reinsurer entity. Used for tax reporting, 1099 issuance, and AP payment processing.

attributes.name: group_name
attributes.description: Name of the reinsurance group or holding company to which this reinsurer belongs. Used for group-level credit exposure aggregation and counterparty concentration risk.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; NAIC ORSA; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent formal counterparty credit review conducted by the cedant's reinsurance credit committee. Supports ORSA and governance audit requirements.
attributes.references: NAIC ORSA; SAP SSAP No. 62R; SOX

attributes.name: lloyds_syndicate_number
attributes.description: Four-digit Lloyd's of London syndicate number. Populated only when reinsurer_type is lloyds_syndicate. Required for Lloyd's-specific bordereaux and premium trust fund reporting.
attributes.references: Lloyd's of London Market Bulletin; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: minimum_am_best_rating
attributes.description: Minimum AM Best Financial Strength Rating required by internal policy for this reinsurer to remain eligible for new cessions. Triggers review if current rating falls below threshold.
attributes.references: AM Best Rating Services; Internal Reinsurance Credit Policy; NAIC ORSA

attributes.name: moodys_rating
attributes.description: Moody's Investors Service insurance financial strength rating for the reinsurer. Used as a tertiary credit quality indicator in counterparty risk frameworks.
attributes.references: Moody's Investors Service; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: naic_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) Company Code
attributes.description: Five-digit NAIC company code assigned to the reinsurer. Required for NAIC Schedule F statutory reporting and credit for reinsurance determinations.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Annual Statement

tag_set.value: National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) Company Code

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next formal counterparty credit review. Drives workflow alerts in the Reinsurance Management System to ensure timely governance compliance.
attributes.references: NAIC ORSA; Internal Reinsurance Credit Policy

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for underwriting, credit, or operational notes about the reinsurer, such as special collateral arrangements, run-off status details, or relationship history.

attributes.name: pool_name
attributes.description: Name of the reinsurance pool or facility when the reinsurer participates as a pool member. Used for pool-level aggregation in bordereaux and Schedule F reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: reinsurer_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the reinsurer in the cedant's system. Controls eligibility for new cessions and triggers collection escalation for run-off or insolvent counterparties.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R; State Guaranty Association rules

attributes.name: reinsurer_type
attributes.description: Classification of the reinsurer entity structure. Drives Schedule F credit treatment and collateral requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: assuming_company|lloyds_syndicate|pool|captive|government|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: relationship_inception_date
attributes.description: Date on which the cedant first entered into a reinsurance agreement with this counterparty. Used for relationship tenure analysis and counterparty history reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; Reinsurance Management System (SICS/Sapiens ReinsurancePro)

attributes.name: retrocession_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reinsurer also acts as a retrocessionaire, accepting ceded risk from other reinsurers. Used to identify retrocession (RETRO) relationships in the reinsurance chain.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F; Reinsurance Management System

attributes.name: schedule_f_category
attributes.description: NAIC Schedule F reporting category for this reinsurer. Determines the statutory credit treatment, penalty charges, and collateral requirements in the Annual Statement.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law (#785)

attributes.name: short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated or commonly used trading name of the reinsurer used in bordereaux reports, internal systems, and operational communications.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; Reinsurance Management System (SICS/Sapiens ReinsurancePro)

attributes.name: sp_rating
attributes.description: S&P Global Ratings financial strength rating for the reinsurer. Supplementary credit quality indicator used alongside AM Best for counterparty risk assessment.
attributes.references: S&P Global Ratings; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: tax_withholding_rate
attributes.description: Federal excise tax or withholding rate applicable to premium payments to this reinsurer, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.01 = 1%). Applies to foreign unauthorized reinsurers per IRC Section 4371.
attributes.references: IRC Section 4371; IRS Publication 515; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the reinsurer master record was most recently modified. Used for change data capture, audit trails, and data quality monitoring in the Silver layer.

products.name: ri_participant
products.description: Allocation of a reinsurer's share within a treaty or FAC agreement. One row per reinsurer per agreement. Captures signed line percentage, written line percentage, and participation effective dates.

attributes.name: ri_participant_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a reinsurer's participation record within a treaty or facultative agreement. One row per reinsurer per agreement.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; IFRS 17; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: reinsurer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reinsurance.reinsurer. Business justification: ri_participant has reinsurer_party_id but also extensive denormalized reinsurer attributes.

attributes.name: ri_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent reinsurance agreement (treaty or facultative) under which this participation is recorded.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: ri_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reinsurance intermediary (broker) who placed this participant's line. Used for broker commission settlement and bordereaux routing.

attributes.name: ri_reinsurer_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Party record representing the reinsurer entity participating in this agreement.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; ACORD data standards

attributes.name: account_current_basis
attributes.description: Basis on which the account current (bordereaux) is prepared for this participant: written premium basis, earned premium basis, or cash basis.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F; IFRS 17

attributes.name: agreement_type
attributes.description: Type of reinsurance agreement: Quota Share (QS), Excess of Loss (XOL), Stop Loss (SL), Catastrophe XL (CAT XL), or Facultative (FAC). Determines cession and recovery mechanics.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R; IFRS 17

attributes.name: brokerage_commission_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of ceded premium payable to the reinsurance broker for placing this participant's line. Applied to the participant's share of written premium.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: ceding_commission_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of ceded premium returned to the cedant by this reinsurer as a ceding commission, covering acquisition and overhead costs. Applicable primarily to QS treaties.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F; IFRS 17

attributes.name: cession_share_pct
attributes.description: Effective share of each cession allocated to this participant, derived from signed line and order hereon. Used to compute this reinsurer's portion of premium and loss.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F; IFRS 17

attributes.name: commutation_amount
attributes.description: Lump-sum amount agreed upon in the commutation to settle all outstanding reserves and future obligations for this reinsurer's participation share.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F; IFRS 17

attributes.name: commutation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the commutation agreement was executed, extinguishing all future obligations between the cedant and this reinsurer under this participation.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: commutation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this participation has been commuted, meaning all outstanding obligations have been settled by a lump-sum payment and the agreement extinguished.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F; IFRS 17

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which premiums, losses, and settlements with this reinsurer are denominated (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR).
attributes.references: ISO 4217; NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: cut_through_clause_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a cut-through endorsement exists allowing the cedant's policyholders to claim directly against this reinsurer in the event of the cedant's insolvency.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Model Insolvency Law

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the reinsurer's participation in the agreement becomes binding and cessions may be allocated to this participant.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; IFRS 17; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the reinsurer's participation ends. Null for open-ended participations. Used to determine in-force panel at any given date.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; IFRS 17; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: funds_withheld_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the cedant withholds ceded premium from this reinsurer under a funds-withheld arrangement, used as collateral for unauthorized reinsurers.
attributes.references: NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law; SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: insolvency_clause_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the standard insolvency clause is included, requiring the reinsurer to pay claims even if the cedant becomes insolvent, per NAIC model law requirements.
attributes.references: NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: lc_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of the letter of credit posted by this reinsurer as collateral. Required for Schedule F credit for reinsurance calculations for unauthorized reinsurers.
attributes.references: NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law; NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: lc_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reinsurer is required to post a letter of credit as collateral for credit for reinsurance purposes under state regulation.
attributes.references: NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law; NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: offset_clause_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the participation agreement includes an offset clause allowing mutual debts between cedant and reinsurer to be netted in settlement.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: order_hereon_pct
attributes.description: The cedant's order percentage representing the total share of risk placed with the reinsurance market. Used to scale signed and written lines to the actual ceded amount.
attributes.references: Lloyd's Market Association (LMA); NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: participant_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique identifier assigned by the reinsurance management system to this participation line, used in bordereaux and Schedule F reporting.

attributes.name: participant_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the reinsurer's participation in the agreement. Controls whether cessions and recoveries can be posted against this participant.

attributes.name: participation_type
attributes.description: Classifies the reinsurer's role in the panel: leader sets terms, followers subscribe, sole reinsurer takes 100%. Drives bordereaux and settlement logic.
attributes.references: ACORD data standards; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: placement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the reinsurer's line was formally placed and agreed, which may precede the participation effective date. Used for audit trail and contract management.

attributes.name: profit_commission_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of underwriting profit returned to the cedant by this reinsurer under a profit commission clause. Calculated after losses and expenses against this participant's share.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: retrocession_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this participation is part of a retrocession arrangement where the reinsurer is itself ceding risk onward to a retrocessionaire.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: rol_pct
attributes.description: Rate on Line expressed as a percentage of the limit, representing the reinsurance premium as a proportion of the coverage limit for this participant's share. Key XOL pricing metric.
attributes.references: Lloyd's Market Association (LMA); NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: settlement_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which premium and loss accounts are settled between the cedant and this reinsurer. Drives bordereaux generation and cash settlement scheduling.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsurancePro; NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: signed_line_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of the agreement's risk that the reinsurer has formally signed and committed to. Signed lines across all participants must sum to 100% for a fully placed agreement.
attributes.references: Lloyd's Market Association (LMA); NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: signing_date
attributes.description: Date on which the reinsurer formally signed the slip or contract, confirming their committed signed line percentage. Distinct from placement date.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the originating reinsurance management system record (e.g., Sapiens ReinsurancePro participant ID) for lineage and reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the reinsurer's participation was terminated prior to the scheduled expiration date, such as due to insolvency, commutation, or mutual agreement.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for early termination of the reinsurer's participation. Used in commutation accounting and Schedule F disclosures.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: trust_fund_amount
attributes.description: Amount held in a reinsurance trust fund by this reinsurer as an alternative collateral mechanism for credit for reinsurance under NAIC model law.
attributes.references: NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law; NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: written_line_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of the agreement initially offered to and accepted by the reinsurer before signing-down. May differ from signed line when the placement is oversubscribed.
attributes.references: Lloyd's Market Association (LMA); NAIC Schedule F

products.name: reinsurance_cession
products.description: Records risk transfer of a policy term to a treaty layer or FAC. Grain: one row per policy term per treaty layer (or FAC). Direction flag (outward/retro) distinguishes cession from retrocession.

attributes.name: reinsurance_cession_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each cession record. One row per policy term per treaty layer or facultative agreement. Primary key of the cession table.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: catastrophe_event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the catastrophe event associated with this cession when is_catastrophe_cession is true. Links to the catastrophe event for PML and AAL aggregation.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; RMS RiskLink; Verisk AIR Touchstone

attributes.name: catastrophegeography_peril_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophegeography.peril. Business justification: Cessions must identify the triggering peril for treaty allocation, bordereaux reporting, Schedule F classification, and reinsurer accounting.

attributes.name: claimfinancials_accounting_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the accounting period in which this cession is booked for statutory and GAAP financial reporting purposes.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Annual Statement Schedule F

attributes.name: coverage_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to coverage.coverage. Business justification: Cessions record the actual transfer of risk to reinsurers. Premium and claim cessions must trace to the specific coverage being ceded for accurate bordereaux reporting, treaty allocation

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: Cession accounting requires currency master for exchange rate application, multi-currency premium and loss aggregation, and statutory reporting in reporting currency.

attributes.name: fac_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the facultative reinsurance agreement if this is a FAC cession. Null for treaty cessions.

attributes.name: line_of_business_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.line_of_business. Business justification: Cession accounting and bordereaux submission require LOB master for consistent line classification, treaty applicability rules, and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: policy_term_id
attributes.description: Reference to the policy term being ceded. Links the cession to the specific time-bounded policy period in force at the time of cession.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; Guidewire PolicyCenter Cession module

attributes.name: premium_transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to premium.premium_transaction. Business justification: Each cession records the reinsurance share of a specific gross premium transaction.

attributes.name: reinsurer_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reinsurer party accepting this cession. Supports multi-reinsurer panels where each reinsurer has a separate cession row.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: ri_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent reinsurance agreement (treaty or facultative) under which this cession is placed.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: riskexposure_insured_risk_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to riskexposure.insured_risk. Business justification: Cessions represent the actual transfer of specific risk exposure to reinsurers. Exposure management and catastrophe modeling require linking cessions to underlying insured risks to

attributes.name: treaty_layer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific treaty layer (e.g., first excess layer, second excess layer) within the reinsurance agreement to which this cession attaches.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: accident_year
attributes.description: Accident Year (AY) associated with losses ceded under this cession. Used for loss development triangles and IBNR reserving on ceded basis.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: agreement_type
attributes.description: Classifies the cession as treaty-based (automatic, per agreed terms) or facultative (individually negotiated per risk).

attributes.name: attachment_point
attributes.description: Dollar threshold at which the reinsurer's liability begins under an XOL or CAT XL treaty. Equivalent to the cedant's retention for excess layers.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; ISO XOL treaty standards

attributes.name: booking_date
attributes.description: Date on which this cession was recorded in the Reinsurance Management System and booked to the general ledger for statutory reporting.

attributes.name: bordereaux_period
attributes.description: Reporting period (YYYY-MM or YYYY-Q#) for which this cession is included in the reinsurance bordereaux submission to the reinsurer.
attributes.references: ACORD 790; NAIC Schedule F; Sapiens ReinsurancePro Bordereaux module

attributes.name: ceded_case_reserve
attributes.description: Reinsurer's share of the case reserve for known reported losses ceded under this cession. Used for ceded reserve reporting on Schedule F.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F; NAIC Schedule P

attributes.name: ceded_earned_premium
attributes.description: Portion of the ceded premium that has been earned as of the reporting date, based on the pro-rata exposure period elapsed.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F; IFRS 17

attributes.name: ceded_gwp
attributes.description: Gross Written Premium (GWP) ceded to the reinsurer for this policy term. Represents the cedant's cost of reinsurance before ceding commission.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Annual Statement Schedule F

attributes.name: ceded_ibnr_reserve
attributes.business_glossary_term: Ceded Incurred But Not Reported Reserve (IBNR)
attributes.description: Reinsurer's share of the IBNR reserve for losses incurred but not yet reported under this cession. Required for ceded IBNR disclosure on Schedule F.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F; NAIC Schedule P

tag_set.value: Ceded Incurred But Not Reported Reserve (IBNR)

attributes.name: ceded_limit
attributes.description: Maximum reinsurer liability under this cession. For XOL treaties, this is the layer limit; for QS, it is the proportional share of the policy limit.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: ceded_tiv
attributes.description: Total Insured Value (TIV) transferred to the reinsurer under this cession. Represents the gross exposure ceded for property lines.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F; ISO property rating

attributes.name: ceded_unearned_premium
attributes.description: Portion of the ceded premium not yet earned as of the reporting date. Represents the reinsurer's liability for the unexpired risk period.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Annual Statement Schedule F

attributes.name: ceding_commission_amount
attributes.description: Commission paid by the reinsurer to the cedant to offset acquisition and administrative costs. Reduces the net cost of reinsurance.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: ceding_commission_pct
attributes.description: Ceding commission expressed as a percentage of ceded written premium. Used to calculate the ceding commission amount for QS treaties.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: collateral_amount
attributes.description: Amount of collateral (letters of credit, trust funds) posted by an unauthorized reinsurer to secure their obligations under this cession.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; NAIC Model Credit for Reinsurance Law

attributes.name: collateral_type
attributes.description: Type of collateral instrument posted by the reinsurer to secure obligations. Required for unauthorized reinsurers per NAIC credit for reinsurance rules.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; NAIC Model Credit for Reinsurance Law

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cession record was first created in the Reinsurance Management System. Used for audit trail and data lineage.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is an outward cession (cedant to reinsurer) or a retrocession (reinsurer ceding further). Distinguishes primary cession from retro.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this cession becomes effective and the reinsurer assumes the ceded risk. Aligns with the policy term effective date for automatic treaty cessions.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: exhaustion_point
attributes.description: Dollar amount at which the reinsurer's layer is fully exhausted (attachment point plus ceded limit). Defines the upper boundary of the reinsurer's liability.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; ISO XOL treaty standards

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the cession expires and the reinsurer's liability ceases. Typically aligns with the policy term expiration date.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: funds_held_amount
attributes.description: Amount of reinsurance premium held by the cedant as funds held under the reinsurance agreement, rather than remitted to the reinsurer.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: is_catastrophe_cession
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cession is associated with a catastrophe event (CAT XL treaty). Flags cessions for CAT PML aggregation and catastrophe bordereaux reporting.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; RMS RiskLink CAT modeling

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this cession, used in bordereaux reporting and reinsurer correspondence. Assigned by the Reinsurance Management System.

attributes.name: policy_year
attributes.description: Policy Year (PY) in which the ceded policy term incepted. Used for actuarial loss development, Schedule P, and reinsurance year-of-account reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: rate_on_line
attributes.description: Rate on Line (ROL) expressed as a percentage of the ceded limit. Key pricing metric for XOL and CAT XL layers; equals ceded premium divided by ceded limit.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; ISO reinsurance pricing standards

attributes.name: reinsurance_cession_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the cession record within the reinsurance management workflow.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; Sapiens ReinsurancePro Cession module

attributes.name: reinsurer_authorization_status
attributes.description: NAIC authorization classification of the assuming reinsurer: authorized, accredited, certified, unauthorized, or reciprocal. Drives collateral and credit requirements.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; NAIC Model Credit for Reinsurance Law

attributes.name: reinsurer_domicile_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the reinsurer's domicile. Determines whether the reinsurer is authorized, accredited, or unauthorized under NAIC Schedule F.

attributes.name: reinsurer_naic_code
attributes.description: Five-digit NAIC company code of the assuming reinsurer. Required for NAIC Schedule F statutory reporting and reinsurer credit risk assessment.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; NAIC Company Code Registry

attributes.name: retention_amount
attributes.description: Amount retained by the cedant (Self-Insured Retention / SIR) before the reinsurer's liability attaches. Attachment point for XOL; retained share for QS.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: share_pct
attributes.description: Proportional share (as a percentage) ceded to the reinsurer. Applicable for Quota Share treaties. For XOL, this represents the reinsurer's participation percentage in the layer.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the originating Reinsurance Management System record (e.g., Sapiens ReinsurancePro cession ID or SICS record key) for traceability and reconciliation.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: treaty_type
attributes.description: Type of reinsurance treaty structure: Quota Share (QS), Excess of Loss (XOL), Stop Loss (SL), or Catastrophe Excess of Loss (CAT XL). Null for FAC cessions.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; ISO reinsurance standards

attributes.name: ultimate_net_loss
attributes.description: Ultimate Net Loss (UNL) ceded under this cession, representing the reinsurer's share of total incurred losses including LAE. Key metric for XOL treaty performance.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F; ISO reinsurance standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this cession record. Used for change tracking and incremental data pipeline processing.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

products.name: ri_premium_transaction
