products.description: Ceded premium ledger. One row per financial movement (written, earned, unearned, return, reinstatement) for a cession. FK to cession, accounting period, treaty layer. Reinstatement rows carry occurrence reference and reinstated limit.
products.reference: Ceded Premium Transaction / Schedule F Premium

attributes.name: ri_premium_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate key for each reinsurance ceded premium financial movement. One row per written, earned, unearned, return, or reinstatement transaction for a cession. TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: claimfinancials_accounting_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the accounting period (month/quarter/year) in which this reinsurance premium transaction is booked for statutory and GAAP financial reporting purposes.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement; SAP SSAP No. 62R; GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: fac_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reinsurance.fac_agreement. Business justification: Premium transactions can be for facultative placements in addition to treaty layers. Currently has treaty_layer_id. Adding optional fac_agreement_id for FAC premium transactions.

attributes.name: line_of_business_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.line_of_business. Business justification: Premium transactions must classify by line for GL coding, treaty allocation, and statutory accounting; LOB master provides chart of accounts mappings and ensures consistent line

attributes.name: original_transaction_id
attributes.description: For reversal or correction transactions, references the ri_premium_transaction_id of the original entry being reversed. Null for original transactions. Supports audit trail and net balance reconciliation.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the underlying direct policy whose premium is being ceded. Required for facultative cessions and policy-level bordereaux reporting under Schedule F.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: policy_term_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific policy term period for which ceded premium is being transacted. Enables reconstruction of in-force ceded premium at any historical date.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: premium_transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to premium.premium_transaction. Business justification: Reinsurance premium transactions must trace to the originating gross premium transaction for reconciliation, bordereaux preparation, ceded/net premium calculation, and regulatory

attributes.name: reinsurance_cession_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reinsurance cession record that this premium transaction belongs to. Links the financial movement to the specific risk ceded under a treaty or facultative agreement.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: reinsurer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reinsurer party record (assuming entity in the party domain) to whom the premium is ceded. Required for Schedule F counterparty-level reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: ri_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reinsurance agreement (treaty or facultative) under which this premium transaction is recorded. Supports bordereaux reporting and treaty-level premium aggregation.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: treaty_layer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific treaty layer (e.g., first excess, second excess) within a multi-layer XOL or CAT XL program to which this ceded premium is allocated.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; ISO Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: accident_year
attributes.description: The calendar year in which losses covered by this ceded premium are expected to occur. Used for accident year (AY) loss development triangles and actuarial reserving analysis.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP SSAP No. 62R; Actuarial Standards of Practice

attributes.name: accounting_date
attributes.description: The date on which this transaction is recognized in the general ledger and statutory accounts. May differ from transaction_date due to period-end cut-off adjustments.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; GAAP ASC 944; SOX

attributes.name: agreement_type
attributes.description: The structural type of the reinsurance agreement: Quota Share (QS), Excess of Loss (XOL), Stop Loss (SL), Catastrophe Excess of Loss (CAT XL), or Surplus Share.
attributes.value_regex: Quota Share|Excess of Loss|Stop Loss|CAT XL|Surplus Share
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: bordereaux_period
attributes.description: The YYYY-MM period for which this transaction is included in the reinsurance bordereaux submission to the reinsurer. Format: YYYY-MM. Drives bordereaux extract and reinsurer statement reconciliation.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; ACORD Standards; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: bordereaux_status
attributes.description: Tracks the submission lifecycle of this transaction in the reinsurance bordereaux process. Acknowledged by reinsurer confirms premium settlement; Disputed triggers reconciliation workflow.

attributes.name: ceded_earned_premium
attributes.description: The pro-rata portion of ceded written premium recognized as earned during the accounting period. Used for ceded loss ratio and earned premium calculations in Schedule P and Schedule F.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule P; GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: ceded_unearned_premium
attributes.description: The portion of ceded written premium not yet earned as of the accounting date. Represents the reinsurer's liability for the unexpired policy period. Required for NAIC Annual Statement balance sheet.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Annual Statement; GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: ceded_written_premium
attributes.description: The portion of written premium transferred to the reinsurer under this cession. For QS treaties, equals GWP multiplied by the cession percentage. Core field for NWP and DPW calculations.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F; GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: ceding_commission
attributes.description: Commission paid by the reinsurer to the cedant to offset acquisition and administrative costs. Expressed as a flat amount per transaction. Reduces the net cost of reinsurance.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F; GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: ceding_commission_rate
attributes.description: The rate applied to ceded written premium to calculate the ceding commission (e.g., 0.2500 = 25%). Used for sliding-scale commission calculations under profit-sharing treaties.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: cession_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the underlying risk ceded to the reinsurer under a quota share or surplus share treaty (e.g., 0.3000 = 30%). Null for XOL treaties where cession is event-triggered.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: cession_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the ceded premium relates to a treaty arrangement, a facultative (FAC) placement, or a retrocession. Drives bordereaux format and Schedule F classification.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R; ISO Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this reinsurance premium transaction record was first created in the reinsurance management system (Sapiens ReinsurancePro or SICS).

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this transaction (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Required for multi-currency reinsurance programs and foreign reinsurer reporting.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Exchange rate used to convert foreign currency amounts to the cedant's functional reporting currency (USD). Applied as of the accounting_date for statutory reporting purposes.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 23; IFRS 17

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The general ledger account code to which this reinsurance premium transaction is posted in the statutory accounting system (Oracle/SAP GL). Required for Schedule F and NAIC Annual Statement mapping.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Annual Statement; SOX

attributes.name: gross_written_premium
attributes.description: The total direct written premium on the underlying policy before any reinsurance cession. Base for calculating the ceded share under quota share or facultative agreements.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Annual Statement; GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: occurrence_reference_code
attributes.description: Reference to the loss occurrence or catastrophe event that triggered a reinstatement premium. Populated only for transaction_type = Reinstatement. Links to the loss event record.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; ISO Reinsurance Standards; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: policy_effective_date
attributes.description: The date the underlying direct policy became effective. Used to assign the ceded premium to the correct policy year (PY) for actuarial and Schedule P/F reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: policy_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date the underlying direct policy expires. Used to calculate the unearned premium period and pro-rata earning of ceded premium over the policy term.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: policy_year
attributes.description: The year in which the underlying policy was written. Used for policy year (PY) experience analysis and reinsurance program performance monitoring per NAIC Schedule F.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; NAIC Schedule P; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: profit_commission
attributes.description: Contingent commission earned by the cedant when the reinsurer's loss ratio on the treaty falls below a specified threshold. Booked as a reduction in net reinsurance cost.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: rate_on_line
attributes.description: The reinsurance premium expressed as a percentage of the treaty limit (ROL = premium / limit). Key pricing metric for XOL and CAT XL treaties used in actuarial and underwriting analysis.
attributes.references: ISO Reinsurance Standards; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: reinstated_limit
attributes.description: The amount of treaty limit reinstated following a loss occurrence, for which the reinstatement_premium is charged. Applicable only when transaction_type = Reinstatement.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; ISO Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: reinstatement_premium
attributes.description: Additional premium paid to the reinsurer to reinstate exhausted treaty limit following a loss occurrence. Applicable to XOL and CAT XL treaties. Linked to occurrence_reference_id.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; ISO Reinsurance Standards; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: reporting_currency_amount
attributes.description: Ceded written premium converted to the cedant's statutory reporting currency (USD) using the exchange_rate. Used for NAIC Annual Statement and Schedule F USD-denominated filings.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 23; NAIC Annual Statement

attributes.name: return_premium
attributes.description: Premium returned to the cedant from the reinsurer due to policy cancellation, mid-term endorsement reducing exposure, or audit adjustment. Negative impact on ceded written premium.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transaction is a reversal of a previously posted reinsurance premium entry. True = reversal transaction. Used for audit trail and net premium reconciliation.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to premium.premium_transaction. Business justification: Bordereaux lines report individual cessions to reinsurers with transaction-level detail.

attributes.name: reinsurance_cession_id
attributes.description: Reference to the underlying cession record that this bordereaux line represents. Links to the Cession entity in the reinsurance domain.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsurancePro Cession Module; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: reinsurer_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reinsurer party record. Identifies the specific reinsurance counterparty receiving this cession for credit risk and Schedule F counterparty reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP/SSAP No. 62; Customer/Party MDM; Sapiens ReinsurancePro

attributes.name: ri_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reinsurance agreement (treaty or facultative) under which this cession is reported.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsurancePro Treaty/Facultative Module; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: agreement_number
attributes.description: Human-readable external identifier of the reinsurance treaty or facultative agreement under which this cession is reported. Used in bordereaux submissions to reinsurers.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsurancePro; NAIC Schedule F; ACORD 715

attributes.name: agreement_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the cession is under a treaty (automatic) or facultative (individually negotiated) reinsurance agreement.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; Sapiens ReinsurancePro; ISO reinsurance standards

attributes.name: attachment_point
attributes.description: The loss threshold at which the XOL or CAT XL reinsurance layer attaches for this cession. Losses below this amount are retained by the cedant.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsurancePro Treaty Module; ISO reinsurance standards; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: bordereaux_line_type
attributes.description: Classifies the nature of this bordereaux line: premium cession, claim cession, adjustment, return premium, or reinstatement. Drives financial processing logic.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsurancePro; NAIC Schedule F; ISO reinsurance standards

attributes.name: catastrophe_code
attributes.description: Industry or internal catastrophe event code (e.g., PCS event number) associated with this cession line. Denormalized for bordereaux reporting and CAT XL aggregation.
attributes.references: PCS (Property Claim Services); RMS RiskLink; NAIC CAT reporting standards

attributes.name: ceded_earned_premium
attributes.description: The portion of earned premium ceded to the reinsurer for the reporting period. Used for loss ratio calculations and IFRS 17 insurance revenue reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP/SSAP No. 62; IFRS 17; Sapiens ReinsurancePro

attributes.name: ceded_ibnr_reserve
attributes.business_glossary_term: Ceded Incurred But Not Reported (IBNR) Reserve
attributes.description: Reinsurer's share of IBNR reserves allocated to this cession line. Used in actuarial reserving and Schedule F statutory reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP/SSAP No. 62; IFRS 17; Actuarial Standards of Practice

tag_set.value: Ceded Incurred But Not Reported (IBNR) Reserve

attributes.name: ceded_lae_paid
attributes.description: Loss Adjustment Expense (LAE) paid by the reinsurer under this cession line. Includes ALAE and ULAE components ceded per agreement terms.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP/SSAP No. 62; Sapiens ReinsurancePro; NAIC LAE definitions

attributes.name: ceded_lae_reserve
attributes.description: Outstanding LAE reserve amount ceded to the reinsurer for this line. Represents the reinsurer's share of unpaid loss adjustment expenses.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP/SSAP No. 62; IFRS 17; Sapiens ReinsurancePro

attributes.name: ceded_loss_paid
attributes.description: Losses paid by the reinsurer under this cession line to date. Represents actual cash recoveries received from the reinsurer for indemnity payments.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP/SSAP No. 62; Guidewire ClaimCenter; Sapiens ReinsurancePro

attributes.name: ceded_loss_reserve
attributes.description: Outstanding case reserve amount ceded to the reinsurer for this line. Represents the reinsurer's share of unpaid loss reserves (OSLR/RBNS).
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP/SSAP No. 62; IFRS 17; Sapiens ReinsurancePro

attributes.name: ceded_unearned_premium
attributes.description: The unearned portion of ceded written premium as of the reporting date. Represents the reinsurer's liability for unexpired risk. Used in balance sheet reserving.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP/SSAP No. 62; IFRS 17

attributes.name: ceded_written_premium
attributes.description: The portion of written premium ceded to the reinsurer under this agreement for this line. Key metric for Schedule F and bordereaux reporting. Expressed in reporting currency.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP/SSAP No. 62; IFRS 17; Sapiens ReinsurancePro Bordereaux Module

attributes.name: ceding_commission_amount
attributes.description: Commission paid by the reinsurer to the cedant on ceded premium for this line. Offsets acquisition costs. Applicable to quota share and surplus treaties.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 62; NAIC Schedule F; Sapiens ReinsurancePro Treaty Module

attributes.name: ceding_commission_rate
attributes.description: The contractual rate applied to ceded premium to compute the ceding commission (e.g., 0.2500 = 25%). Defined in the reinsurance agreement terms.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 62; NAIC Schedule F; Sapiens ReinsurancePro Treaty Module

attributes.name: cession_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the risk ceded to the reinsurer under this agreement line (e.g., 0.3000 = 30%). Applicable primarily to quota share treaties.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsurancePro Cession Module; NAIC Schedule F; ISO reinsurance standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this bordereaux line record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements per SOX and MAR.
attributes.references: SOX; NAIC Model Audit Rule (MAR); GLBA; SAP/SSAP No. 62

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this bordereaux line (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multi-currency reinsurance agreements.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; NAIC Schedule F; IFRS 17; SAP/SSAP No. 62

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Foreign exchange rate used to convert cession amounts to the reporting currency. Applicable when the ceded policy is denominated in a currency other than USD.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; NAIC Schedule F; IFRS 17; SAP/SSAP No. 23

attributes.name: gross_written_premium
attributes.description: Total gross written premium on the ceded policy for the cession period before reinsurance. Basis for computing ceded written premium. Expressed in reporting currency.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement; SAP/SSAP No. 62; IFRS 17; Sapiens ReinsurancePro

attributes.name: insured_name
attributes.description: Name of the insured party on the ceded policy as reported on the bordereaux. Required by reinsurers for risk identification and facultative certificate matching.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; ACORD 125; Sapiens ReinsurancePro Bordereaux Module

attributes.name: is_retrocession
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cession line represents a retrocession (cession of assumed reinsurance) rather than a direct cession. True = retrocession; False = direct cession.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP/SSAP No. 62; Sapiens ReinsurancePro Retrocession Module

attributes.name: line_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number of this record within the parent bordereaux run. Used for ordering, reconciliation, and error identification during bordereaux processing.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsurancePro Bordereaux Module; ACORD data standards

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current processing status of this bordereaux line in the reinsurer settlement workflow. Tracks lifecycle from draft through acceptance or dispute resolution.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsurancePro Bordereaux Module; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: loss_date
attributes.description: Date of the insured loss event for claim-cession lines. Used to determine treaty year applicability (accident year basis) and XOL layer attachment. Null for premium lines.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; NAIC Schedule P; Sapiens ReinsurancePro

attributes.name: policy_effective_date
attributes.description: The date the ceded policy term became effective. Used to determine the applicable treaty year and cession period for bordereaux allocation.
attributes.references: Guidewire PolicyCenter; NAIC Schedule F; ACORD 125

attributes.name: policy_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date the ceded policy term expires. Used with effective date to compute the cession period and pro-rata premium calculations.
attributes.references: Guidewire PolicyCenter; NAIC Schedule F; ACORD 125

attributes.name: rate_on_line
attributes.description: Rate on Line (ROL) expressed as a decimal — the ratio of reinsurance premium to the reinsurer's limit. Key pricing metric for XOL and CAT XL treaties.
attributes.references: ISO reinsurance standards; Sapiens ReinsurancePro Treaty Module; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: reinsurer_limit
attributes.description: Maximum amount the reinsurer is liable to pay above the attachment point for this cession line. Defines the XOL layer limit (e.g., $5M xs $1M).
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsurancePro Treaty Module; ISO reinsurance standards; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: reinsurer_share_percentage
attributes.description: The specific reinsurer's participation percentage in the reinsurance agreement for this line (e.g., 0.5000 = 50% of a 100% placed treaty layer).
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsurancePro Treaty Module; NAIC Schedule F; ISO reinsurance standards

attributes.name: report_date
attributes.description: Date the claim was first reported (FNOL date) for claim-cession lines. Used for IBNR analysis and claims-made policy trigger determination.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; NAIC Schedule P; ACORD 715

attributes.name: reporting_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the reporting period covered by this bordereaux line. Together with start date defines the bordereaux reporting window.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; Sapiens ReinsurancePro Bordereaux Module; IFRS 17

attributes.name: reporting_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the reporting period covered by this bordereaux line. Defines the window for premium and loss movements included in this submission.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; Sapiens ReinsurancePro Bordereaux Module; IFRS 17

attributes.name: retention_amount
attributes.description: The cedant's net retained loss amount for this cession line after reinsurance recovery. For XOL treaties, this is the SIR/retention layer below the attachment point.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsurancePro; NAIC Schedule F; ISO reinsurance standards

attributes.name: source_system_reference
attributes.description: The originating system's unique identifier for this bordereaux line record (e.g., Sapiens ReinsurancePro internal line ID). Supports data lineage and reconciliation.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsurancePro Bordereaux Module; NAIC Schedule F reconciliation

attributes.name: treaty_type
attributes.description: Specific treaty structure: Quota Share (QS), Excess of Loss (XOL), Stop Loss (SL), Catastrophe Excess of Loss (CAT XL), or Surplus. Determines cession calculation method.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; Sapiens ReinsurancePro Treaty Module; ISO reinsurance standards

attributes.name: treaty_year
attributes.description: The underwriting or accident year of the reinsurance treaty applicable to this cession line. Used for treaty-year loss development and Schedule F segmentation.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP/SSAP No. 62; Sapiens ReinsurancePro Treaty Module

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this bordereaux line record was last modified. Used for incremental data processing, change detection, and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: SOX; NAIC Model Audit Rule (MAR); GLBA; Sapiens ReinsurancePro

products.name: ri_reinstatement
products.description: Records the reinstatement of treaty limit after a loss occurrence exhausts a layer. One row per reinstatement event per treaty layer. Captures reinstatement premium, reinstated limit, occurrence reference, and effective date.

attributes.name: ri_reinstatement_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate primary key for each treaty layer reinstatement event. One row per reinstatement event per treaty layer occurrence.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; Reinsurance Management System (Sapiens ReinsurancePro)

attributes.name: catastrophe_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophegeography.catastrophe_event. Business justification: Reinstatements are triggered by specific catastrophe events exhausting layer limits.

attributes.name: catastrophegeography_peril_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophegeography.peril. Business justification: Reinstatements are peril-specific (e.g., hurricane layer exhaustion triggers hurricane reinstatement premium).

attributes.name: claimfinancials_accounting_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the accounting period in which the reinstatement premium is booked for statutory and GAAP financial reporting.

attributes.name: line_of_business_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.line_of_business. Business justification: Reinstatement premium calculations are line-specific; LOB master provides rate-on-line benchmarks and treaty term applicability by line for accurate premium computation and treaty

attributes.name: reinsurance_cession_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cession record associated with the loss occurrence that triggered this reinstatement, linking ceded exposure to the reinstated layer.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; Reinsurance Management System (Sapiens ReinsurancePro)

attributes.name: reinsurer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reinsurance.reinsurer. Business justification: Reinstatements track premium per reinsurer (reinsurer_share_pct, reinsurer_reinstatement_premium_amt). Should have FK to reinsurer master for reinsurer attributes.

attributes.name: ri_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent reinsurance agreement (contract) under which the treaty layer and this reinstatement event exist.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; Reinsurance Management System (Sapiens ReinsurancePro)

attributes.name: treaty_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reinsurance treaty under which this reinstatement is triggered. Links to the Treaty master record.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; Reinsurance Management System (Sapiens ReinsurancePro)

attributes.name: treaty_layer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reinsurance.treaty_layer. Business justification: Reinstatements occur at the layer level (when a layer limit is exhausted and reinstated). Currently has treaty_id, but reinstatements are layer-specific for XOL/CAT XL structures.

attributes.name: bordereaux_period
attributes.description: Year-month (YYYY-MM) reporting period in which this reinstatement is included on the reinsurance bordereaux submitted to the reinsurer for reconciliation.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; Reinsurance Bordereaux & Regulatory Reporting Repository

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this reinstatement record was first created in the Reinsurance Management System, used for audit trail and data lineage.
attributes.references: SOX; NAIC Model Audit Rule (MAR); Reinsurance Management System (Sapiens ReinsurancePro)

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for a disputed reinstatement status, capturing reinsurer objections or cedant counter-arguments for resolution tracking.
attributes.references: Reinsurance Management System (Sapiens ReinsurancePro); NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the reinstatement premium must be paid to the reinsurer per the treaty credit terms, used for cash flow and delinquency tracking.
attributes.references: Reinsurance Management System (Sapiens ReinsurancePro); NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the reinstated treaty layer limit becomes effective and available for future losses, as agreed with the reinsurer.
attributes.references: Reinsurance Management System (Sapiens ReinsurancePro); NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: exhausted_limit_amt
attributes.description: The amount of the treaty layer limit that was exhausted by the triggering loss occurrence, forming the basis for calculating the reinstatement premium.
attributes.references: Reinsurance Management System (Sapiens ReinsurancePro); NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the reinstated limit expires, typically aligned with the treaty year end or a specific occurrence-based expiry per treaty wording.
attributes.references: Reinsurance Management System (Sapiens ReinsurancePro); NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General Ledger account code to which the reinstatement premium expense is posted in the statutory and GAAP accounting systems for financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP; US GAAP (FASB); IFRS 17; Oracle/SAP GL

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: Date on which the reinstatement premium invoice or debit note was issued to the reinsurer for settlement.

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: Invoice or debit note number issued to the reinsurer for the reinstatement premium, used for accounts payable reconciliation and bordereaux reporting.
attributes.references: Reinsurance Management System (Sapiens ReinsurancePro); NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: is_automatic
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reinstatement is triggered automatically upon layer exhaustion (true) or requires explicit reinsurer consent and notification (false).
attributes.references: Reinsurance Management System (Sapiens ReinsurancePro); ACORD data standards

attributes.name: is_free_reinstatement
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reinstatement is provided at no additional premium cost per treaty wording (true = free reinstatement; false = premium-bearing reinstatement).
attributes.references: Reinsurance Management System (Sapiens ReinsurancePro); ACORD data standards

attributes.name: layer_limit_amt
attributes.description: The original per-occurrence limit of the treaty layer being reinstated, expressed in the treaty currency. Represents the maximum ceded recovery per occurrence.
attributes.references: Reinsurance Management System (Sapiens ReinsurancePro); NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: max_reinstatements_allowed
attributes.description: Maximum number of reinstatements permitted under the treaty layer per treaty year as specified in the treaty wording, used to validate reinstatement_sequence.
attributes.references: Reinsurance Management System (Sapiens ReinsurancePro); ACORD data standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes or comments entered by the reinsurance analyst regarding special conditions, treaty wording interpretations, or settlement instructions.

attributes.name: occurrence_date
attributes.description: Date of the loss occurrence that triggered the layer exhaustion and necessitated this reinstatement, used for accident year and treaty year attribution.
attributes.references: ISO; NAIC Schedule F; Reinsurance Management System (Sapiens ReinsurancePro)

attributes.name: occurrence_reference
attributes.description: External reference code or name for the loss occurrence that exhausted the layer (e.g., CAT event code, storm name, occurrence number per treaty wording).
attributes.references: ISO; RMS RiskLink; Reinsurance Management System (Sapiens ReinsurancePro)

attributes.name: occurrence_reference_code
attributes.description: Reference to the loss occurrence or catastrophe event that exhausted the treaty layer and triggered this reinstatement.

attributes.name: original_premium_basis_amt
attributes.description: The original treaty premium (annual deposit or minimum premium) used as the basis for computing the reinstatement premium under pro-rata-of-original-premium treaty structures.
attributes.references: Reinsurance Management System (Sapiens ReinsurancePro); NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the reinstatement premium was remitted to the reinsurer, used for cash settlement reconciliation and Schedule F reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP/SSAP; Reinsurance Management System (Sapiens ReinsurancePro)

attributes.name: payment_reference
attributes.description: Wire transfer, check, or settlement reference number confirming remittance of the reinstatement premium to the reinsurer.

attributes.name: pro_rata_factor
attributes.description: Pro-rata time adjustment factor applied when the reinstatement is time-limited (e.g., reinstated limit covers only a partial treaty year), reducing the reinstatement premium accordingly.
attributes.references: Reinsurance Management System (Sapiens ReinsurancePro); ACORD data standards

attributes.name: reinstated_limit_amt
attributes.description: The amount of treaty layer limit reinstated by this event. May equal the full layer limit or a partial amount if only partially exhausted or partially reinstated.
attributes.references: Reinsurance Management System (Sapiens ReinsurancePro); NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: reinstatement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this reinstatement event, assigned by the Reinsurance Management System for bordereaux and counterparty communication.
attributes.references: ACORD data standards; Reinsurance Management System (Sapiens ReinsurancePro)

attributes.name: reinstatement_premium_amt
attributes.description: Gross reinstatement premium payable to the reinsurer for restoring the exhausted layer limit, calculated as reinstated limit multiplied by the reinstatement premium rate.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP/SSAP; Reinsurance Management System (Sapiens ReinsurancePro)

attributes.name: reinstatement_premium_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the reinstatement premium amount (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR), matching the treaty settlement currency.

attributes.name: reinstatement_premium_rate
attributes.description: Rate on Line (ROL) percentage applied to the reinstated limit to calculate the reinstatement premium due, as specified in the treaty wording (e.g., 100% pro-rata, 50%).
attributes.references: Reinsurance Management System (Sapiens ReinsurancePro); ACORD data standards

attributes.name: reinstatement_sequence
attributes.description: Ordinal sequence of this reinstatement within the treaty layer for the treaty year (1st reinstatement, 2nd reinstatement, etc.), as defined in the treaty wording.
attributes.references: Reinsurance Management System (Sapiens ReinsurancePro); ACORD data standards

attributes.name: reinstatement_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the reinstatement event, tracking progression from pending confirmation through premium invoicing and payment settlement.
attributes.references: Reinsurance Management System (Sapiens ReinsurancePro); NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: reinstatement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the reinstatement as automatic (triggered by loss), conditional (subject to reinsurer consent), free (no additional premium), or paid (premium-bearing).
attributes.references: Reinsurance Management System (Sapiens ReinsurancePro); ACORD data standards

attributes.name: reinsurer_confirmation_ref
attributes.description: Reference number or acknowledgment code provided by the reinsurer confirming acceptance of the reinstatement, required for conditional reinstatements.
attributes.references: Reinsurance Management System (Sapiens ReinsurancePro); ACORD data standards

attributes.name: reinsurer_reinstatement_premium_amt
attributes.description: Reinsurer's proportional share of the reinstatement premium, derived from the gross reinstatement premium multiplied by the reinsurer share percentage.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; Reinsurance Management System (Sapiens ReinsurancePro)

attributes.name: reinsurer_share_pct
attributes.description: Percentage share of the treaty layer held by the reinsurer (or lead reinsurer on a co-reinsurance panel), used to apportion the reinstated limit and reinstatement premium.
attributes.references: Reinsurance Management System (Sapiens ReinsurancePro); NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: retention_amt
attributes.description: The cedant's retained loss amount (attachment point or SIR) below the reinstated treaty layer, confirming the layer structure at the time of reinstatement.
attributes.references: Reinsurance Management System (Sapiens ReinsurancePro); NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational source system from which this reinstatement record was ingested (e.g., SAPIENS_RI, SICS), supporting data lineage in the lakehouse.
attributes.references: Reinsurance Bordereaux & Regulatory Reporting Repository; Data Warehouse

attributes.name: treaty_year
attributes.description: The underwriting or treaty year (e.g., 2024) to which this reinstatement belongs, used for Schedule F and bordereaux reporting by treaty year.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this reinstatement record, supporting audit trail requirements and change tracking for regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: SOX; NAIC Model Audit Rule (MAR); Reinsurance Management System (Sapiens ReinsurancePro)

products.name: ri_settlement
products.description: Net cash settlement between cedant and reinsurer, per reinsurer per period, netting ceded premium payable against loss recoverable. Includes profit commission (loss ratio, sliding-scale rate, commission amount) as a settlement component.

attributes.name: ri_settlement_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate primary key for each reinsurance net cash settlement record between cedant and reinsurer per period.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: claimfinancials_accounting_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the accounting period (calendar quarter or month) to which this settlement belongs for statutory and GAAP reporting.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Annual Statement

attributes.name: line_of_business_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.line_of_business. Business justification: Settlement reconciliation by line requires LOB master for consistent line classification across cedant and reinsurer accounting, treaty allocation rules, and regulatory reporting

attributes.name: reinsurer_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party record identifying the reinsurer counterparty for this settlement.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; ACORD data standards

attributes.name: ri_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reinsurance agreement (treaty or facultative) under which this settlement is calculated.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: treaty_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reinsurance.treaty. Business justification: Settlements can be at treaty level in addition to agreement level. Currently only has reinsurance_agreement_id. Adding optional treaty_id for treaty-specific settlements.

attributes.name: treaty_layer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reinsurance.treaty_layer. Business justification: Settlements can be at layer level for XOL/CAT XL treaties. Adding optional treaty_layer_id for layer-specific settlements. Populated when settlement is at specific layer level.

attributes.name: adjustment_premium_amount
attributes.description: Premium adjustment amount resulting from audit or retrospective rating, representing the difference between deposit and final premium.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: agreement_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the settlement relates to a treaty or facultative reinsurance agreement.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the settlement was formally approved by the authorized approver in the reinsurance management system.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or user identifier of the individual who approved this settlement, supporting SOX segregation of duties and audit trail.

attributes.name: authorized_reinsurer_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reinsurer is authorized/accredited in the cedant's state of domicile, affecting Schedule F credit for reinsurance.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; State DOI regulations

attributes.name: bordereaux_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the bordereaux submission to the reinsurer that supports the cession and loss data underlying this settlement.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; ACORD data standards

attributes.name: ceded_premium_earned_amount
attributes.description: Portion of ceded written premium earned during the settlement period, used for loss ratio and profit commission calculations.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F; IFRS 17

attributes.name: ceded_premium_written_amount
attributes.description: Gross written premium ceded to the reinsurer for the settlement period, representing the cedant's premium payable obligation.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F; IFRS 17

attributes.name: ceded_unearned_premium_amount
attributes.description: Unearned portion of ceded written premium as of the settlement period end, representing the reinsurer's liability for unexpired risk.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: ceding_commission_amount
attributes.description: Commission paid by the reinsurer to the cedant as a percentage of ceded premium, offsetting the cedant's acquisition and overhead costs.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: cession_share_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of risk ceded to this reinsurer under a quota share or surplus share treaty, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.3000 = 30%).
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: collateral_held_amount
attributes.description: Amount of collateral (letters of credit, trust funds) held by the cedant from an unauthorized reinsurer to support Schedule F credit.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this settlement record was first created in the reinsurance management system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this settlement record (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR).

attributes.name: deposit_premium_amount
attributes.description: Provisional deposit premium paid to the reinsurer at inception, subject to adjustment at final audit based on actual subject premium.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for a disputed settlement, capturing the nature of the disagreement between cedant and reinsurer.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Standards; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_date
attributes.description: Date on which a disputed settlement was formally resolved and agreed between the cedant and reinsurer.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Standards; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Contractual date by which the net settlement payment must be remitted per the reinsurance agreement terms.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: funds_withheld_amount
attributes.description: Amount of ceded premium withheld by the cedant as collateral under a funds-withheld reinsurance arrangement, reducing the cash settlement.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code to which the net settlement amount is posted in the statutory and GAAP accounting systems.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; SOX; GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: interest_on_funds_withheld_amount
attributes.description: Interest credited to the reinsurer on funds withheld by the cedant, per the contractual interest rate in the reinsurance agreement.

attributes.name: payment_date

products.name: repair_estimate
products.description: Property or auto repair estimate associated with a claim exposure. Grain: one row per estimate. Captures estimator, repair facility, estimate date, line-item costs, agreed value, and supplement history.

attributes.name: repair_estimate_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the repair estimate record.

attributes.name: approved_by_adjuster_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the adjuster who approved this repair estimate.

attributes.name: claim_exposure_id
attributes.description: Links this estimate to the specific claim exposure (coverage line) being repaired.

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Parent claim for which this repair estimate was prepared.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this estimate.

attributes.name: estimator_party_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to party.party. Business justification: Estimators/appraisers are licensed parties (individuals or organizations) tracked for quality control, licensing verification, and vendor performance management.

attributes.name: prior_estimate_repair_estimate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the previous estimate that this supplement or revision supersedes.

attributes.name: agreed_amount
attributes.description: Final negotiated and agreed repair cost between insurer, insured, and repair facility, in policy currency.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date the estimate was approved by the adjuster or claims handler.

attributes.name: betterment_amount
attributes.description: Amount deducted from the estimate for betterment (improvement over pre-loss condition), in policy currency.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this repair estimate record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: damage_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the damage observed during inspection, including scope and severity.

attributes.name: deductible_applied_amount
attributes.description: Policy deductible amount applied to this repair estimate, in policy currency.

attributes.name: depreciation_amount
attributes.description: Amount deducted for depreciation of parts or materials (Actual Cash Value adjustment), in policy currency.

attributes.name: document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URI to the stored estimate document (PDF, image, or system file).

attributes.name: estimate_date
attributes.description: Date the repair estimate was prepared or issued by the estimator or repair facility.

attributes.name: estimate_method
attributes.description: Method used to prepare the estimate: manual, software-assisted, photo-based, AI-driven, or field inspection.

attributes.name: estimate_notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to the repair estimate.

attributes.name: estimate_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the repair estimate, often assigned by the estimator or repair facility.

attributes.name: estimate_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the repair estimate in the adjudication workflow.

attributes.name: estimate_type
attributes.description: Classification of the estimate: initial assessment, supplement for additional damage, revised, final agreed value, desk review, or field inspection.

attributes.name: estimating_software
attributes.description: Name and version of the estimating software used (e.g., CCC ONE, Mitchell, Xactimate).

attributes.name: estimator_type
attributes.description: Classification of who prepared the estimate: staff adjuster, independent adjuster, repair shop, third-party appraiser, or insured self-estimate.

attributes.name: inspection_date
attributes.description: Date the physical inspection of the damaged property or vehicle was conducted.

attributes.name: labor_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total labor cost for the repair work, in policy currency.

attributes.name: labor_hours
attributes.description: Total estimated labor hours required to complete the repair work.

attributes.name: labor_rate_per_hour
attributes.description: Hourly labor rate charged by the repair facility, in policy currency.

attributes.name: net_payable_amount
attributes.description: Net amount payable by the insurer after deductible, depreciation, and betterment adjustments, in policy currency.

attributes.name: paint_materials_cost_amount
attributes.description: Cost of paint, finishing materials, and supplies for auto or property restoration, in policy currency.

attributes.name: parts_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total cost of parts and materials required for the repair, in policy currency.

attributes.name: parts_source
attributes.description: Classification of parts to be used: OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer), aftermarket, recycled, refurbished, or used.

attributes.name: photo_count
attributes.description: Number of photos or images attached to document the damage and support the estimate.

attributes.name: repair_facility_address
attributes.description: Physical address of the repair facility or contractor location.

attributes.name: repair_facility_name
attributes.description: Name of the repair shop, body shop, contractor, or service provider that will perform or bid on the repairs.

attributes.name: repair_facility_phone
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the repair facility or contractor.

attributes.name: repair_facility_type
attributes.description: Classification of the repair facility: network shop, preferred vendor, OEM certified, independent, contractor, or restoration company.

attributes.name: repair_scope_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the proposed repair work, including materials, labor, and methods.

attributes.name: sublet_cost_amount
attributes.description: Cost of subcontracted or outsourced work (e.g., glass, upholstery, specialty trades), in policy currency.

attributes.name: supplement_number
attributes.description: Sequential number indicating this is the Nth supplement to the original estimate (0 for initial estimate).

attributes.name: supplement_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why a supplemental estimate was required (e.g., hidden damage discovered, scope change, price adjustment).

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Sales tax or other applicable taxes on the repair estimate, in policy currency.

attributes.name: total_estimate_amount
attributes.description: Total estimated cost of the repair including parts, labor, materials, sublet, and taxes, in policy currency.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this repair estimate record was last modified.

products.name: salvage_disposition

attributes.name: salvage_disposition_id

attributes.name: adjuster_id

attributes.name: claim_exposure_id

attributes.name: claim_id

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this disposition record.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the salvage vendor, auction house, or third-party recovery agent handling the disposition.

attributes.name: salvage_party_id

attributes.name: salvage_subrogation_target_party_id

attributes.name: abandonment_reason

attributes.name: actual_salvage_value

attributes.name: buyer_name

attributes.name: closed_date

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: disposition_notes

attributes.name: disposition_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for this salvage or subrogation disposition record.

attributes.name: disposition_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the salvage or subrogation pursuit.

attributes.name: estimated_salvage_value
attributes.description: Estimated market value of the salvaged property at the time of disposition opening.

attributes.name: litigation_filed_date
attributes.description: Date when legal action was filed for subrogation recovery.

attributes.name: litigation_status
attributes.description: Current status of any legal action associated with subrogation pursuit.

attributes.name: net_recovery_amount
attributes.description: Net amount recovered after deducting all recovery expenses from gross salvage or subrogation proceeds.

attributes.name: opened_date

attributes.name: recovery_expenses

attributes.name: recovery_type
attributes.description: Type of recovery pursuit: salvage from damaged property, subrogation from liable third party, reinsurance recovery, or other.

attributes.name: sale_date

attributes.name: sale_method
attributes.description: Method used to dispose of salvaged property: auction, private sale, scrap, donation, retained by insured, or other.

attributes.name: salvage_item_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the salvaged property or damaged goods being recovered.

attributes.name: salvage_item_type
attributes.description: Category of salvaged item: vehicle total loss, building materials, equipment, inventory, personal property, or other.

attributes.name: settlement_date

attributes.name: storage_end_date

attributes.name: storage_location

attributes.name: storage_start_date
attributes.description: Date when salvaged property was placed into storage.

attributes.name: subrogation_demand_amount
attributes.description: Total amount demanded from the liable third party in subrogation pursuit.

attributes.name: subrogation_recovered_amount

attributes.name: subrogation_target_name
attributes.description: Name of the liable third party or entity against whom subrogation is pursued.

attributes.name: title_status
attributes.description: Legal title status of salvaged vehicle or property: clean, salvage, rebuilt, junk, pending transfer, or not applicable.

attributes.name: title_transfer_date
attributes.description: Date when legal title of salvaged property was transferred to the insurer or buyer.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this salvage disposition record was last modified.

attributes.name: vehicle_vin

attributes.name: vendor_name

products.name: reserve
products.description: Reserve: Case, IBNR, and LAE reserve amounts for claim exposures. GRAIN: One row per financial movement per claim exposure. Grain: one row per financial movement per claim exposure.

attributes.name: reserve_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each reserve position record. One row per reserve type per claim exposure per accounting period. Grain: one reserve movement per claim exposure per period.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP SSAP No. 55

attributes.name: adjuster_id
attributes.description: Reference to the adjuster who authorized or last modified this reserve position. Required for reserve authority and audit trail.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter Reserving module; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: approved_by_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party (supervisor or manager) who approved this reserve movement when it exceeded adjuster authority limits. Null if no approval was required.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; SOX; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: catastrophe_event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the catastrophe event record when the claim is associated with a declared CAT. Null for non-catastrophe claims. Supports CAT aggregate reserve reporting.
attributes.references: ISO PCS; NAIC Schedule P; RMS RiskLink / AIR Touchstone

attributes.name: claim_exposure_id
attributes.description: Reference to the claim exposure (coverage line within a claim) to which this reserve position belongs. Links reserve to a specific coverage and insured risk within the claim.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter Reserving module; NAIC Schedule P

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent claim record. Denormalized for direct claim-level aggregation and reporting without joining through claim exposure.

attributes.name: claimfinancials_accounting_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the accounting period in which this reserve position is recorded. Enables calendar year, accident year, and policy year reserve triangles.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 55; NAIC Annual Statement Schedule P

attributes.name: coverage_id
attributes.description: Reference to the coverage under which this reserve is established. Supports reserve analysis by coverage type and line of business.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: Multi-currency claim operations require currency master for exchange rate lookup, functional currency conversion, rounding rules, and financial consolidation.

attributes.name: line_of_business_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.line_of_business. Business justification: Actuarial reserve adequacy analysis, NAIC Schedule P reporting, and regulatory reserve filings require joining reserve transactions to LOB master for proper line classification, loss

attributes.name: reinsurance_cession_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reinsurance.cession. Business justification: Reserves track ceded amounts (ceded_opening_balance_amount, ceded_movement_amount) requiring direct cession link for monthly reserve adequacy reporting and Schedule F preparation.

attributes.name: riskexposure_insured_risk_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to riskexposure.insured_risk. Business justification: Actuaries segment reserve adequacy by risk characteristics (construction type, protection class, vehicle type, driver profile) for accurate loss development and catastrophe

attributes.name: underwriting_loss_history_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to coverage.loss_history. Business justification: Actuaries use prior loss history from underwriting submissions to calibrate reserve adequacy and IBNR estimates for similar risk profiles.

attributes.name: underwriting_risk_score_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to coverage.underwriting_risk_score. Business justification: Actuaries stratify case reserves and IBNR by underwriting risk tier (COPE score, territory score, catastrophe score).

attributes.name: accident_year
attributes.description: The calendar year in which the loss event occurred. Used for accident year (AY) loss triangle development and actuarial reserving analysis per NAIC Schedule P.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP) No. 43

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the reserve movement was approved by the authorizing supervisor or manager. Null if no approval was required for this movement.

attributes.name: authority_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum reserve amount the authorizing adjuster is permitted to set without escalation per the claims reserving authority matrix. Supports reserve governance and SOX controls.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; SOX; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: basis
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reserve amounts are stated on a Gross (before reinsurance), Net (after reinsurance), or Ceded (reinsurer share only) basis for this record.
attributes.references: NAIC SSAP No. 55; NAIC Schedule F; IFRS 17

attributes.name: case_reserve_adequacy_flag
attributes.description: Actuarial or supervisory assessment of whether the case reserve is adequate relative to the expected ultimate loss. Used in reserve review and ORSA reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC ORSA; ASOP No. 43; SAP SSAP No. 55

attributes.name: catastrophe_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reserve is associated with a declared catastrophe event. Enables CAT vs. non-CAT reserve segregation for PML analysis and reinsurance recovery tracking.
attributes.references: ISO PCS Catastrophe Bulletin; NAIC Schedule P; RMS RiskLink

attributes.name: reserve_category
attributes.description: Broad financial category of the reserve: Loss (indemnity), Expense (LAE/DCC/AO), Salvage (anticipated recovery from salvage), or Subrogation (anticipated recovery from third parties).
attributes.references: NAIC SSAP No. 55; SAP Statutory Accounting

attributes.name: ceded_closing_balance_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the closing reserve balance ceded to reinsurers. Net reserve equals closing balance minus ceded closing balance. Required for Schedule F statutory reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: ceded_movement_amount
attributes.description: Incremental change in the ceded reserve portion during the accounting period. Supports net reserve calculation and reinsurance bordereaux reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: ceded_opening_balance_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the opening reserve balance ceded to reinsurers under applicable treaties or facultative agreements. Used for net reserve and Schedule F reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R; IFRS 17

attributes.name: closing_balance_amount
attributes.description: Reserve balance at the end of the accounting period for this claim exposure and reserve type. Equals opening balance plus movement amount. Gross of reinsurance.
attributes.references: NAIC SSAP No. 55; GAAP ASC 944; IFRS 17

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Internal cost center to which this reserve is allocated for management accounting and expense reporting purposes. Supports departmental P&L and RBC capital allocation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this reserve record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, SOX compliance, and data lineage tracking in the lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: SOX; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; GLBA

attributes.name: development_period
attributes.description: Number of months elapsed from the accident year start to the end of the accounting period. Used to position this reserve in the loss development triangle (e.g., 12, 24, 36 months).
attributes.references: ASOP No. 43; NAIC Schedule P; Actuarial Reserving System

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this reserve position becomes effective for financial reporting purposes. May differ from the transaction date for period-end adjustments and actuarial entries.
attributes.references: NAIC SSAP No. 55; GAAP ASC 944; IFRS 17

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code to which this reserve movement is posted in the statutory and GAAP accounting systems. Supports financial close and Schedule P reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP/Oracle GL; NAIC Annual Statement; SOX; GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: ibnr_factor
attributes.description: Actuarial development factor applied to derive the IBNR reserve component. Sourced from the actuarial reserving system loss development triangle for the applicable LOB and accident year.
attributes.references: ASOP No. 43; NAIC Schedule P; Data Warehouse / Actuarial Reserving System

attributes.name: loss_date
attributes.description: Date of the underlying loss event that gave rise to this claim and reserve. Denormalized from the claim for accident year triangle development without additional joins.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; ASOP No. 43; Guidewire ClaimCenter

attributes.name: method
attributes.description: Methodology used to establish or update this reserve: Case_Estimate (adjuster judgment), Formula (system-calculated), Actuarial (actuarial model output), Bulk (portfolio-level), or Tabular (mortality/morbidity table).
attributes.references: ASOP No. 43; NAIC Schedule P; SAP SSAP No. 55

attributes.name: movement_amount
attributes.description: Incremental change to the reserve during the accounting period. Positive value indicates reserve strengthening; negative value indicates reserve release. Gross of reinsurance.
attributes.references: NAIC SSAP No. 55; GAAP ASC 944; IFRS 17

attributes.name: movement_reason_code
attributes.description: Coded reason for the reserve movement in this period (e.g., NEW_RESERVE, STRENGTHENING, PARTIAL_RELEASE, FULL_RELEASE, PAYMENT_OFFSET, REOPEN). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter Reserving module; NAIC Schedule P

attributes.name: movement_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative provided by the adjuster or actuarial team explaining the basis for the reserve movement. Supports audit trail and reserve review documentation.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Externally visible business identifier for this reserve record, typically assigned by the claims management system. Used in bordereaux and statutory reporting.

attributes.name: opening_balance_amount
attributes.description: Reserve balance carried forward from the prior accounting period for this claim exposure and reserve type. Starting point for the period movement calculation.
attributes.references: NAIC SSAP No. 55; GAAP ASC 944; IFRS 17

attributes.name: policy_year
attributes.description: The year in which the policy that generated this claim was written. Supports policy year (PY) reserve development triangles distinct from accident year analysis.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP Statutory Accounting

attributes.name: reinsurance_recoverable_amount
attributes.description: Estimated reinsurance recoverable on this reserve position based on applicable treaty or facultative cession. Supports Schedule F reporting and net reserve calculation.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R; IFRS 17

attributes.name: report_date
attributes.description: Date the claim was first reported to the insurer (FNOL date). Used to compute report lag and support IBNR development analysis in actuarial reserving.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; ASOP No. 43; Guidewire ClaimCenter FNOL module

attributes.name: requires_supervisor_approval
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reserve movement exceeded the adjuster authority limit and required supervisor or management approval before posting.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; SOX Internal Controls; NAIC Market Conduct

attributes.name: reserve_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the reserve position. Open reserves are active; Closed reserves have been fully settled or released; Reopened indicates a previously closed reserve reactivated.

attributes.name: reserve_type
attributes.description: Classification of the reserve: Case (known reported loss), IBNR (Incurred But Not Reported), LAE (Loss Adjustment Expense), ULAE (Unallocated LAE), ALAE (Allocated LAE), or DCC (Defense & Cost Containment).
attributes.references: NAIC SSAP No. 55; SAP; Schedule P Instructions

attributes.name: salvage_anticipated_amount
attributes.description: Estimated salvage recovery anticipated on this claim exposure. Reduces the net reserve position and is reported separately in NAIC statutory filings.
attributes.references: NAIC SSAP No. 55; SAP Statutory Accounting; Guidewire ClaimCenter

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system that originated this reserve record: ClaimCenter, DuckCreek, Legacy, Manual (spreadsheet entry), or Actuarial (reserving system upload).
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; Duck Creek Claims; Data Warehouse / Actuarial Reserving System

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code where the insured risk is located or the loss occurred. Required for state-level Schedule P statutory reporting and DOI regulatory filings.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Schedule P; State DOI regulations; ISO

attributes.name: subrogation_anticipated_amount
attributes.description: Estimated subrogation recovery anticipated on this claim exposure. Reduces the net reserve position and is tracked separately for recovery management and statutory reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC SSAP No. 55; SAP Statutory Accounting; Guidewire ClaimCenter Recovery module

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the reserve movement was entered into the claims management system. Used for CY (Calendar Year) reporting and reconciliation to the general ledger.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; NAIC Annual Statement; SAP

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this reserve record. Used for incremental data pipeline processing, audit trail, and change data capture in the lakehouse.
attributes.references: SOX; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; GLBA

products.name: claim_payment
products.description: Claim Payment: Payments made on claim exposures. GRAIN: One row per financial movement per claim exposure. Grain: one row per financial movement per claim exposure.

attributes.name: claim_payment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each claim payment disbursement record. Primary key. One row per payment per claim exposure per accounting period.

attributes.name: claim_exposure_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific coverage line within the claim (Claim Exposure) against which this payment is charged. Grain anchor per VREQ-007.

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent claim under which this payment is issued. Links payment to the reported loss event.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; NAIC Annual Statement Schedule P

attributes.name: claimfinancials_accounting_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the accounting period in which this payment is recognized for statutory and GAAP financial reporting purposes.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: International claim payments require currency master for exchange rate application, withholding tax calculation, bank account validation, and functional currency conversion.

attributes.name: line_of_business_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.line_of_business. Business justification: Payment authority limits, commission calculations, and loss ratio monitoring are configured by line of business.

attributes.name: original_payment_claim_payment_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the original payment record when this row represents a reissue or replacement. Null for original disbursements.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: System user ID of the claims examiner or supervisor who authorized this payment within the authority limit matrix.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; Guidewire ClaimCenter; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: payee_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Party record identifying the individual or organization receiving this payment (claimant, vendor, attorney, lienholder, loss payee).

attributes.name: riskexposure_insured_risk_id

attributes.name: underwriting_loss_history_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to coverage.loss_history. Business justification: Underwriters verify CLUE/MVR loss runs against internal payment history. Business process: loss_history records from submissions reference actual historical claim_payment

attributes.name: accident_year
attributes.description: Four-digit calendar year in which the loss event occurred. Used for accident year (AY) loss development triangles and actuarial reserving.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP) No. 43

attributes.name: ap_batch_number
attributes.description: Identifier of the AP disbursement batch in which this payment was grouped for bank settlement. Used for batch reconciliation in Oracle/SAP AP module.

attributes.name: authority_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum payment amount the authorizing user was permitted to approve per the claims authority matrix at the time of authorization.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; Guidewire ClaimCenter Authority Matrix

attributes.name: bank_account_code
attributes.description: Internal code identifying the company bank account from which the payment was funded. Supports multi-bank disbursement and reconciliation workflows.
attributes.references: Oracle/SAP AP Module; SOX; PCI DSS

attributes.name: check_eft_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Check / Electronic Funds Transfer (EFT) Reference Number
attributes.description: Check number or EFT transaction reference issued by the bank or payment processor. Used for bank reconciliation and stop-payment processing.
attributes.references: PCI DSS; Oracle/SAP AP Module; NACHA EFT Standards

tag_set.value: Check / Electronic Funds Transfer (EFT) Reference Number

attributes.name: cleared_date
attributes.description: Date the payment instrument cleared the bank. Null until the check or EFT is confirmed settled. Used for outstanding check reconciliation.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Internal cost center to which the payment expense is allocated for management accounting and expense ratio reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle/SAP GL Module; NAIC Annual Statement

attributes.name: coverage_type_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the coverage part under which this payment is charged (e.g., HO-Dwelling, PAP-Liability, CGL-BI). Aligns payment to the policy coverage for Schedule P reporting.
attributes.references: ISO Forms Library; NAIC Schedule P; ACORD 125/126

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this payment record was first created in the claims management system. Supports audit trail and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; Guidewire ClaimCenter; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: deductible_offset_amount
attributes.description: Amount of the payment attributable to the insured's deductible or Self-Insured Retention (SIR) that is to be collected back from the policyholder.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; Policy terms; NAIC Schedule P

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General Ledger account code to which this payment is posted in the statutory and GAAP accounting systems for financial reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle/SAP GL Module; SAP/SSAP; US GAAP; IFRS 17

attributes.name: gross_payment_amount
attributes.description: Total gross amount disbursed before any deductions, withholdings, or offsets. Denominated in the currency indicated by currency_code.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP/SSAP No. 55; IFRS 17

attributes.name: is_1099_reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment must be reported to the IRS on Form 1099-MISC or 1099-NEC. Drives year-end tax reporting extract.

attributes.name: is_final_payment
attributes.description: Indicates this payment closes the claim exposure financially. When true, triggers reserve release and exposure closure workflow in ClaimCenter.

attributes.name: is_structured_settlement
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment is part of a structured settlement annuity arrangement rather than a lump-sum disbursement.
attributes.references: Structured Settlement Protection Acts; IRC Section 130; NAIC Model Law

attributes.name: loss_category
attributes.description: Detailed loss sub-category classifying the nature of the payment: Bodily Injury (BI), Property Damage (PD), Medical Payments (MP), Uninsured Motorist (UM), etc.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; ISO CGL; PAP; ACORD

attributes.name: net_payment_amount
attributes.description: Actual amount disbursed to the payee after withholding and deductions. Net = gross_payment_amount minus withholding_amount.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP/SSAP No. 55; IFRS 17

attributes.name: payee_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the payment recipient as printed on the check or EFT remittance. May differ from the claimant name (e.g., attorney, lienholder, mortgagee).

attributes.name: payee_tax_number
attributes.description: Federal Employer Identification Number (FEIN) or Social Security Number (SSN) of the payee for IRS 1099 reporting. Masked in non-privileged access tiers.

attributes.name: payment_authorization_code
attributes.description: Internal authorization or approval code assigned by the claims supervisor or authority matrix before payment release. Supports SOX payment controls.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; Guidewire ClaimCenter Authority Matrix; NAIC Market Conduct

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the payment was issued or disbursed to the payee. Used for calendar year (CY) and accident year (AY) loss reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement; SAP/SSAP; Schedule P

attributes.name: payment_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative describing the purpose or nature of the payment (e.g., 'Partial settlement for dwelling damage', 'Attorney fee disbursement').
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Instrument or mechanism used to disburse funds to the payee (paper check, ACH, wire transfer, EFT, draft, or virtual card).
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; PCI DSS; Guidewire BillingCenter

attributes.name: payment_number
