attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable payment reference number assigned by the claims payment system or AP module. Used for reconciliation and payee inquiries.

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the payment instrument. Tracks issuance through clearance, void, stop-payment, reissue, and return workflows in ClaimCenter.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter Payments Module; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: payment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the payment by financial category: indemnity (loss), medical, Loss Adjustment Expense (LAE), Defense & Cost Containment (DCC), Adjusting & Other (AO), or recovery offset.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP/SSAP No. 55; ISO

attributes.name: policy_year
attributes.description: Four-digit year of the policy period under which the loss is covered. Used for policy year (PY) loss development and reinsurance treaty year allocation.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; Reinsurance treaty terms

attributes.name: reinsurance_recoverable_amount
attributes.description: Portion of this payment expected to be recovered from reinsurers under applicable treaty or facultative agreements. Used for net loss reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP/SSAP No. 62R; IFRS 17; Reinsurance Management System

attributes.name: reissue_date
attributes.description: Date a replacement payment was reissued after a void or stop-payment. Links to the original payment via original_payment_id for audit trail.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: remittance_memo
attributes.description: Short memo line printed on the check or included in the EFT remittance advice to the payee. Typically includes claim number and coverage description.

attributes.name: siu_referral_flag
attributes.description: Indicates this payment was flagged for Special Investigations Unit (SIU) review due to suspected fraud. Payment may be held pending SIU clearance.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Insurance Fraud Act; Fraud Detection/SIU System; FCRA

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this payment record was ingested into the lakehouse Silver layer.
attributes.references: Enterprise Data Governance Policy; Databricks Lakehouse Architecture

attributes.name: state_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code of the jurisdiction governing this payment for regulatory reporting and state DOI compliance purposes.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement; State DOI; NAIC Model Laws

attributes.name: stop_payment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates a stop-payment order has been placed on this check with the issuing bank. Triggers reissue workflow and outstanding check reconciliation.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; Oracle/SAP AP Module; UCC Article 4

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this payment record. Used for incremental data pipeline processing and audit trail.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; Guidewire ClaimCenter; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: void_date
attributes.description: Date the payment was voided. Populated only when payment_status is Voided. Triggers reversal entries in the general ledger.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; Oracle/SAP GL Module; SOX

attributes.name: withholding_amount
attributes.description: Amount withheld from the gross payment for tax withholding, Medicare Set-Aside (MSA), or other statutory deductions before net disbursement.
attributes.references: IRS Form 1099; Medicare Secondary Payer Act; SAP

products.name: recovery
products.description: Recovery: Subrogation, salvage, and reinsurance recoveries on claim exposures. GRAIN: One row per financial movement per claim exposure. Grain: one row per financial movement per claim exposure.

attributes.name: recovery_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each claim recovery transaction. One row per recovery transaction per claim exposure per accounting period.

attributes.name: adjuster_id
attributes.description: Reference to the claims adjuster or recovery specialist responsible for managing and pursuing this recovery transaction.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: attorney_organization_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to party.organization. Business justification: Recovery (salvage, subrogation, reinsurance) often involves legal counsel. Law firms are organizations requiring full party attribution for vendor management, payment processing, and

attributes.name: claim_exposure_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific coverage line within the claim (Claim Exposure) against which this recovery is applied.

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent claim record. Denormalized for direct claim-level reporting and aggregation without joining through claim exposure.

attributes.name: claim_payment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original claim payment transaction that this recovery offsets. Links recovery to the indemnity payment for net loss calculation.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter Payments module; SAP/SSAP No. 65

attributes.name: claimfinancials_accounting_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the accounting period in which this recovery transaction is recognized for statutory and GAAP financial reporting.

attributes.name: coverage_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to coverage.coverage. Business justification: Subrogation and salvage recoveries must tie to the coverage that paid the original loss for proper reserve relief, reinsurance accounting, and statutory reporting.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: Multi-currency recovery operations (reinsurance collections, subrogation from foreign insurers, salvage auctions) require currency master for demand amount conversion, collection tracking

attributes.name: line_of_business_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.line_of_business. Business justification: Subrogation and salvage recovery tracking, reinsurance recovery allocation, and net loss ratio calculation require LOB master for treaty participation rules, recovery expense

attributes.name: reinsurance_cession_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reinsurance cession record when recovery_type is reinsurance. Null for subrogation and salvage recoveries.

attributes.name: responsible_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party from whom recovery is sought: tortfeasor for subrogation, salvage buyer for salvage, or reinsurer for reinsurance recovery.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter Subrogation module; ACORD standards

attributes.name: ri_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reinsurance agreement (treaty or facultative) under which a reinsurance recovery is claimed. Null for subrogation and salvage.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsurancePro; NAIC Schedule F; SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: riskexposure_property_risk_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to riskexposure.property_risk. Business justification: Salvage teams track disposition of damaged buildings and subrogation pursues liable parties for property damage at specific locations.

attributes.name: salvage_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to claimfinancials.salvage. Business justification: Recovery is the transaction record for collected amounts. Salvage is the master record for salvage activity.

attributes.name: subrogation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to claimfinancials.subrogation. Business justification: Recovery is the transaction record for collected amounts. Subrogation is the master record for a subrogation pursuit.

attributes.name: accident_year
attributes.description: Calendar year in which the loss event occurred. Used for accident year (AY) loss development triangles and actuarial reserving analysis.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Schedule P; Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP)

attributes.name: bordereaux_period
attributes.description: YYYY-MM formatted period for which this recovery is included in reinsurance bordereaux reporting to the reinsurer. Applicable for reinsurance recoveries.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; Sapiens ReinsurancePro Bordereaux module; SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: closed_date
attributes.description: Date on which the recovery file was formally closed, either after full collection, settlement, or abandonment of pursuit.

attributes.name: collected_amount
attributes.description: Gross amount actually received from the responsible party or reinsurer prior to deducting collection expenses or attorney fees.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 65; NAIC Annual Statement; GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: collected_date
attributes.description: Date on which recovery funds were actually received and posted. Null if recovery has not yet been collected.

attributes.name: collection_expense_amount
attributes.description: Costs incurred to pursue and collect the recovery, including attorney fees, court costs, and investigation expenses. Deducted to derive net recovery.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 65; NAIC Schedule P; ALAE/DCC definitions

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this recovery record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, SOX compliance, and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOX; GLBA; NAIC Model Audit Rule (MAR)

attributes.name: demand_amount
attributes.description: Gross amount formally demanded from the responsible party or reinsurer. Represents the maximum expected recovery before negotiation or adjustment.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 65; NAIC Schedule P; GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: demand_date
attributes.description: Date on which the formal demand for recovery was first issued to the responsible party, tortfeasor, or reinsurer.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter Subrogation module; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code to which this recovery transaction is posted for statutory and GAAP financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 65; GAAP ASC 944; Oracle/SAP GL module

attributes.name: litigation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether legal action has been filed to pursue this recovery. True when a lawsuit or arbitration proceeding is active.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter Subrogation module; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: method
attributes.description: Mechanism used to pursue or collect the recovery. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: demand_letter|litigation|negotiated_settlement|auction|bordereaux|direct_bill — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter Subrogation module; NAIC Model Laws

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: Net recovery amount after deducting collection expenses from collected amount. Used for statutory reporting and loss ratio calculations (NWP basis).
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 65; NAIC Annual Statement Schedule P; GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text narrative capturing adjuster commentary, negotiation history, legal strategy notes, or other contextual information about this recovery.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Externally visible business identifier for this recovery transaction, used in bordereaux reporting, correspondence, and audit trails.
attributes.references: ACORD data standards; NAIC Bordereaux Reporting

attributes.name: payment_reference
attributes.description: Check number, wire transfer reference, EFT trace number, or other payment instrument identifier for the collected recovery funds.
attributes.references: Guidewire BillingCenter; PCI DSS; GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: policy_year
attributes.description: Year in which the policy that generated the claim was written. Used for policy year (PY) loss development and reinsurance treaty year allocation.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Schedule P; SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: recovery_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the recovery transaction: open (demand issued), collected (funds received), closed (finalized), void (cancelled), or disputed.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter Recovery module; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: recovery_type
attributes.description: Classifies the nature of the recovery: subrogation (pursuit of third-party tortfeasor), salvage (sale of damaged property), reinsurance (ceded loss recovery), or other.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement; SAP/SSAP No. 65; ISO P&C standards

attributes.name: ri_participation_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the ceded loss recoverable from the reinsurer under the applicable treaty or facultative agreement (e.g., 0.7500 = 75%).
attributes.references: SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F; Sapiens ReinsurancePro Bordereaux

attributes.name: ri_recovery_basis
attributes.description: Reinsurance structure under which the recovery is claimed: quota share (QS), excess of loss (XOL), stop loss (SL), or facultative (FAC).
attributes.references: SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F; Sapiens ReinsurancePro

attributes.name: salvage_item_description
attributes.description: Description of the salvaged property or item sold, including condition, make/model for vehicles, or material type for property salvage.

attributes.name: salvage_type
attributes.description: Classification of salvage recovery: total loss vehicle, damaged property, scrap material, or auction proceeds. Applicable only when recovery_type is salvage.
attributes.references: ISO P&C standards; Guidewire ClaimCenter Salvage module

attributes.name: siu_referral_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this recovery has been referred to the Special Investigations Unit (SIU) for fraud investigation or suspicious activity review.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Insurance Fraud Act; Guidewire ClaimCenter SIU module

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record that originated this recovery transaction (e.g., ClaimCenter, ReinsurancePro, BillingCenter, or manual entry).
attributes.references: Data governance; SOX; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code for the jurisdiction governing this recovery, used for statutory reporting and state DOI regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement; State DOI regulations; ISO state codes

attributes.name: statute_of_limitations_date
attributes.description: Date by which legal action must be filed to preserve the right of recovery. Critical for subrogation diary management and SIU oversight.
attributes.references: State DOI regulations; NAIC Model Laws; FCRA

attributes.name: subrogation_basis
attributes.description: Legal theory under which subrogation is pursued: tort (negligence), contract (breach), statutory (workers comp lien), or equitable subrogation.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Laws; State DOI regulations; ISO P&C standards

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: The real-world date on which the recovery event occurred: demand issued, settlement agreed, payment received, or salvage sale completed.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 65; GAAP ASC 944; IFRS 17 para 38

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this recovery record. Used for change data capture, audit trail, and incremental ETL processing.
attributes.references: SOX; GLBA; NAIC Model Audit Rule (MAR)

products.name: subrogation
products.description: Master record for a subrogation pursuit against a liable third party. Tracks demand amount, collected amount, attorney assignment, litigation status, settlement date, and net recovery after expenses per claim.

attributes.name: subrogation_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the subrogation pursuit record. One row per subrogation action initiated against a liable third party arising from a paid claim.

attributes.name: attorney_organization_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to party.organization. Business justification: Law firms handling subrogation litigation are organizations in the party domain. Tracking counsel requires full organization details for billing, communication, and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: claim_exposure_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific coverage line (claim exposure) within the claim that generated the subrogation opportunity. Enables per-coverage recovery tracking.

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent claim from which this subrogation pursuit originates. Links the recovery action to the underlying loss event and paid indemnity.

attributes.name: claimfinancials_accounting_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the accounting period in which the subrogation recovery is recognized for statutory and GAAP financial reporting. Aligns with Schedule P accident year reporting.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 65; GAAP ASC 944; NAIC Schedule P; IFRS 17

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: Cross-border subrogation pursuits against foreign liable parties require currency master for demand amount calculation, settlement negotiation, collection tracking, and insured reimbursement

attributes.name: liable_party_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to party.party. Business justification: Subrogation pursues recovery from liable third parties who are tracked as party entities. Demand letters, settlement negotiations, and litigation require full party attribution including address

attributes.name: riskexposure_auto_risk_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to riskexposure.auto_risk. Business justification: Subrogation adjusters reference insured vehicle details, driver information, and garaging location when pursuing third-party recoveries.

attributes.name: arbitration_award_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount awarded by the arbitration panel in favor of the insurer. May differ from demand amount. Drives final collection and closure processing.
attributes.references: Arbitration Forums Inc.; SAP SSAP No. 65

attributes.name: arbitration_filing_date
attributes.description: Date the subrogation dispute was filed with the arbitration forum. Used to track filing deadlines and arbitration cycle times.

attributes.name: arbitration_forum
attributes.description: Arbitration body used for intercompany dispute resolution. Arbitration Forums Inc. is standard for auto subrogation. Drives filing fee tracking and award enforcement.
attributes.references: Arbitration Forums Inc.; AAA; JAMS; ISO Auto Subrogation Guidelines

attributes.name: closed_date
attributes.description: Date the subrogation pursuit was formally closed in the claims system. Used for cycle time reporting and recovery performance measurement.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: closure_reason
attributes.description: Reason the subrogation pursuit was closed. Required for recovery analytics, SIU referral decisions, and regulatory reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product if values expand]
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Standards; Guidewire ClaimCenter

attributes.name: collected_amount
attributes.description: Total gross amount actually received from the liable party or their insurer to date. Cumulative across all payments. Used in net recovery and loss ratio calculations.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP SSAP No. 65; GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: collectible_amount
attributes.description: Estimated collectible portion of the demand amount after applying comparative negligence, policy limits of the liable party, and asset assessment. Used for reserve adequacy.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP SSAP No. 65; Actuarial Standards of Practice

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the subrogation record was first created in the claims management system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: demand_amount
attributes.description: Gross dollar amount demanded from the liable third party, typically equal to total indemnity paid plus allocated loss adjustment expenses (ALAE) on the claim.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP SSAP No. 65; Guidewire ClaimCenter

attributes.name: demand_date
attributes.description: Date the formal subrogation demand letter was issued to the liable party or their insurer. Starts the statute of limitations clock for recovery actions.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Laws; State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: insured_reimbursement_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the net recovery returned to the insured, typically representing their deductible or uninsured loss. Required by the made-whole doctrine in most jurisdictions.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Laws; State DOI Regulations; Made-Whole Doctrine

attributes.name: last_activity_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent action taken on the subrogation file (demand, payment received, court filing, etc.). Used for diary management and dormant file identification.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: liable_party_claim_number
attributes.description: Claim number assigned by the liable party's insurer for the same loss event. Enables cross-carrier reconciliation and arbitration tracking.
attributes.references: Arbitration Forums Inc.; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: liable_party_insurer
attributes.description: Name of the insurance carrier for the liable third party. Used to route intercompany arbitration and direct demand letters to the correct carrier.
attributes.references: NAIC Company Code Registry; Arbitration Forums Inc.

attributes.name: liable_party_policy_number
attributes.description: Policy number of the liable third party's insurance coverage. Required for intercompany arbitration filings and demand correspondence.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; Arbitration Forums Inc.

attributes.name: litigation_status
attributes.description: Current stage of legal proceedings for the subrogation pursuit. Drives reserve adequacy reviews and legal expense forecasting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product if stages expand]
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; State Court Rules

attributes.name: lob_code
attributes.description: NAIC line of business code for the policy coverage generating the subrogation. Drives recovery strategy, arbitration eligibility, and statutory reporting segmentation.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Lines of Business; ISO LOB Codes

attributes.name: made_whole_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the insured has been fully compensated for their loss before the insurer may retain subrogation proceeds. Required by the made-whole doctrine in most states.
attributes.references: Made-Whole Doctrine; State DOI Regulations; NAIC Model Laws

attributes.name: negligence_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of fault attributed to the liable third party as determined by investigation or adjudication. Drives the collectible amount calculation under comparative negligence statutes.
attributes.references: State Tort Law; NAIC Model Laws; ISO Claims Guidelines

attributes.name: net_recovery_amount
attributes.description: Net recovery after deducting recovery expenses from collected amount (collected_amount minus recovery_expense_amount). Represents the actual financial benefit to the insurer.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP SSAP No. 65; GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: next_action_date
attributes.description: Diary date for the next required action on the subrogation file. Drives case management queues and ensures statute of limitations compliance.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text narrative capturing key developments, negotiation history, legal strategy, and adjuster observations for the subrogation pursuit. Supports case management and audit.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Externally visible business identifier for the subrogation pursuit, used in demand letters, court filings, and bordereaux reporting. Format: SUBR-YYYY-NNNNNNN.

attributes.name: opened_date
attributes.description: Date the subrogation pursuit was formally opened in the claims management system. Used as the start point for cycle time and recovery lag analysis.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: pursuit_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the subrogation pursuit. Drives case management queues and recovery reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Open|Demand Issued|Negotiating|Settled|Collected|Closed - No Recovery|Referred to Litigation — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter Recovery Module; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: recovery_expense_amount
attributes.description: Total allocated expenses incurred in pursuing the subrogation recovery, including attorney fees, court costs, and investigation costs (DCC/ALAE). Deducted to compute net recovery.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP SSAP No. 65; GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: recovery_method
attributes.description: Mechanism used to pursue the subrogation recovery. Intercompany Arbitration applies to auto claims under Arbitration Forum agreements. Drives legal cost allocation.
attributes.references: Arbitration Forums Inc.; ISO; Guidewire ClaimCenter

attributes.name: referral_date
attributes.description: Date the subrogation file was referred to outside counsel or a subrogation vendor for legal pursuit. Triggers DCC expense tracking and litigation status updates.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: reinsurance_recovery_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the gross subrogation collected amount allocable to reinsurers per treaty or facultative cession terms. Reported on Schedule F and reinsurance bordereaux.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F; Reinsurance Bordereaux Reporting Repository

attributes.name: reinsurance_recovery_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether a portion of the subrogation recovery must be remitted to reinsurers per cession agreements. Triggers reinsurance bordereaux reporting and recovery allocation.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F; Reinsurance Management System

attributes.name: settlement_amount
attributes.description: Agreed gross settlement amount with the liable party. May differ from demand amount due to negotiation, comparative negligence, or policy limits of the liable party.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; SAP SSAP No. 65; GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: Date a settlement agreement was reached with the liable party or their insurer. Triggers final payment processing and closure of the subrogation pursuit.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; SAP SSAP No. 65; GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: siu_referral_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subrogation file has been referred to the Special Investigations Unit (SIU) for fraud investigation related to the liable party or loss circumstances.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Insurance Fraud Act; State DOI Anti-Fraud Regulations; Guidewire ClaimCenter SIU Module

attributes.name: state_of_loss
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code where the loss occurred. Determines applicable subrogation statutes, comparative negligence rules, and statute of limitations periods.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Laws; State DOI Regulations; ISO Territory Codes

attributes.name: statute_of_limitations_date
attributes.description: Date by which legal action must be filed to preserve the subrogation right. Calculated from loss date per applicable state statute. Critical for diary and case management.
attributes.references: State DOI Regulations; NAIC Model Laws; State Tort Statutes

attributes.name: subrogation_type
attributes.description: Legal basis of the recovery action: Subrogation (insurer steps into insured's rights), Contribution (recovery from co-insurer), or Indemnification (contractual hold-harmless recovery).
attributes.references: ISO Insurance Subrogation Guidelines; NAIC Model Laws

attributes.name: suit_filed_date
attributes.description: Date the subrogation lawsuit was filed in court. Marks the transition from pre-litigation to litigation phase and triggers enhanced reserve and expense tracking.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the subrogation record. Used for change data capture, audit trail, and incremental ETL processing in the lakehouse.

products.name: salvage
products.description: Master record for salvage activity on a total-loss insured item. Tracks salvage value estimate, auction proceeds, title transfer status, storage costs, net salvage amount, and disposition method per claim exposure.

attributes.name: salvage_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the salvage record. One row per salvage activity per claim exposure on a total-loss insured item.

attributes.name: claim_exposure_id
attributes.description: Reference to the claim exposure (coverage line within a claim) that generated this salvage activity.

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent claim under which this salvage activity is recorded.

attributes.name: claimfinancials_accounting_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the accounting period in which salvage proceeds are recognized for statutory and GAAP reporting.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 55; US GAAP ASC 944; IFRS 17

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: Salvage auction proceeds, storage costs, and net salvage calculations require currency master for multi-currency total loss settlements, reinsurance salvage share allocation, and functional

attributes.name: insured_risk_id
attributes.description: Reference to the insured risk (vehicle, property, etc.) that is the subject of salvage disposition.

attributes.name: riskexposure_property_risk_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to riskexposure.property_risk. Business justification: Salvage teams coordinate property demolition, environmental remediation, and land sale with specific property characteristics.

attributes.name: riskexposure_vehicle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to riskexposure.vehicle. Business justification: Salvage vendors require VIN, title number, and vehicle specifications for auction processing and title transfer.

attributes.name: vendor_payee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to claimfinancials.payee. Business justification: Salvage has vendor_name and vendor_code (STRING) for the salvage vendor (auction house, salvage yard). Vendors are payees. Adding vendor_payee_id FK normalizes vendor master data.

attributes.name: assigned_date
attributes.description: Date the salvage item was formally assigned to the salvage vendor or auction house for disposition.

attributes.name: auction_date
attributes.description: Date on which the salvaged item was auctioned or sold. Used to align proceeds recognition with the correct accounting period.

attributes.name: auction_fee
attributes.description: Fee charged by the auction house or salvage vendor for facilitating the sale, deducted from gross proceeds to arrive at net salvage.

attributes.name: auction_proceeds
attributes.description: Gross cash proceeds received from the auction or direct sale of the salvaged item before deducting storage, towing, and auction fees.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 55; NAIC Schedule P; US GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: buyer_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual or entity that purchased the salvaged item at auction or direct sale.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; state DOI total-loss regulations

attributes.name: buyer_type
attributes.description: Classification of the salvage buyer. Determines applicable title transfer rules and tax reporting obligations.

attributes.name: catastrophe_code
attributes.description: ISO or internal catastrophe event code linking this salvage to a declared CAT event for PML aggregation and reinsurance recovery.
attributes.references: ISO CAT codes; RMS RiskLink; NAIC CAT reporting

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: Certificate of destruction or salvage certificate number issued by the state DMV or relevant authority for the disposed item.
attributes.references: State DMV regulations; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: closed_date
attributes.description: Date the salvage activity was closed, indicating all proceeds collected, title transferred, and financials reconciled.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the salvage record was first created in the claims management system.
attributes.references: SOX; GLBA; Guidewire ClaimCenter audit trail

attributes.name: disposition_method
attributes.description: Method by which the salvaged item is disposed of. Impacts net salvage calculation and title transfer obligations.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; state DOI total-loss regulations

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: GL account code to which the net salvage proceeds are posted in the statutory and GAAP general ledger.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 55; Oracle/SAP GL module; SOX

attributes.name: insured_retained_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the insured elected to retain the salvaged item, resulting in a deduction from the total-loss settlement payment.
attributes.references: ISO PAP/CA forms; state DOI total-loss regulations

attributes.name: insured_retention_deduction
attributes.description: Amount deducted from the total-loss settlement when the insured elects to retain the salvaged item, equal to the salvage value estimate.
attributes.references: ISO PAP/CA forms; SAP/SSAP No. 55; state DOI regulations

attributes.name: item_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the salvaged item including make, model, year, condition, or property type to support valuation and disposition.

attributes.name: lob_code
attributes.description: NAIC or internal line of business code (e.g., PAP, CA, HO) for statutory reporting and Schedule P allocation of salvage recoveries.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement; NAIC Schedule P; ISO LOB codes

attributes.name: net_salvage_amount
attributes.description: Net proceeds from salvage after deducting storage, towing, and auction fees from gross auction proceeds. Credited against claim payments.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 55; NAIC Schedule P; US GAAP ASC 944; IFRS 17

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text adjuster notes capturing disposition decisions, buyer negotiations, title issues, or other relevant salvage activity details.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Externally visible business identifier for the salvage record, used in bordereaux, vendor communications, and regulatory filings.

attributes.name: reinsurance_recoverable_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether a portion of the net salvage proceeds is recoverable by or creditable to a reinsurer under treaty or facultative agreement.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F; Sapiens ReinsurancePro

attributes.name: reinsurance_salvage_share
attributes.description: Portion of net salvage proceeds attributable to reinsurers under applicable treaty or facultative agreement, per SSAP No. 62R.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F; IFRS 17

attributes.name: salvage_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the salvage activity. Drives workflow in ClaimCenter Recovery module and financial recognition timing.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter Recovery module; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: salvage_type
attributes.description: Classification of the salvage by asset category. Determines applicable disposition rules, title transfer requirements, and accounting treatment.
attributes.references: ISO forms; NAIC Annual Statement instructions

attributes.name: siu_referral_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this salvage activity has been referred to the SIU for fraud investigation (e.g., staged total loss).
attributes.references: NAIC Model Insurance Fraud Act; Guidewire ClaimCenter SIU module

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code where the salvage activity occurs, used for state DOI reporting and title transfer jurisdiction.
attributes.references: NAIC state codes; state DOI regulations; USPS state abbreviations

attributes.name: storage_cost
attributes.description: Cumulative cost of storing the salvaged item from date of loss to date of disposition, deducted from gross proceeds.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter Expense module; SAP/SSAP No. 55

attributes.name: storage_end_date
attributes.description: Date the salvaged item was removed from storage upon sale, transfer, or destruction.

attributes.name: storage_location
attributes.description: Address or facility name where the salvaged item is stored pending auction or disposition.

attributes.name: storage_start_date
attributes.description: Date the salvaged item entered storage, used to calculate accrued storage costs and vendor billing.

attributes.name: title_number
attributes.description: State-issued salvage title number assigned to the vehicle or property after total-loss declaration, required for legal resale.
attributes.references: State DMV regulations; state DOI total-loss rules

attributes.name: title_received_date
attributes.description: Date the insurer physically received the signed title document from the insured, initiating the transfer process.
attributes.references: State DOI total-loss regulations; Guidewire ClaimCenter

attributes.name: title_transfer_date
attributes.description: Date on which the title of the salvaged item was legally transferred from the insured to the insurer or designated buyer.
attributes.references: State DOI total-loss regulations; DMV title transfer rules

attributes.name: title_transfer_status
attributes.description: Status of the vehicle or property title transfer from the insured to the insurer or salvage buyer. Required for total-loss compliance.
attributes.references: State DOI total-loss regulations; DMV title transfer rules

attributes.name: total_loss_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the insured item was declared a total loss, triggering full salvage disposition and title transfer requirements.
attributes.references: State DOI total-loss threshold regulations; ISO PAP/CA forms

attributes.name: towing_cost
attributes.description: Cost of towing or transporting the salvaged item to the storage yard or auction facility, deducted from gross proceeds.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the salvage record, supporting audit trail and change tracking requirements.
attributes.references: SOX; GLBA; Guidewire ClaimCenter audit trail

attributes.name: value_estimate
attributes.description: Appraised or estimated market value of the salvaged item prior to auction or sale, used to set reserve and evaluate offers.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 55; Guidewire ClaimCenter Reserve module

attributes.name: vin
attributes.description: 17-character Vehicle Identification Number for salvaged vehicles, used for title transfer, DMV reporting, and CLUE database updates.

products.name: claim_expense
products.description: Claim Expense: LAE, DCC, and AO expenses on claim exposures. GRAIN: One row per financial movement per claim exposure. Grain: one row per financial movement per claim exposure.

attributes.name: claim_expense_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each claim expense transaction record. Primary key for the claim_expense table. One row per expense movement per claim exposure and accounting period.

attributes.name: adjuster_id
attributes.description: Reference to the claims adjuster responsible for authorizing or submitting this expense. Links expense to the handling adjuster for workload and cost reporting.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter — Adjuster entity; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: approved_by_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party (adjuster supervisor or manager) who approved this expense transaction. Required for audit trail and authority-level compliance.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter — Expense.approvedBy; SOX Section 404; NAIC Market Conduct

attributes.name: claim_exposure_id
attributes.description: Reference to the claim exposure (coverage line within a claim) to which this expense is allocated. Links expense to the specific coverage and insured risk.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter — ClaimExposure entity; NAIC Schedule P

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent claim record. Enables direct claim-level aggregation of all expense transactions without joining through claim exposure.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter — Claim entity; NAIC Schedule P

attributes.name: claimfinancials_accounting_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the accounting period in which this expense transaction is recognized for statutory and GAAP financial reporting purposes.

attributes.name: coverage_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to coverage.coverage. Business justification: LAE allocation to coverage line is required for Schedule P reporting, reinsurance bordereaux, and actuarial reserving.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: Multi-currency claim expense processing (foreign adjuster fees, international expert invoices, cross-border legal costs) requires currency master for functional currency conversion

attributes.name: line_of_business_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.line_of_business. Business justification: LAE allocation, expense ratio monitoring, and reinsurance expense recovery require LOB master for ALAE vs ULAE classification rules, treaty expense participation, and regulatory

attributes.name: original_expense_claim_expense_id
attributes.description: For reversal transactions, references the claim_expense_id of the original expense being reversed. Null for original (non-reversal) expense transactions.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter — Transaction reversal linkage; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: payee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party record of the vendor or service provider who rendered the service and generated this expense (e.g., law firm, medical examiner, appraiser).

attributes.name: riskexposure_insured_risk_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to riskexposure.insured_risk. Business justification: Expense management tracks inspection costs by property type, engineering report costs by construction class, and appraisal fees by vehicle type.

attributes.name: financial_transaction_id
attributes.description: The native transaction identifier from the originating system of record (e.g., Guidewire ClaimCenter expense ID). Enables traceability back to the source system.

attributes.name: accident_year
attributes.description: The calendar year in which the underlying loss event occurred. Used for accident-year LAE development triangles and actuarial reserving analysis.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP) No. 43

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the expense was approved by the authorized approver. Used for SLA measurement and audit trail documentation.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Approval workflow status for the expense. Expenses above authority thresholds require supervisor or management approval before payment can be issued.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter — Expense approval workflow; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: check_number
attributes.description: Check or EFT reference number issued for payment of this expense. Used for bank reconciliation and positive pay verification. Null for non-check payments.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Internal cost center or department code responsible for this expense. Supports management reporting, expense allocation, and budget variance analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this expense record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and regulatory record-retention compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GLBA; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Exchange rate applied to convert the expense from transaction currency to functional currency at the transaction date. Stored for audit and restatement purposes.

attributes.name: expense_amount
attributes.description: Gross amount of the expense transaction in the policy currency before any adjustments or recoveries. Positive for charges; negative for reversals or credits.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 55; GAAP ASC 944; IFRS 17 para 51

attributes.name: expense_date
attributes.description: The date on which the expense was incurred or the service was rendered. Used for accident-year and policy-year LAE allocation in Schedule P reporting.

attributes.name: expense_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the services rendered or expense incurred as provided by the adjuster or vendor. Used for audit review and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter — Expense.description; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: expense_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable identifier for this expense transaction. Used in vendor correspondence, GL postings, and audit trails.

attributes.name: expense_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the expense transaction from initial entry through approval, payment, and potential voiding or dispute resolution.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter — Expense.status; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: expense_type
attributes.description: Detailed classification of the nature of the expense. Drives GL account mapping and regulatory cost categorization. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: legal_fee|expert_witness|medical_exam|investigation|appraisal|court_cost|adjuster_fee|other — promote to reference
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter — Expense.type; NAIC Schedule P

attributes.name: functional_currency_amount
attributes.description: Expense amount converted to the company functional currency (USD) using the exchange rate at transaction date. Used for consolidated statutory and GAAP reporting.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The GL account code to which this expense is posted in the general ledger. Drives statutory Schedule P line assignment and GAAP income statement classification.
attributes.references: Oracle/SAP GL; NAIC Annual Statement; SAP/SSAP No. 55

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: Date printed on the vendor invoice. Used for accounts payable aging, payment terms calculation, and late-payment penalty assessment.

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: The invoice or billing reference number issued by the vendor. Used for three-way matching (PO, receipt, invoice) and duplicate payment prevention.

attributes.name: invoice_received_date
attributes.description: Date the invoice was received by the claims department. Used to measure vendor billing timeliness and trigger payment due-date calculations.

attributes.name: is_dcc_expense
attributes.business_glossary_term: Defense and Cost Containment (DCC) Expense Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this expense is classified as Defense and Cost Containment (DCC) per NAIC Schedule P definitions. Distinct from AO (Adjusting and Other) expenses.

tag_set.value: Defense and Cost Containment (DCC) Expense Flag

attributes.name: is_recoverable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this expense is subject to reinsurance recovery under a treaty or facultative agreement. Drives cession and bordereaux reporting.
attributes.references: Reinsurance treaty terms; NAIC Schedule F; SAP/SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: lae_category
attributes.description: Classifies the expense into LAE sub-categories: ALAE (Allocated LAE), ULAE (Unallocated LAE), DCC (Defense and Cost Containment), or AO (Adjusting and Other). Required for Schedule P.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP/SSAP No. 55; ISO standards

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the expense was actually disbursed to the vendor or payee. Null if the expense has not yet been paid. Used for cash-basis reporting.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method by which the expense was or will be disbursed to the vendor. Drives accounts payable processing and bank reconciliation workflows.

attributes.name: policy_year
attributes.description: The year in which the policy that generated the underlying claim was effective. Used for policy-year LAE development and reinsurance treaty year allocation.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; Reinsurance treaty terms

attributes.name: reinsurance_recoverable_amount
attributes.description: Portion of this expense recoverable from reinsurers under applicable treaty or facultative agreements. Used in Schedule F and bordereaux reporting.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F; Reinsurance treaty terms

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates this transaction is a reversal of a previously posted expense. Reversals carry a negative amount and reference the original transaction via original_expense_id.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter — Transaction reversal pattern; SAP/SSAP No. 55

attributes.name: service_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the service period covered by this expense. Together with service_start_date defines the billing period for period-based vendor engagements.

attributes.name: service_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the service period covered by this expense (e.g., legal retainer period, expert engagement). Used for period-based expense accrual.

attributes.name: siu_referral_flag
attributes.description: Indicates this expense has been flagged for SIU review due to suspected fraud, inflated billing, or unusual vendor patterns. Triggers SIU workflow.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter — SIU module; NAIC Model Fraud Regulation; FCRA

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this expense record was sourced. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and multi-system integration audits.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: The date the expense transaction was entered or posted in the claims management system. May differ from expense_date for late-reported or backdated entries.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this expense record. Used for incremental data pipeline processing and change-data-capture audit trails.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GLBA; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

products.name: loss_triangle
products.description: Actuarial loss development triangle per accident year, policy year, or calendar year cohort. Stores paid losses, incurred losses, case reserves, and IBNR by development period for Schedule P and reserving analytics.

attributes.name: loss_triangle_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each loss development triangle row. One row per cohort, development period, and triangle type combination.

attributes.name: catastrophegeography_peril_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophegeography.peril. Business justification: Actuarial loss development triangles are stratified by peril type for IBNR reserving and Schedule P reporting.

attributes.name: claimfinancials_accounting_period_id
attributes.description: References the accounting period (calendar quarter or year-end) as of which this triangle cell is evaluated.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: Multi-currency loss triangles for international operations require currency master for consistent development factor calculation, ultimate loss estimation, and functional currency

attributes.name: geography_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophegeography.geography. Business justification: Loss triangles are segmented by geographic territory for state-specific reserve adequacy analysis and NAIC Schedule P regulatory filings.

attributes.name: line_of_business_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.line_of_business. Business justification: Actuarial loss development analysis, IBNR estimation, and reserve adequacy testing require LOB master for development pattern selection, tail factor application, and regulatory

attributes.name: loss_approved_by_party_id
attributes.description: References the appointed actuary or senior reviewer who approved this triangle cell for statutory filing. Required for NAIC Annual Statement certification.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement; ASOP No. 43; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: loss_party_id
attributes.description: References the actuary or analyst responsible for selecting development factors and ultimate estimates for this triangle cell. Required for ORSA and SOX sign-off.
attributes.references: NAIC ORSA; SOX Section 302; Actuarial Standards Board

attributes.name: accident_half_year
attributes.description: Semi-annual sub-period within the cohort year (e.g., 2022-H1, 2022-H2) for lines requiring half-year granularity such as short-tail property.
attributes.references: CAS Loss Development Triangle Standards; Actuarial Reserving Best Practices

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the triangle cell was approved by the appointed actuary or senior reviewer for inclusion in the statutory or GAAP reserve filing.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement; SOX Section 302; ASOP No. 43

attributes.name: case_alae_reserve_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Case Allocated Loss Adjustment Expense (ALAE) Reserve Amount
attributes.description: Outstanding case reserve for allocated loss adjustment expenses (ALAE) on known open claims in this cohort as of the evaluation date.

tag_set.value: Case Allocated Loss Adjustment Expense (ALAE) Reserve Amount

attributes.name: case_reserve_amount
attributes.description: Outstanding case reserve (OSLR) held for known reported but unsettled claims in this cohort as of the evaluation date. Excludes IBNR.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP/SSAP No. 55; ASOP No. 43

attributes.name: catastrophe_flag
attributes.description: True if the losses in this triangle cell include catastrophe (CAT) event losses. Enables CAT vs. non-CAT loss triangle segmentation for PML and AAL analysis.
attributes.references: ISO PCS Catastrophe Definitions; NAIC Schedule P; RMS/AIR CAT Modeling Standards

attributes.name: claim_count_closed
attributes.description: Cumulative count of claims closed (with or without payment) for this cohort as of the evaluation date. Used in closure rate and tail factor analysis.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; CAS Reserving Standards

attributes.name: claim_count_open
attributes.description: Count of claims still open (RBNS) for this cohort as of the evaluation date. Derived operationally as reported minus closed; stored for audit and triangle integrity.

attributes.name: claim_count_reported
attributes.description: Cumulative count of claims reported for this cohort as of the evaluation date. Used in frequency-severity analysis and IBNR count triangles.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; CAS Loss Development Standards

attributes.name: cohort_type
attributes.description: Defines the basis for grouping losses into cohort rows: Accident Year (AY), Policy Year (PY), Calendar Year (CY), or Report Year. Determines triangle orientation.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; CAS Reserving Standards; ASOP No. 43

attributes.name: cohort_year
attributes.description: The four-digit year identifying the loss cohort row (e.g., accident year 2021, policy year 2020). Forms the vertical axis of the development triangle.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; CAS Loss Development Triangle Standards

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: Five-digit NAIC company code identifying the legal entity (insurance company) for which this triangle is reported. Required for statutory Schedule P filing.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement; NAIC Company Database

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this triangle record was first written to the data lakehouse. Supports audit trail and data lineage for statutory and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; GLBA

attributes.name: development_factor
attributes.description: Cumulative loss development factor (LDF) from this development period to ultimate, as selected by the actuary. Used to project ultimate losses from current incurred.
attributes.references: CAS Loss Development Triangle Standards; ASOP No. 43

attributes.name: development_period
attributes.description: Age of the cohort in months at the evaluation date (e.g., 12, 24, 36, 48). Forms the horizontal axis of the development triangle.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; CAS Loss Development Triangle Standards; ASOP No. 43

attributes.name: earned_premium_amount
attributes.description: Earned premium for the cohort year used as the denominator in loss ratio calculations. Enables calendar-year and accident-year loss ratio derivation.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP/SSAP No. 55; GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: evaluation_date
attributes.description: The as-of date at which losses in this triangle cell are measured. Typically a quarter-end or year-end date used for statutory and GAAP reserving.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement; SAP/SSAP No. 55; ASOP No. 43

attributes.name: gross_net_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the triangle amounts are gross of reinsurance, net of reinsurance, or represent the ceded portion only. Critical for Schedule F and reinsurance reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; Schedule F; SAP/SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: group_code
attributes.description: NAIC group code for the insurance holding company group. Enables consolidated group-level Schedule P and RBC reporting across affiliated entities.

attributes.name: ibnr_alae_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Incurred But Not Reported (IBNR) Allocated Loss Adjustment Expense (ALAE) Amount
attributes.description: Actuarial IBNR estimate for allocated loss adjustment expenses for this cohort. Combined with case ALAE reserve to form total ALAE reserve.

tag_set.value: Incurred But Not Reported (IBNR) Allocated Loss Adjustment Expense (ALAE) Amount

attributes.name: ibnr_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Incurred But Not Reported (IBNR) Reserve Amount
attributes.description: Actuarial estimate of losses incurred but not yet reported (IBNR), including IBNER development, for this cohort as of the evaluation date.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP/SSAP No. 55; ASOP No. 43

tag_set.value: Incurred But Not Reported (IBNR) Reserve Amount

attributes.name: incurred_loss_amount
attributes.description: Total incurred losses = paid losses + case reserves for this cohort and development period. Excludes IBNR. Used in loss ratio and Schedule P reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P Part 2; SAP/SSAP No. 55

attributes.name: is_diagonal
attributes.description: True if this cell falls on the latest diagonal of the triangle (most recent evaluation for each cohort year). Used to filter current reserve position for reporting.

attributes.name: is_tail_period
attributes.description: True if this development period is beyond the last observed data point and the amount is a tail-factor projection rather than an observed value.
attributes.references: CAS Loss Development Triangle Standards; ASOP No. 43

attributes.name: lob_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the line of business corresponding to lob_code, such as Private Passenger Auto Liability or Commercial General Liability.

attributes.name: paid_alae_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Paid Allocated Loss Adjustment Expense (ALAE) Amount
attributes.description: Cumulative paid allocated loss adjustment expenses (ALAE/DCC) for this cohort as of the evaluation date. Reported separately on NAIC Schedule P.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P Part 2; SAP/SSAP No. 55

tag_set.value: Paid Allocated Loss Adjustment Expense (ALAE) Amount

attributes.name: paid_loss_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative loss payments made to claimants for this cohort as of the evaluation date, excluding loss adjustment expenses. Core Schedule P column.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P Part 2; SAP/SSAP No. 55

attributes.name: prior_period_ultimate_amount
attributes.description: Ultimate loss estimate for this cohort from the prior evaluation period. Enables period-over-period reserve development and redundancy/deficiency analysis.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; ASOP No. 43; SAP/SSAP No. 55

attributes.name: reinsurance_program_type
attributes.description: Identifies the reinsurance structure applied when gross_net_indicator is net or ceded. Supports Schedule F and reinsurance bordereaux reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP/SSAP No. 62R; Reinsurance Association of America

attributes.name: reserve_development_amount
attributes.description: Change in ultimate loss estimate from prior to current evaluation period (favorable = negative, adverse = positive). Key metric for Schedule P reserve adequacy.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P Part 2; SAP/SSAP No. 55; ASOP No. 43

attributes.name: reserving_method
attributes.description: Actuarial method used to estimate ultimate losses for this triangle cell. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: chain_ladder|bornhuetter_ferguson|cape_cod|frequency_severity|clark_ldf|benktander|average_hindsight — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ASOP No. 43; CAS Reserving Standards; IFRS 17

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational source system that provided the underlying loss and premium data (e.g., ClaimCenter, reserving system). Supports data lineage.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standards; SOX Data Lineage Requirements

attributes.name: tail_factor
attributes.description: Selected tail factor applied beyond the last observed development period to project losses to ultimate. Critical for long-tail lines such as GL, WC, and D&O.
attributes.references: CAS Loss Development Triangle Standards; ASOP No. 43

attributes.name: triangle_run_number
attributes.description: References the actuarial reserving run or batch that produced this triangle snapshot, enabling version comparison across evaluation dates.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP) No. 43

attributes.name: triangle_status
attributes.description: Workflow status of this triangle cell within the actuarial reserving cycle. Approved and published cells are used for statutory filings; superseded cells are retained for audit.
attributes.references: NAIC ORSA; SAP/SSAP No. 55; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: triangle_type
attributes.description: Identifies the financial measure populating this triangle cell. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: paid_loss|incurred_loss|case_reserve|ibnr|paid_alae|incurred_alae|paid_ulae|lae_total — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP/SSAP No. 55; CAS Reserving Standards

attributes.name: ultimate_alae_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Ultimate Allocated Loss Adjustment Expense (ALAE) Amount
attributes.description: Actuarial estimate of total ultimate ALAE for this cohort = paid ALAE + case ALAE reserve + IBNR ALAE. Used in combined ratio and Schedule P analytics.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP/SSAP No. 55; ASOP No. 43

tag_set.value: Ultimate Allocated Loss Adjustment Expense (ALAE) Amount

attributes.name: ultimate_loss_amount
attributes.description: Actuarial estimate of total ultimate losses for this cohort = incurred losses + IBNR. The primary output of the reserving process used in Schedule P.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP/SSAP No. 55; ASOP No. 43

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this triangle record. Used to detect restatements and track reserve revisions across actuarial review cycles.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; NAIC Annual Statement; ASOP No. 43

attributes.name: written_premium_amount
attributes.description: Direct written premium (DPW) for the cohort year. Used alongside earned premium for policy year and accident year loss ratio benchmarking.

products.name: ibnr_estimate
products.description: Actuarial IBNR and IBNER estimate per LOB, accident year, and valuation date. Records selected ultimate, expected loss ratio, development factor, tail factor, and actuary sign-off. SSOT for IBNR positions.

attributes.name: ibnr_estimate_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Incurred But Not Reported (IBNR) Estimate ID
attributes.description: Unique surrogate primary key for each IBNR/IBNER actuarial estimate record. One row per LOB, accident year, and valuation date combination per actuarial run.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP SSAP No. 55

tag_set.value: Incurred But Not Reported (IBNR) Estimate ID

attributes.name: actuary_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Party record of the credentialed actuary (FCAS/ACAS) who reviewed and signed off on this IBNR estimate per NAIC actuarial opinion requirements.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Law on Actuarial Opinion; ASOP No. 43

attributes.name: catastrophegeography_peril_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophegeography.peril. Business justification: IBNR estimates are calculated separately by peril type for actuarial reserve adequacy and ultimate loss projections.

attributes.name: claimfinancials_accounting_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the accounting period (calendar quarter or year-end) in which this IBNR estimate was recorded for statutory and GAAP financial reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement; SAP SSAP No. 55

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: Multi-currency IBNR calculations for international portfolios require currency master for earned premium conversion, ultimate loss estimation, and functional currency consolidation.

attributes.name: geography_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophegeography.geography. Business justification: IBNR calculations are performed by state/territory for regulatory reserve requirements and state-specific actuarial certifications.

attributes.name: line_of_business_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.line_of_business. Business justification: Actuarial IBNR estimation by line of business is required for statutory reserve filings, NAIC Schedule P reporting, and reserve adequacy opinions.

attributes.name: underwriting_risk_score_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to coverage.underwriting_risk_score. Business justification: Actuarial IBNR models segment by underwriting risk score band to reflect loss emergence patterns by risk tier.

attributes.name: accident_year
attributes.description: The calendar year in which the insured loss events occurred. Used as the primary actuarial development dimension for loss triangles and IBNR estimation per Schedule P.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; CAS Statement of Principles on Loss Reserving

attributes.name: actuarial_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for the actuary to document material assumptions, data limitations, method selections, or qualifications associated with this IBNR estimate.
attributes.references: ASOP No. 43; NAIC Model Law on Actuarial Opinion

attributes.name: actuarial_run_number
attributes.description: Identifier for the actuarial reserving system batch run that produced this estimate. Enables traceability back to the specific model run in the Data Warehouse/Actuarial Reserving System.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; ASOP No. 43; NAIC Model Audit Rule (MAR)

attributes.name: actuary_signoff_date
attributes.description: Date on which the credentialed actuary formally approved and signed off on this IBNR estimate for inclusion in the statutory actuarial opinion or management reserve review.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Law on Actuarial Opinion; ASOP No. 43; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: age_to_age_factor
attributes.description: Selected cumulative loss development factor (LDF) from current age to ultimate, used to project reported or paid losses to their ultimate value in the chain ladder method.
attributes.references: CAS Statement of Principles on Loss Reserving; ASOP No. 43

attributes.name: case_reserve_amt
attributes.description: Outstanding case reserves (OSLR) held by claims adjusters for known reported claims as of the valuation date. Excludes IBNR and LAE reserves.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP SSAP No. 55; CAS Statement of Principles

attributes.name: claim_count_reported
attributes.description: Number of claims reported to the insurer for this accident year and LOB as of the valuation date. Used in frequency-severity IBNR methods and claim count development.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; CAS Statement of Principles on Loss Reserving

attributes.name: claim_count_ultimate
attributes.description: Actuarially selected ultimate number of claims expected for this accident year and LOB, including unreported claims. Used in frequency-severity IBNR estimation.
attributes.references: CAS Statement of Principles on Loss Reserving; ASOP No. 43

attributes.name: committee_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the reserve committee or senior management formally approved this IBNR estimate for booking to the general ledger and statutory financial statements.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Audit Rule (MAR); SOX Section 302; NAIC ORSA

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: Five-digit NAIC company code identifying the legal entity (insurance company) for which this IBNR estimate is prepared. Required for statutory filings.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement; NAIC Company Database

attributes.name: confidence_level
attributes.description: Statistical confidence level associated with the IBNR estimate (e.g., 0.75 = 75th percentile). Used in risk-based capital (RBC) and ORSA reserve adequacy assessments.
attributes.references: NAIC ORSA; NAIC RBC Instructions; ASOP No. 43

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this IBNR estimate record was first created in the actuarial reserving system or data warehouse. Used for audit trail and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; NAIC Model Audit Rule (MAR)

attributes.name: cumulative_ldf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cumulative Loss Development Factor (LDF) to Ultimate
attributes.description: Product of all age-to-age factors from current maturity to ultimate, including the tail factor. Applied to reported or paid losses to derive the selected ultimate.
attributes.references: CAS Statement of Principles on Loss Reserving; ASOP No. 43

tag_set.value: Cumulative Loss Development Factor (LDF) to Ultimate

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Operational system from which loss triangle data was sourced for this estimate (e.g., Data Warehouse/Actuarial Reserving System, ClaimCenter, manual upload).
attributes.references: NAIC Model Audit Rule (MAR); SOX Section 302

attributes.name: development_method
attributes.description: Actuarial method used to estimate IBNR (e.g., Chain Ladder, Bornhuetter-Ferguson, Cape Cod, Clark LDF, Frequency-Severity). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: chain_ladder|bornhuetter_ferguson|cape_cod|clark_ldf|frequency_severity|expected_loss — promote to reference
attributes.references: CAS Statement of Principles on Loss Reserving; ASOP No. 43

attributes.name: earned_premium_amt
attributes.description: Net earned premium for this accident year and LOB as of the valuation date, used as the denominator for loss ratio calculations and ELR derivation.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP SSAP No. 55

attributes.name: estimate_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for this actuarial estimate record, used in actuarial opinion letters, Schedule P filings, and reserving committee presentations.

attributes.name: estimate_status
attributes.description: Workflow status of this actuarial estimate. Only approved estimates are used in statutory filings. Superseded records are retained for audit trail.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Law on Actuarial Opinion; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: estimate_type
attributes.description: Distinguishes the type of actuarial reserve estimate: pure IBNR (unreported claims), IBNER (development on known claims), total IBNR, or LAE IBNR.
attributes.references: CAS Statement of Principles on Loss Reserving; ASOP No. 43

attributes.name: expected_loss_ratio
attributes.description: A priori expected loss ratio used in Bornhuetter-Ferguson and Cape Cod methods, derived from pricing or industry benchmarks. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.65 = 65%).
attributes.references: CAS Statement of Principles on Loss Reserving; ASOP No. 43

attributes.name: high_estimate_amt
attributes.description: Upper bound of the actuarial range of reasonable IBNR estimates as required by ASOP No. 43. Supports reserve adequacy disclosures in the actuarial opinion.
attributes.references: ASOP No. 43; NAIC Model Law on Actuarial Opinion

attributes.name: ibner_amt
attributes.business_glossary_term: Incurred But Not Enough Reported (IBNER) Amount
attributes.description: Estimated development on known reported claims where current case reserves are expected to be inadequate. Subset of total IBNR for IBNER-specific tracking.
attributes.references: CAS Statement of Principles on Loss Reserving; ASOP No. 43

tag_set.value: Incurred But Not Enough Reported (IBNER) Amount

attributes.name: ibnr_amt
attributes.business_glossary_term: Incurred But Not Reported (IBNR) Reserve Amount
attributes.description: Actuarially estimated reserve for losses incurred but not yet reported to the insurer as of the valuation date. Core output of this estimate record.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP SSAP No. 55; ASOP No. 43

tag_set.value: Incurred But Not Reported (IBNR) Reserve Amount

attributes.name: ibnr_claim_count
attributes.description: Estimated number of claims incurred but not yet reported as of the valuation date. Equals ultimate claim count minus reported claim count.
attributes.references: CAS Statement of Principles on Loss Reserving; ASOP No. 43

attributes.name: is_cat_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether catastrophe (CAT) losses are included in this IBNR estimate. Actuaries often produce separate ex-CAT and total estimates for Schedule P and PML analysis.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; CAS Statement of Principles; ISO CAT Codes

attributes.name: is_reinsurance_net
attributes.description: Indicates whether this IBNR estimate is net of reinsurance recoveries (true) or gross of reinsurance (false). Both gross and net estimates are required for Schedule F and IFRS 17.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 55; IFRS 17

attributes.name: lae_ibnr_amt
attributes.description: Actuarially estimated reserve for unallocated and allocated loss adjustment expenses (ULAE/ALAE) on unreported and underdeveloped claims as of the valuation date.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP SSAP No. 55; ASOP No. 43

attributes.name: lob_description
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the line of business corresponding to lob_code, such as Commercial Multi-Peril, Personal Auto Liability, or Homeowners.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement; ISO Statistical Plan

attributes.name: low_estimate_amt
attributes.description: Lower bound of the actuarial range of reasonable IBNR estimates as required by ASOP No. 43. Supports reserve adequacy disclosures in the actuarial opinion.
attributes.references: ASOP No. 43; NAIC Model Law on Actuarial Opinion

attributes.name: paid_losses_amt
attributes.description: Cumulative loss payments made through the valuation date for this accident year and LOB, net of recoveries. Used in paid loss development triangle.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP SSAP No. 55

attributes.name: percent_developed
attributes.description: Reciprocal of the cumulative LDF, representing the estimated proportion of ultimate losses already reported or paid as of the valuation date (e.g., 0.80 = 80% developed).
attributes.references: CAS Statement of Principles on Loss Reserving; ASOP No. 43

attributes.name: prior_ibnr_amt
attributes.description: IBNR estimate from the immediately preceding valuation date for this accident year and LOB. Enables period-over-period reserve development and redundancy/deficiency analysis.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP SSAP No. 55; ASOP No. 43

attributes.name: reported_losses_amt
attributes.description: Cumulative paid losses plus case reserves (OSLR) as of the valuation date for this accident year and LOB. Serves as the starting point for IBNR development.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP SSAP No. 55

attributes.name: reserve_change_amt
attributes.description: Change in IBNR estimate from prior valuation to current valuation (current minus prior). Positive indicates reserve strengthening; negative indicates redundancy release.
