attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP SSAP No. 55; ASOP No. 43

attributes.name: reserving_basis
attributes.description: Accounting basis under which this IBNR estimate is prepared: Statutory Accounting Principles (SAP), US GAAP, IFRS 17, or internal management basis.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 55; US GAAP ASC 944; IFRS 17

attributes.name: tail_factor
attributes.description: Loss development factor applied beyond the last observed development period to account for late-emerging losses. Critical for long-tail lines such as GL, WC, and medical malpractice.
attributes.references: CAS Statement of Principles on Loss Reserving; ASOP No. 43

attributes.name: triangle_maturity_months
attributes.description: Age of the accident year in months as of the valuation date (e.g., 12, 24, 36). Identifies the column position in the loss development triangle used for this estimate.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; CAS Statement of Principles on Loss Reserving

attributes.name: ulr
attributes.description: Selected ultimate loss ratio for this accident year and LOB, calculated as ultimate loss amount divided by earned premium. Key actuarial KPI for reserving adequacy.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; CAS Statement of Principles; ASOP No. 43

attributes.name: ultimate_loss_amt
attributes.description: Actuary-selected ultimate loss estimate for this accident year and LOB, representing total expected losses at full development. Equals reported losses plus IBNR.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; ASOP No. 43; CAS Statement of Principles

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this IBNR estimate record. Tracks revisions during the review and approval workflow prior to statutory filing.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; NAIC Model Audit Rule (MAR)

attributes.name: valuation_date
attributes.description: The as-of date through which loss development data was compiled for this estimate. Defines the maturity of the accident year triangle used in the actuarial analysis.

products.name: claimfinancials_accounting_period
products.description: Reference calendar for financial close cycles. Defines calendar year, accident year, policy year, and fiscal period boundaries used to bucket premium, loss, and expense transactions for statutory and GAAP reporting.

attributes.name: claimfinancials_accounting_period_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each accounting period record. Primary key. _canonical_skip_reason: REFERENCE_LOOKUP — this is a reference calendar/dimension table; per-role minimums are exempt.

attributes.name: prior_period_claimfinancials_accounting_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the immediately preceding accounting period. Supports period-over-period variance analysis, loss triangle chaining, and reserve roll-forward calculations.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P, Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP) No. 43

attributes.name: accident_year
attributes.description: Four-digit accident year for loss development triangles and IBNR estimation. Losses are bucketed by the year the loss event occurred, per actuarial reserving standards.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P, Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP) No. 43

attributes.name: bordereaux_period_code
attributes.description: Period code used in reinsurance bordereaux submissions to treaty reinsurers. Aligns cession, premium, and loss data to the reinsurer's reporting calendar.
attributes.references: Reinsurance Bordereaux & Regulatory Reporting Repository, SICS/Sapiens ReinsurancePro

attributes.name: calendar_year
attributes.description: Four-digit calendar year (January–December). Used for CY loss ratio, CY written premium, and CY combined ratio analytics per NAIC Schedule P.

attributes.name: close_date
attributes.description: Date on which the accounting period was officially closed (soft close). After this date, new transactions require a journal entry adjustment or period reopening.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this accounting period record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for financial transactions booked in this period (e.g., USD). Supports multi-currency statutory and GAAP reporting.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Last calendar date included in this accounting period (inclusive). Transactions with an effective date on or before this date fall within the period.

attributes.name: fiscal_month
attributes.description: Month number (1–12) within the fiscal year. Used for monthly close cycles, premium booking, and loss reserve movements in the GL.

attributes.name: fiscal_quarter
attributes.description: Quarter number (1–4) within the fiscal year. Used for quarterly statutory filings, NAIC quarterly statements, and interim GAAP reporting.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP, US GAAP (FASB), NAIC Quarterly Statement

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Four-digit fiscal year to which this period belongs (e.g., 2024). Aligns with the company's statutory and GAAP reporting year.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP, US GAAP (FASB), NAIC Annual Statement

attributes.name: fx_rate_to_usd
attributes.description: Exchange rate to USD applicable for this period's financial translations. Used for multi-currency consolidation in statutory and GAAP reporting.

attributes.name: gl_period_code
attributes.description: Period code as defined in the General Ledger system (Oracle/SAP). Used to reconcile premium, loss, and expense transactions between the data warehouse and the GL.

attributes.name: ifrs17_reporting_period
attributes.description: Period identifier as used in IFRS 17 insurance contract reporting (e.g., '2024-Q1'). Supports CSM amortization, loss component tracking, and IFRS 17 disclosure requirements.

attributes.name: is_quarter_end
attributes.description: True if this period is the last month of a fiscal quarter, triggering quarterly NAIC statement preparation and interim GAAP reporting.

attributes.name: is_stub_period
attributes.description: True if this period is a partial period (fewer days than a standard month), such as a company formation period or mid-year fiscal year change.

attributes.name: is_year_end
attributes.description: True if this period represents the final period of the fiscal or calendar year, triggering year-end statutory close, NAIC Annual Statement preparation, and RBC calculations.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement, SAP/SSAP, RBC Requirements

attributes.name: lock_date
attributes.description: Date on which the period was hard-locked, preventing any further postings. Supports SOX controls and statutory filing integrity.

attributes.name: loss_development_lag
attributes.description: Number of months elapsed from the accident year start to this period's end date. Used to position the period on loss development triangles for IBNR and IBNER estimation.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P, Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP) No. 43

attributes.name: naic_statement_period
attributes.description: NAIC filing period designation: Q1, Q2, Q3 for quarterly statements, or ANNUAL for the year-end NAIC Annual Statement. Drives statutory reporting schedules.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement, NAIC Quarterly Statement, SAP/SSAP

attributes.name: period_basis
attributes.description: Actuarial and statutory basis: CY (Calendar Year), AY (Accident Year), PY (Policy Year), or FY (Fiscal Year). Drives loss triangle bucketing and Schedule P reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P, SAP/SSAP, Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP)

attributes.name: period_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the period (e.g., CY-2024-03 for calendar year 2024 March). Used in GL, statutory, and bordereaux reporting.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP, NAIC Annual Statement, Oracle/SAP GL

attributes.name: period_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days in this accounting period. Used for daily pro-rata premium earning, exposure day calculations, and IFRS 17 coverage unit computations.

attributes.name: period_name
attributes.description: Human-readable label for the period (e.g., 'March 2024', 'Q1 2024', 'AY 2023'). Used in reports, dashboards, and statutory filings.

attributes.name: period_status
attributes.description: Current state of the period in the financial close lifecycle: OPEN (transactions posting), CLOSED (soft close), LOCKED (hard close, no further postings), REOPENED (adjustment window).
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP, US GAAP (FASB), Oracle/SAP GL, SOX

attributes.name: period_type
attributes.description: Granularity of the period: MONTHLY for standard close cycles, QUARTERLY for interim reporting, SEMI_ANNUAL, or ANNUAL for year-end statutory filings.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP, US GAAP (FASB), IFRS 17 (IASB), NAIC Annual Statement

attributes.name: policy_year
attributes.description: Four-digit policy year for policy-year loss development. Losses and premium are bucketed by the year the policy was written, used in Schedule P and reinsurance bordereaux.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P, SAP/SSAP, Reinsurance Bordereaux

attributes.name: premium_earning_method
attributes.description: Method used to earn written premium into earned premium during this period: PRO_RATA (daily pro-rata), RULE_OF_78, DAILY, or MONTHLY. Drives UEP and EP calculations.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 66, NAIC Annual Statement, ISO Rating

attributes.name: reopen_date
attributes.description: Date on which a previously closed or locked period was reopened for adjustment postings. Null if the period has never been reopened.

attributes.name: reporting_framework
attributes.description: Accounting framework under which this period is reported: SAP (Statutory Accounting Principles), GAAP (US GAAP/FASB), IFRS17 (IASB IFRS 17), or STATUTORY for state-specific filings.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP, US GAAP (FASB), IFRS 17 (IASB), NAIC Annual Statement

attributes.name: schedule_p_period_label
attributes.description: Label used to identify this period on NAIC Schedule P loss development exhibits (e.g., '2024 1 Year', '2023 2 Years'). Supports actuarial reserving and regulatory filing.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record that originated this period definition (e.g., 'ORACLE_GL', 'SAP_FI'). Supports data lineage and reconciliation.
attributes.references: Oracle/SAP GL, SOX, Model Audit Rule (MAR)

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: First calendar date included in this accounting period. Transactions with an effective date on or after this date fall within the period.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this accounting period record. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and SOX compliance.

products.name: financial_transaction
products.description: One row per atomic double-entry posting generated by a claim financial event (reserve, payment, recovery, expense), keyed to claim exposure and accounting period. Grain: one row per financial movement per claim exposure.

attributes.name: financial_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate key for each atomic double-entry posting generated by a claim financial event. One row per financial movement per claim exposure. Grain: one row per posting.

attributes.name: catastrophe_event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the catastrophe event (CAT) associated with this financial transaction, if the underlying loss is part of a declared catastrophe. Supports CAT loss aggregation and PML reporting.
attributes.references: ISO PCS Catastrophe Codes, RMS RiskLink, NAIC CAT Reporting

attributes.name: claim_exposure_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific coverage line within the claim (Claim Exposure) that this financial movement is attributed to. Drives per-coverage financial reporting.

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent claim under which this financial movement was generated. Links the posting to the reported loss event.

attributes.name: claimfinancials_accounting_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the accounting period in which this financial transaction is recognized for statutory and GAAP reporting purposes.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP, GAAP, IFRS 17, NAIC Annual Statement

attributes.name: original_transaction_financial_transaction_id
attributes.description: For reversal or correction transactions, references the original financial_transaction_id that this entry offsets or corrects. Null for original (non-reversal) postings.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: System user ID of the adjuster, supervisor, or financial controller who authorized this financial transaction. Required for authority limit compliance and SOX audit trail.
attributes.references: SOX, NAIC Market Conduct Standards, Guidewire ClaimCenter

attributes.name: payment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the associated claim payment record when this financial transaction represents a disbursement. Links the GL posting to the payment instrument record for reconciliation.

attributes.name: ri_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reinsurance agreement (treaty or facultative) under which the ceded portion of this transaction is recoverable. Null if no reinsurance applies.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 62, NAIC Schedule F, Sapiens ReinsurancePro

attributes.name: salvage_id
attributes.description: Reference to the associated salvage record when this financial transaction represents a salvage recovery. Links the GL posting to the salvage disposition record.

attributes.name: accident_year
attributes.description: The calendar year in which the loss event (accident) occurred. Used for accident year (AY) loss development triangles and actuarial reserving analysis per NAIC Schedule P.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P, Actuarial Standards of Practice No. 43

attributes.name: ap_batch_number
attributes.description: Identifier of the accounts payable batch run in which this financial transaction was processed and disbursed. Used for payment reconciliation and GL batch balancing.

attributes.name: authority_limit_amount
attributes.description: The financial authority limit of the approving user at the time of authorization. Confirms the transaction was within delegated authority and supports SOX internal controls.
attributes.references: SOX, NAIC Market Conduct Standards, Guidewire ClaimCenter

attributes.name: calendar_year
attributes.description: The calendar year in which this financial transaction was posted. Used for calendar year (CY) incurred loss and paid loss reporting in statutory financial statements.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement, SAP/SSAP, NAIC Schedule P

attributes.name: ceded_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the gross amount ceded to reinsurers under applicable treaty or facultative agreements. Used for net retained loss calculation and reinsurance bordereaux reporting.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 62, NAIC Schedule F, IFRS 17

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Organizational cost center to which this financial transaction is allocated for internal management accounting and expense reporting purposes.
attributes.references: Oracle/SAP GL, SOX, Internal Management Accounting Standards

attributes.name: coverage_type_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific coverage type (e.g., BI, PD, COMP, COLL, MED_PAY, UM/UIM) associated with this financial posting. Enables coverage-level financial analysis.
attributes.references: ISO Coverage Forms, ACORD Standards, NAIC Schedule P

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this financial transaction record was first created in the claims management system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: SOX, GLBA, NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the transaction amounts (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP). Required for multi-currency operations and statutory reporting.

attributes.name: current_balance_amount
attributes.description: The reserve or financial balance on the claim exposure immediately after this transaction was applied. Supports outstanding loss reserve (OSLR) and IBNR reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P, SAP/SSAP No. 55, Actuarial Reserving Standards

attributes.name: deductible_offset_amount
attributes.description: Amount of the financial transaction attributable to the insured's deductible or self-insured retention (SIR), reducing the insurer's net liability on this posting.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 55, GAAP ASC 944, ISO Policy Forms

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this financial transaction is effective for accounting and reserving purposes. May differ from transaction_date for backdated adjustments or period corrections.

attributes.name: expense_category
attributes.description: For expense-type transactions, classifies the LAE component: DCC (Defense and Cost Containment), AO (Adjusting and Other), ULAE (Unallocated Loss Adjustment Expense). Null for non-expense transactions.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P, SAP/SSAP No. 55, GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The GL account code to which this financial transaction is posted in the general ledger system (Oracle/SAP). Enables reconciliation between claims system and statutory financial statements.

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: The full gross monetary amount of this financial posting before any reinsurance, deductible, or offset adjustments. Positive for charges/losses; negative for recoveries/credits.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 55, GAAP ASC 944, IFRS 17, NAIC Schedule P

attributes.name: lob_code
attributes.description: NAIC or internal line of business code classifying the coverage type associated with this financial transaction (e.g., HO, PAP, CGL, CA, WC, BOP). Supports Schedule P segmentation.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Schedule P, NAIC Line of Business Codes

attributes.name: loss_category
attributes.description: Categorizes the financial movement by loss component: INDEMNITY (property/liability loss), MEDICAL (bodily injury medical), LAE (loss adjustment expense), ALAE (allocated LAE), ULAE (unallocated LAE), OTHER.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P, SAP/SSAP No. 55, GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: Net retained amount after deducting ceded reinsurance and deductible offsets from the gross amount. Represents the insurer's ultimate net loss (UNL) for this posting.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 55, GAAP ASC 944, NAIC Schedule P, IFRS 17

attributes.name: policy_year
attributes.description: The year in which the policy that generated this claim was effective. Used for policy year (PY) loss development and underwriting year profitability analysis.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P, SAP/SSAP, Actuarial Standards of Practice

attributes.name: posted_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this financial transaction was posted to the general ledger and claims system. Used for audit trail and reconciliation with GL batch runs.
attributes.references: Oracle/SAP GL, SOX, NAIC Annual Statement

attributes.name: prior_balance_amount
attributes.description: The reserve or financial balance on the claim exposure immediately before this transaction was applied. Enables incremental change analysis and reserve development tracking.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P, SAP/SSAP No. 55, Actuarial Reserving Standards

attributes.name: reinsurance_recoverable_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether any portion of this financial transaction is recoverable from reinsurers under a treaty or facultative agreement. Drives reinsurance bordereaux and Schedule F reporting.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 62, NAIC Schedule F, IFRS 17

attributes.name: reserve_type
attributes.description: For reserve transactions, identifies the reserve category: CASE (case reserve set by adjuster), IBNR (incurred but not reported), IBNER (incurred but not enough reported), LAE (loss adjustment expense reserve). Null for non-reserve transactions.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P, SAP/SSAP No. 55, Actuarial Standards of Practice

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transaction is a reversal (offsetting entry) of a previously posted financial transaction. True if this is a correcting reversal entry.

attributes.name: siu_referral_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this financial transaction has been flagged for review by the Special Investigations Unit (SIU) due to suspected fraud or irregularity.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Fraud Act, NICB, Guidewire ClaimCenter SIU Module

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record that originated this financial transaction (e.g., CLAIMCENTER, DUCK_CREEK, GL, MANUAL, REINS_PRO). Supports data lineage and reconciliation.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement, SOX, Internal Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: source_transaction_reference
attributes.description: The native transaction identifier or reference number from the originating source system (e.g., ClaimCenter transaction ID, GL journal entry number). Enables cross-system reconciliation.

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code for the jurisdiction in which this financial transaction is reported. Required for state-level statutory reporting to Departments of Insurance (DOI).
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement, State DOI Reporting Requirements, ISO

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the financial event occurred (e.g., reserve change effective date, payment issue date, recovery receipt date). Principal real-world event date for this posting.

attributes.name: transaction_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative describing the reason for or nature of this financial posting (e.g., 'Initial case reserve set at FNOL', 'Partial indemnity payment to claimant'). Supports adjuster notes.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter, NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: transaction_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable reference number assigned to this financial posting by the claims management or general ledger system. Used for audit trails and reconciliation.

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the financial posting: PENDING (awaiting approval), POSTED (booked to GL), REVERSED (offset entry created), VOIDED (cancelled before posting), APPROVED (authorized, not yet posted).

attributes.name: transaction_subtype
attributes.description: Granular classification within the transaction type. Examples: CASE_RESERVE, IBNR_RESERVE, LAE_RESERVE, INDEMNITY_PAYMENT, MEDICAL_PAYMENT, SUBROGATION_RECOVERY, SALVAGE_RECOVERY, REINSURANCE_RECOVERY, DCC_EXPENSE, AO_EXPENSE.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P, SAP/SSAP No. 55, GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: High-level category of the financial movement: RESERVE (case/IBNR/LAE reserve), PAYMENT (indemnity/LAE disbursement), RECOVERY (subrogation/salvage/reinsurance), or EXPENSE (DCC/AO/ULAE).
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P, SAP/SSAP No. 55, GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this financial transaction record was last modified. Tracks corrections, reversals, and status changes for audit and reconciliation purposes.
attributes.references: SOX, GLBA, NAIC Market Conduct Standards

products.name: reinsurance_recovery
products.description: One row per reinsurance recovery billing per claim exposure and treaty or facultative agreement. Tracks ceded loss amount, ceded LAE, recovery billed, recovery collected, and outstanding balance. Links claim to reinsurance cession.

attributes.name: reinsurance_recovery_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each reinsurance recovery billing record. One row per reinsurance recovery billing per claim exposure and treaty or facultative agreement.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: claim_exposure_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific coverage line (claim exposure) within the claim to which this recovery applies.

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent claim from which this reinsurance recovery originates.

attributes.name: claimfinancials_accounting_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the accounting period in which this recovery transaction is recognized for statutory and GAAP financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; US GAAP ASC 944; IFRS 17

attributes.name: reinsurance_cession_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reinsurance cession record that establishes the cedant's share ceded to the reinsurer under the applicable agreement.

attributes.name: reinsurer_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party record representing the reinsurer from whom recovery is sought.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: ri_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reinsurance agreement (treaty or facultative) under which this recovery is billed.

attributes.name: ri_recovery_id
attributes.description: FK to reinsurance.ri_recovery.ri_recovery_id — Links the cedant-side reinsurance recovery accrual to the reinsurance ceded-loss ledger so ceded recovery is booked once and reconciled, preventing double-counting of recoverables (VREQ-009/VREQ-014).

attributes.name: accident_year
attributes.description: Calendar year in which the loss event occurred. Used for actuarial loss triangle development and reinsurance bordereaux reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: agreement_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the recovery is under a treaty (automatic) or facultative (individually negotiated) reinsurance agreement.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: attachment_point
attributes.description: The loss threshold above which the reinsurer's obligation begins under an Excess of Loss (XOL) or Stop Loss (SL) treaty layer.

attributes.name: authorized_control_level_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reinsurer is an authorized (admitted) reinsurer for statutory credit purposes, affecting RBC and Schedule F treatment.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; NAIC RBC; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: billing_date
attributes.description: The date on which the reinsurance recovery was billed to the reinsurer. Principal business event date for this transaction.

attributes.name: bordereaux_period
attributes.description: The reporting period (YYYY-MM or YYYY-Q#) in which this recovery is included in the reinsurance bordereaux submission to the reinsurer.
attributes.references: SICS/Sapiens ReinsurancePro; NAIC Schedule F; ACORD

attributes.name: cash_call_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this recovery was billed as an interim cash call to the reinsurer prior to final claim settlement, as permitted under large-loss provisions.

attributes.name: ceded_lae_amount
attributes.description: Loss Adjustment Expense (LAE) amount ceded to the reinsurer, including both Allocated LAE (ALAE) and Unallocated LAE (ULAE) where applicable.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F; NAIC Schedule P

attributes.name: ceded_loss_amount
attributes.description: Gross indemnity loss amount ceded to the reinsurer under the applicable agreement for this claim exposure. Excludes LAE.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F; IFRS 17

attributes.name: cession_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the loss ceded to the reinsurer under the applicable agreement, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.7500 = 75%). Applicable primarily to quota share treaties.

attributes.name: collateral_held_amount
attributes.description: Amount of collateral (letters of credit, trust funds) held from the reinsurer that can be applied against this outstanding recovery balance.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R; State DOI regulations

attributes.name: collection_date
attributes.description: The date on which the recovery amount was actually received from the reinsurer. Null if not yet collected.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: commutation_indicator
attributes.description: Flags whether this recovery record has been settled via a commutation agreement, extinguishing future obligations between cedant and reinsurer.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: coverage_type_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the coverage type within the claim exposure (e.g., dwelling, liability, collision, comprehensive). Drives treaty layer applicability.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this reinsurance recovery record was first created in the Reinsurance Management System.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this recovery record (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR).

attributes.name: days_overdue
attributes.description: Number of calendar days the outstanding recovery balance has been past the contractual due date. Used for Schedule F aging buckets and credit risk monitoring.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: disputed_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the billed recovery amount that the reinsurer has formally disputed. Tracked separately for collections and reserving purposes.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Contractual due date by which the reinsurer is obligated to remit the recovery amount per the reinsurance agreement terms.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General Ledger account code to which this reinsurance recovery is posted in the statutory and GAAP financial statements.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; US GAAP ASC 944; SOX

attributes.name: lob_code
attributes.description: NAIC or internal Line of Business code for the underlying policy (e.g., HO, PAP, CGL, BOP, CA). Used for treaty allocation and Schedule F/P reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: HO|PAP|CGL|BOP|CA|WC|CPP|EPLI|DO|EO — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: loss_date
attributes.description: Date of the underlying loss event. Used to determine which treaty year and layer applies for accident year (AY) and policy year (PY) reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by reinsurance analysts documenting dispute details, collection actions, commutation terms, or other recovery-specific commentary.

attributes.name: outstanding_balance
attributes.description: Unpaid balance owed by the reinsurer, calculated as recovery billed minus recovery collected. Used for Schedule F overdue reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: overdue_indicator
attributes.description: Flags recoveries where the outstanding balance has exceeded the contractual due date. Drives NAIC Schedule F overdue reinsurance reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: policy_year
attributes.description: Year in which the policy that generated the claim was written. Used for policy year (PY) reinsurance treaty allocation and bordereaux.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: recovery_billed_amount
attributes.description: Total amount billed to the reinsurer for this recovery, combining ceded loss and ceded LAE. Represents the gross recovery claim submitted.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: recovery_collected_amount
attributes.description: Actual amount received from the reinsurer to date. May be less than billed if partial payment or dispute exists.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: recovery_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this recovery billing, used in bordereaux reporting and reinsurer correspondence. Assigned by the Reinsurance Management System.

attributes.name: recovery_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the recovery billing. Tracks progression from initial billing through collection or write-off.

attributes.name: recovery_type
attributes.description: Classifies the nature of the recovery: indemnity loss, Loss Adjustment Expense (LAE), combined loss and LAE, salvage share, or subrogation share.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F; ISO

attributes.name: reinsurer_limit
attributes.description: Maximum amount the reinsurer is obligated to pay under the applicable treaty layer or facultative certificate for this claim.

attributes.name: retention_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the loss retained by the cedant (Pc_Insurance) after cession. For XOL treaties, this equals the Self-Insured Retention (SIR) or attachment point.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: settlement_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the reinsurance settlement or cash call under which this recovery was remitted by the reinsurer.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this recovery record was sourced (e.g., SAPIENS for Sapiens ReinsurancePro, SICS, or MANUAL for manual entries).

attributes.name: treaty_type
attributes.description: Specifies the treaty structure: Quota Share (QS), Excess of Loss (XOL), Stop Loss (SL), or Catastrophe Excess of Loss (CAT XL). Null for facultative agreements.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this reinsurance recovery record.

attributes.name: written_off_amount
attributes.description: Amount of the recovery deemed uncollectible and written off, typically due to reinsurer insolvency or commutation agreement.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F; State Guaranty Associations

products.name: claim_financial_snapshot
products.description: Point-in-time financial position per claim exposure as of a valuation date. Stores total incurred (paid + case reserve), IBNR allocation, ceded amounts, net retained position, and prior-period comparison for statutory reporting.

attributes.name: claim_financial_snapshot_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate key for each point-in-time financial position record per claim exposure and valuation date. Grain: one row per claim exposure per valuation date.

attributes.name: catastrophe_event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the catastrophe event record when the claim is CAT-designated. Links to PCS bulletin or internal CAT event for aggregate PML reporting.
attributes.references: ISO PCS, RMS RiskLink, Verisk AIR Touchstone

attributes.name: claim_exposure_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific coverage line within the claim (Claim Exposure) for which this financial position is recorded.

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent claim record for which this financial snapshot is captured.

attributes.name: claimfinancials_accounting_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the accounting period (calendar month/quarter/year) in which this snapshot is valued for statutory and GAAP reporting.

attributes.name: coverage_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific coverage (e.g., BI, PD, Comp, Collision) under which this claim exposure is adjudicated.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the policy under which the claim was filed, enabling policy-year and underwriting-year loss aggregation.

attributes.name: quote_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to coverage.quote. Business justification: Pricing actuaries perform quote-vs-actual loss ratio analysis to validate rating adequacy.

attributes.name: reinsurance_cession_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific reinsurance cession record for this claim exposure. Links to bordereaux reporting and RI recovery tracking.

attributes.name: ri_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary reinsurance agreement (treaty or facultative) under which ceded amounts are reported for this claim exposure.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F, SAP/SSAP No. 62R, Sapiens ReinsurancePro

attributes.name: riskexposure_insured_risk_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to riskexposure.insured_risk. Business justification: Catastrophe modelers aggregate incurred losses by geocoded property locations and construction types for event loss estimation.

attributes.name: accident_year
attributes.description: The calendar year in which the loss event occurred. Used for Schedule P loss triangle development and actuarial reserving by accident year.

attributes.name: case_reserve_amount
attributes.description: Outstanding case reserve (OSLR) set by the adjuster for this claim exposure as of the valuation date. Represents the estimated future loss payment.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P, SAP/SSAP No. 55, Guidewire ClaimCenter

attributes.name: catastrophe_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this claim exposure is associated with a declared catastrophe event. Drives CAT loss reporting and reinsurance CAT XL recovery.
attributes.references: ISO PCS Catastrophe Bulletins, NAIC, RMS RiskLink

attributes.name: ceded_ibnr_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Ceded Incurred But Not Reported (IBNR) Amount
attributes.description: Portion of the IBNR reserve ceded to reinsurers as of the valuation date. Used for net IBNR and Schedule F reinsurance reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F, SAP/SSAP No. 62R, IFRS 17

tag_set.value: Ceded Incurred But Not Reported (IBNR) Amount

attributes.name: ceded_paid_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative loss payments ceded to and recovered from reinsurers on this claim exposure through the valuation date.

attributes.name: ceded_reserve_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the outstanding case reserve ceded to reinsurers under treaty or facultative agreements as of the valuation date.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F, SAP/SSAP No. 62R, Reinsurance Management System

attributes.name: claim_status
attributes.description: Current adjudication status of the claim as of the valuation date. Drives reserve adequacy assessment and closure rate analytics.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter, NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: coverage_type_code
attributes.description: Specific coverage type within the LOB (e.g., BI, PD, COMP, COLL, MED, UMBI) identifying the peril or benefit being claimed.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this snapshot (e.g., USD). Supports multi-currency reinsurance reporting.

attributes.name: deductible_amount
attributes.description: Policyholder deductible applicable to this claim exposure. Reduces the insurer's gross loss payment obligation.

attributes.name: development_period
attributes.description: Number of months elapsed from the accident year start to the valuation date. Used as the x-axis in loss development triangles (e.g., 12, 24, 36 months).
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P, Actuarial Standards of Practice

attributes.name: ibnr_reserve_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Incurred But Not Reported (IBNR) Reserve Amount
attributes.description: Actuarially allocated IBNR reserve for this claim exposure or cohort as of the valuation date. Includes IBNER development on known claims.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P, Actuarial Standards of Practice No. 43, SAP/SSAP No. 55

tag_set.value: Incurred But Not Reported (IBNR) Reserve Amount

attributes.name: lae_reserve_amount
attributes.description: Case reserve for allocated loss adjustment expenses (ALAE/DCC) associated with this claim exposure as of the valuation date.

attributes.name: lob_code
attributes.description: NAIC line of business code classifying the coverage (e.g., 01=Fire, 05=CMP, 19=Auto Liability, 21=Workers Comp). Drives Schedule P grouping.

attributes.name: net_incurred_amount
attributes.description: Net retained total incurred loss after reinsurance cessions and recoveries. Key metric for net loss ratio and RBC capital calculations.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P, SAP/SSAP No. 55, RBC requirements

attributes.name: net_reserve_amount
attributes.description: Net retained case reserve after cessions to reinsurers (gross case reserve minus ceded reserve). Represents the company's retained liability.

attributes.name: paid_lae_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative allocated loss adjustment expense (ALAE) payments made on this claim exposure through the valuation date.

attributes.name: paid_loss_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative loss payments made on this claim exposure through the valuation date, net of recoveries. Excludes LAE payments.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P, SAP/SSAP No. 55, Guidewire ClaimCenter

attributes.name: policy_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum coverage limit applicable to this claim exposure as of the loss date. Used to cap incurred amounts and assess limit adequacy.

attributes.name: policy_year
attributes.description: The year in which the policy that generated this claim was written. Used for policy-year loss development and reinsurance treaty year allocation.

attributes.name: prior_period_incurred_amount
attributes.description: Total incurred amount as of the immediately preceding valuation period. Enables period-over-period reserve development and redundancy/deficiency analysis.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P, Actuarial Standards of Practice No. 43

attributes.name: prior_period_paid_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative paid loss as of the immediately preceding valuation period. Used to compute incremental paid loss development in loss triangles.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P, Actuarial Standards of Practice

attributes.name: report_year
attributes.description: The calendar year in which the claim was first reported (FNOL). Used for reported-year loss triangles and IBNR analysis.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P, Actuarial Standards of Practice

attributes.name: reserve_basis
attributes.description: Identifies the reserving methodology basis for this snapshot record (case, IBNR, LAE, ULAE, or bulk). Supports actuarial triangle segmentation.
attributes.references: Actuarial Standards of Practice No. 43, NAIC Schedule P

attributes.name: reserve_change_amount
attributes.description: Change in total incurred from prior period to current valuation date (current incurred minus prior incurred). Positive = strengthening; negative = release.

attributes.name: salvage_reserve_amount
attributes.description: Estimated future salvage recovery reserved against this claim exposure as of the valuation date. Reduces net incurred loss.

attributes.name: sir_amount
attributes.description: Self-insured retention amount applicable to this claim exposure for large commercial accounts. Insurer pays above the SIR threshold.

attributes.name: snapshot_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this financial snapshot record was first created in the data warehouse. Supports audit trail and data lineage for statutory reporting.
attributes.references: SOX, NAIC Model Audit Rule (MAR), SAP/SSAP

attributes.name: snapshot_status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of this financial snapshot record indicating whether it is the current active position or has been superseded by a later valuation.

attributes.name: snapshot_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this financial snapshot record was last modified. Used to detect restatements and track reserve re-estimations over time.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record that originated this financial data (e.g., CLAIMCENTER, RESERVING_DW, ACTUARIAL). Supports data lineage.

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code where the insured risk is located or the loss occurred. Required for state-level statutory reporting to DOI.

attributes.name: subrogation_reserve_amount
attributes.description: Estimated future subrogation recovery reserved against this claim exposure as of the valuation date. Reduces net incurred loss.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P, Guidewire ClaimCenter Recovery module

attributes.name: total_incurred_amount
attributes.description: Total incurred loss = paid loss + case reserve + IBNR allocation as of the valuation date. Primary metric for Schedule P and loss ratio reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P, SAP/SSAP No. 55, IFRS 17

attributes.name: total_incurred_lae_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Total Incurred Loss Adjustment Expense (LAE) Amount
attributes.description: Total incurred LAE = paid LAE + LAE reserve as of the valuation date. Used for combined ratio and expense ratio statutory reporting.

tag_set.value: Total Incurred Loss Adjustment Expense (LAE) Amount

attributes.name: total_recovery_collected_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative subrogation, salvage, and other third-party recoveries actually collected on this claim exposure through the valuation date.

attributes.name: ulae_reserve_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Unallocated Loss Adjustment Expense (ULAE) Reserve Amount
attributes.description: Allocated portion of the ULAE reserve for this claim exposure as of the valuation date. Covers overhead claims handling costs not directly assignable.

tag_set.value: Unallocated Loss Adjustment Expense (ULAE) Reserve Amount

attributes.name: valuation_date
attributes.description: The as-of date for this financial snapshot. All reserve, paid, and incurred amounts reflect the financial position as of this date.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement, SAP/SSAP No. 55, IFRS 17

products.name: lae_allocation
products.description: Allocates unallocated LAE (ULAE) to individual claim exposures using an actuarial allocation method (paid-to-paid, Kittel, etc.). Records allocated ULAE amount, method code, allocation basis, and accounting period.

attributes.name: lae_allocation_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each LAE allocation record. Grain: one row per ULAE allocation transaction per claim exposure per accounting period.
attributes.references: NAIC Statutory Accounting Principles (SAP), SSAP No. 55

attributes.name: catastrophegeography_peril_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophegeography.peril. Business justification: LAE allocation methods vary by peril type with catastrophe losses requiring different ULAE/ALAE allocation rules than attritional losses.

attributes.name: claim_exposure_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific coverage line within a claim to which this LAE allocation is applied.

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent claim associated with this LAE allocation, enabling claim-level aggregation of allocated ULAE.

attributes.name: claimfinancials_accounting_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the accounting period in which this ULAE allocation is recorded for statutory and GAAP financial reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement, SSAP No. 55, GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: coverage_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to coverage.coverage. Business justification: ULAE and ALAE allocation to coverage is required for actuarial reserving, reinsurance settlement, and Schedule P reporting.

attributes.name: geography_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophegeography.geography. Business justification: LAE allocation is performed by state for regulatory expense reporting and state-specific expense ratio analysis.

attributes.name: original_allocation_lae_allocation_id
attributes.description: For reversal or adjustment records, references the original allocation being corrected, enabling audit trail of allocation amendments.

attributes.name: accident_year
attributes.description: The calendar year in which the loss event occurred, used for accident-year loss development triangles and IBNR actuarial analysis.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P, CAS Statement of Principles on Reserving

attributes.name: actuarial_review_flag
attributes.description: Indicates this allocation record has been flagged for actuarial review due to anomalous weight, amount, or method deviation.
attributes.references: CAS Statement of Principles on Reserving, ORSA

attributes.name: allocated_alae_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount of ALAE directly assigned to this claim exposure, distinct from ULAE which is spread via actuarial method.

attributes.name: allocated_ulae_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Allocated Unallocated Loss Adjustment Expense (ULAE) Amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount of ULAE allocated to this specific claim exposure for the accounting period using the selected actuarial method.
attributes.references: NAIC SSAP No. 55, CAS Statement of Principles on Reserving

tag_set.value: Allocated Unallocated Loss Adjustment Expense (ULAE) Amount

attributes.name: allocation_basis_amount
attributes.description: The denominator value for this claim exposure used in the allocation calculation (e.g., paid loss amount, incurred loss amount, or claim count).

attributes.name: allocation_basis_code
attributes.description: The denominator basis used to spread ULAE across claim exposures (e.g., paid losses, incurred losses, claim count, earned premium).
attributes.references: CAS Statement of Principles on Reserving, NAIC SSAP No. 55

attributes.name: allocation_method_code
attributes.description: Actuarial method used to allocate ULAE to individual claim exposures. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PAID_TO_PAID|KITTEL|BORNHUETTER_FERGUSON|DEVELOPMENT|BUDGETED|OTHER — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: allocation_method_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the actuarial allocation method applied (e.g., Paid-to-Paid, Kittel Method), for reporting and audit trail.
attributes.references: CAS Statement of Principles on Reserving

attributes.name: allocation_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for this allocation transaction, used in actuarial bordereaux and Schedule P reporting.

attributes.name: allocation_run_date
attributes.description: The date on which the actuarial allocation batch run was executed, used for version control and audit of actuarial estimates.

attributes.name: allocation_run_number
attributes.description: Identifier for the actuarial batch run that produced this allocation, enabling full traceability and re-run comparison across allocation cycles.

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the allocation record within the actuarial reserving and GL posting workflow.

attributes.name: allocation_weight
attributes.description: The proportional weight assigned to this claim exposure in the ULAE allocation calculation, expressed as a decimal fraction (0 to 1).

attributes.name: calendar_year
attributes.description: The calendar year in which this allocation transaction is recorded, supporting calendar-year statutory financial reporting.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: Legal entity or statutory company code for multi-company insurers, required for NAIC Annual Statement filing by legal entity.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Organizational cost center to which this LAE allocation is attributed for internal management reporting and expense allocation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this allocation record was first created in the system, supporting audit trail and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this allocation record (e.g., USD).

attributes.name: evaluation_date
attributes.description: The as-of date for which loss and expense data were evaluated in this allocation run, aligning with actuarial triangle evaluation dates.
attributes.references: CAS Statement of Principles on Reserving, NAIC Schedule P

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The GL account code to which this LAE allocation is posted, enabling reconciliation to the statutory balance sheet and income statement.
attributes.references: Oracle/SAP GL module, NAIC Annual Statement, SAP SSAP No. 55

attributes.name: gross_net_indicator
attributes.description: Specifies whether this allocation represents gross (before reinsurance), net (after reinsurance), or ceded LAE for statutory reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement, Schedule F, SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: lae_type_code
attributes.description: Classifies the LAE component being allocated: ULAE (Unallocated), ALAE (Allocated), DCC (Defense & Cost Containment), or AO (Adjusting & Other).
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions, SSAP No. 55, Schedule P

attributes.name: lob_code
attributes.description: NAIC line of business code identifying the insurance line (e.g., HO, PAP, CGL, CA) for Schedule P and statutory reporting segmentation.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement, Schedule P, NAIC Line of Business Codes

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for actuarial or accounting commentary on this allocation, including method overrides or period-end adjustments.

attributes.name: posted_date

attributes.name: total_pool_basis_amount

attributes.name: total_pool_ulae_amount

attributes.name: transaction_date

products.name: payee
products.description: Master record for a party designated to receive claim payments. Captures payee name, tax ID (SSN/FEIN), address, bank account for EFT, 1099 reporting flag, and payee type (claimant, attorney, vendor, lienholder).

attributes.name: payee_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the payee master record. One row per party designated to receive claim payments. MASTER_PARTY role.

attributes.name: geography_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophegeography.geography. Business justification: Payee address determines tax jurisdiction for 1099 reporting, state withholding requirements, and escheatment rules.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the enterprise Party master record for this payee, enabling linkage to the canonical party identity and deduplication via Customer/Party MDM.

attributes.name: preferred_currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: International payee management requires currency master for payment processing in payee's preferred currency, withholding tax calculation, bank account validation, and 1099/tax reporting.

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for the payee. Used for check mailing, 1099 form delivery, and OFAC/fraud screening. Required for all check-based payment methods.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1220; USPS Addressing Standards; GLBA; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line (suite, apartment, unit, floor) for the payee. Supplements address_line1 for complete mailing address on checks and 1099 forms.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1220; USPS Addressing Standards; GLBA

attributes.name: attorney_bar_number
attributes.description: State bar license number for payees classified as attorneys. Used to validate attorney payees in ClaimCenter and supports regulatory reporting of legal expense payments.
attributes.references: State Bar Association Records; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; Guidewire ClaimCenter

attributes.name: backup_withholding_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the payee is subject to IRS backup withholding (currently 24%). Set when TIN is missing, unverified, or IRS notifies the payer of withholding obligation.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1220; 26 U.S.C. § 3406; IRS CP2100 Notice

attributes.name: bank_account_number
attributes.description: Payee's bank account number for EFT/ACH disbursements. Stored in tokenized or encrypted form per PCI DSS and GLBA requirements. Required when payment_method is EFT or wire.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; PCI DSS v4.0; GLBA; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: bank_account_type
attributes.description: Type of bank account used for EFT disbursements: checking or savings. Required by NACHA for ACH transaction formatting and return code handling.

attributes.name: bank_name
attributes.description: Name of the financial institution holding the payee's account. Used for EFT remittance documentation and payment reconciliation in the General Ledger.

attributes.name: bank_routing_number
attributes.description: ABA routing transit number (9 digits) identifying the payee's financial institution for ACH/EFT transactions. Required when payment_method is EFT or wire.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; Federal Reserve Regulation J; ABA Routing Number Registry

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City of the payee's mailing address. Required for check issuance, 1099 reporting, and OFAC geographic screening.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1220; USPS Addressing Standards; GLBA

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the payee's mailing address (e.g., USA, CAN). Drives OFAC screening, foreign payment rules, and FATCA/FBAR reporting obligations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the payee record was first created in the Claims Management System. Supports audit trail, SOX compliance, and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GLBA; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; Guidewire ClaimCenter

attributes.name: do_not_pay_flag
attributes.description: Hard stop flag that prevents any payment from being issued to this payee. Set by compliance, SIU, or legal hold. Overrides all payment authorizations until manually cleared.
attributes.references: OFAC; 31 C.F.R. Parts 500-598; Guidewire ClaimCenter; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this payee record is valid and eligible to receive payments. Supports temporal validity tracking for payee lifecycle management and audit compliance.

attributes.name: email
attributes.description: Primary email address for the payee. Used for EFT remittance advice delivery, payment notifications, and electronic 1099 delivery where consent is obtained.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; IRS Publication 1220; GLBA; GDPR Article 4; CCPA

attributes.name: entity_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the payee is a natural person (individual) or a legal entity (organization). Determines which tax identification type applies and governs 1099/W-9 requirements.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date after which this payee record is no longer eligible to receive payments. Null indicates an open-ended active payee. Used for attorney retainer expiry and vendor contract end dates.

attributes.name: fraud_indicator_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Fraud Detection/SIU system has flagged this payee as a potential fraud risk based on pattern analysis, prior SIU findings, or external data sources (e.g., NICB).
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter SIU Module; NICB; NAIC Fraud Reporting; 18 U.S.C. § 1033

attributes.name: guardian_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the court-appointed guardian or conservator when the payee is a minor or legally incapacitated. Payments are issued in the guardian's name on behalf of the payee.
attributes.references: State DOI Regulations; UTMA; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; GLBA

attributes.name: is_1099_reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether payments to this payee are subject to IRS 1099 reporting. Drives year-end tax reporting workflows and AP batch processing in the General Ledger system.

attributes.name: is_minor
attributes.description: Indicates whether the payee is a minor (under 18). Triggers guardian/conservator payment controls, court approval requirements, and special handling in ClaimCenter payment workflows.
attributes.references: State DOI Regulations; Uniform Transfers to Minors Act (UTMA); NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: is_structured_settlement
attributes.description: Indicates whether payments to this payee are part of a structured settlement annuity arrangement. Triggers specialized payment scheduling, tax treatment, and regulatory disclosure requirements.
attributes.references: 26 U.S.C. § 130; Structured Settlement Protection Acts (state); NAIC Model Law

attributes.name: lien_holder_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the payee holds a lien or security interest on the insured property. When true, the payee must be co-payee on property damage payments per standard mortgage/lien clauses.
attributes.references: Standard Mortgage Clause; ISO CP 12 18; ACORD 28; UCC Article 9

attributes.name: payee_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the payee as it must appear on the payment instrument (check or EFT). For individuals this is the legal name; for entities the registered business name.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable identifier assigned to the payee by the Claims Management System (e.g., PAY-000012345). Used on checks, EFT remittances, and 1099 filings.

attributes.name: ofac_match_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) Match Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the payee returned a potential match against the OFAC SDN list during screening. A true value triggers a compliance hold and manual review before payment release.
attributes.references: OFAC SDN List; 31 C.F.R. Parts 500-598; BSA/AML

tag_set.value: Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) Match Flag

attributes.name: ofac_screen_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) Screen Date
attributes.description: Most recent date on which the payee was screened against the OFAC SDN and consolidated sanctions lists. Supports periodic re-screening compliance requirements.

tag_set.value: Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) Screen Date

attributes.name: ofac_screened
attributes.business_glossary_term: Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) Screened Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the payee has been screened against the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) list. Payments to blocked persons are prohibited under U.S. sanctions law.
attributes.references: OFAC SDN List; 31 C.F.R. Parts 500-598; BSA/AML

tag_set.value: Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) Screened Flag

attributes.name: payee_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the payee record. Blocked payees cannot receive payments until cleared by SIU or compliance review. Drives payment eligibility checks in ClaimCenter.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; OFAC SDN List

attributes.name: payee_type
attributes.description: Classifies the payee's role in the payment transaction. Drives 1099 reporting rules, authority limits, and payment workflow routing within ClaimCenter.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; IRS Publication 1220; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Preferred or designated payment instrument for disbursements to this payee: check, EFT (ACH), wire transfer, Zelle, or other. Drives payment routing in BillingCenter and ClaimCenter.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; Guidewire BillingCenter; NACHA Operating Rules

attributes.name: phone
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the payee. Used for payment confirmation, returned check follow-up, and EFT pre-notification as required by NACHA rules.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; GLBA; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP or ZIP+4 postal code for the payee's mailing address. Required for check delivery, 1099 filing, and USPS address validation.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1220; USPS Addressing Standards; GLBA

attributes.name: siu_referral_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payee has been referred to the Special Investigations Unit (SIU) for fraud screening. A true value places a payment hold pending SIU clearance.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter SIU Module; NAIC Fraud Reporting Requirements; 18 U.S.C. § 1033

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record that originated this payee record (e.g., CLAIMCENTER, BILLINGCENTER, MDM). Supports data lineage and master data reconciliation.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; Customer/Party MDM; NAIC Annual Statement

attributes.name: tax_id_type
attributes.description: Classifies the tax_id field: SSN (Social Security Number), FEIN (Federal Employer Identification Number), ITIN (Individual Taxpayer Identification Number), or EIN (Employer Identification Number).

attributes.name: tax_id_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the payee's TIN has been validated against IRS TIN Matching or equivalent verification service. Required before issuing 1099 forms.
attributes.references: IRS TIN Matching Program; IRS Publication 1220; 26 U.S.C. § 3406

attributes.name: tax_number
attributes.description: Federal tax identifier for the payee: Social Security Number (SSN) for individuals or Federal Employer Identification Number (FEIN) for organizations. Required for IRS 1099 reporting.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1220; IRS W-9; 26 U.S.C. § 6041; GLBA

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the payee record. Used for change data capture (CDC), audit trail, and downstream Silver layer incremental processing.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GLBA; Guidewire ClaimCenter; Databricks Lakehouse CDC

attributes.name: vendor_code
attributes.description: Internal vendor identifier assigned by the Accounts Payable system (Oracle/SAP) for payees classified as vendors (e.g., repair shops, medical providers, appraisers). Enables AP reconciliation.
attributes.references: Oracle/SAP AP Module; Guidewire ClaimCenter; NAIC Schedule P

attributes.name: w9_received
attributes.description: Indicates whether a completed IRS Form W-9 (Request for Taxpayer Identification Number and Certification) has been received from the payee. Required before releasing payments subject to backup withholding.

attributes.name: w9_received_date
attributes.description: Date on which the IRS Form W-9 was received from the payee. Used to establish the effective date of TIN certification and backup withholding exemption.

products.name: statutory_reserve_filing

attributes.name: geography_id

attributes.name: original_filing_statutory_reserve_filing_id

attributes.name: company_name

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: earned_premium_amount

attributes.name: evaluation_date

attributes.name: filing_date

attributes.name: filing_type

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current processing status of this bordereaux line in the reinsurer settlement workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: DRAFT|SUBMITTED|ACKNOWLEDGED|DISPUTED|SETTLED|VOIDED|AMENDED — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: lob_code
attributes.description: NAIC line of business code classifying the underlying policy (e.g., HO, PAP, CGL, CA) for reinsurer reporting and treaty allocation.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement; ISO LOB Classification

attributes.name: loss_date
attributes.description: Date of the underlying loss event (accident year anchor), used to determine which reinsurance treaty year applies to this cession.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: loss_development_amount
attributes.description: Change in ceded incurred loss between the current and prior bordereaux period for this claim line, representing adverse or favorable development.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule P

attributes.name: policy_number
attributes.description: Policy number of the underlying insured policy to which the claim and cession relate, as reported on the bordereaux.

attributes.name: policy_year
attributes.description: Year in which the underlying policy was incepted, used for policy-year loss development and reinsurance treaty year determination.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: prior_period_ceded_loss_amount
attributes.description: Ceded loss amount reported on the immediately preceding bordereaux period for this claim line, enabling period-over-period development tracking.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule P

attributes.name: recovery_status
attributes.description: Status of the reinsurance recovery for this ceded claim line, indicating whether amounts have been collected, are outstanding, or are in dispute.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: report_date
attributes.description: Date the claim was first reported (FNOL date), used for claims-made policy triggers and reinsurance reporting lag analysis.

attributes.name: ri_agreement_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reinsurance arrangement is a treaty (automatic) or facultative (individually negotiated) agreement.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: ri_collected_amount
attributes.description: Amount actually received from the reinsurer against this bordereaux line to date, used to compute the outstanding reinsurance receivable.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: ri_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum reinsurance recovery available under the applicable treaty layer or facultative certificate for this claim exposure.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: ri_recoverable_amount
attributes.description: Total amount recoverable from the reinsurer on this line (ceded loss plus ceded LAE), representing the gross reinsurance asset on the balance sheet.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F; IFRS 17

attributes.name: ri_retention_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of the loss retained by the cedant (self-insured retention or treaty retention layer) before reinsurance recovery applies.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record (e.g., GUIDEWIRE_CC, SAPIENS_RI) from which this bordereaux line was extracted.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Date this bordereaux line was transmitted to the reinsurer as part of the settlement batch.

attributes.name: treaty_type
attributes.description: Classification of the treaty structure: Quota Share (QS), Excess of Loss (XOL), Stop Loss (SL), Catastrophe XL (CAT XL), or Aggregate. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: QS|XOL|SL|CAT_XL|AGGREGATE|RETRO — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this bordereaux line record, supporting audit trail and change detection in the Silver layer.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_pc_insurance_blog_v499`.`_metrics`.`billing_account`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Billing account lifecycle and balance metrics. Grain: one row per billing account."
  source: "`vibe_pc_insurance_blog_v499`.`billing`.`account`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "account_status"
      expr: account_status
      comment: "Current status of the billing account (Active, Suspended, Closed, etc.)"
    - name: "account_type"
      expr: account_type
      comment: "Type of billing account (Individual, Commercial, Agency, etc.)"
    - name: "billing_frequency"
      expr: billing_frequency
      comment: "Billing frequency (Monthly, Quarterly, Annual, etc.)"
    - name: "billing_method"
      expr: billing_method
      comment: "Method of billing (Direct Bill, Agency Bill, List Bill, etc.)"
    - name: "payment_plan_type"
      expr: payment_plan_type
      comment: "Type of payment plan (Full Pay, Installment, etc.)"
    - name: "delinquency_status"
      expr: delinquency_status
      comment: "Delinquency status of the account (Current, Past Due, Collections, etc.)"
    - name: "auto_pay_enabled"
      expr: auto_pay_enabled
      comment: "Whether automatic payment is enabled for this account"
    - name: "paperless_billing_flag"
      expr: paperless_billing_flag
      comment: "Whether the account is enrolled in paperless billing"
    - name: "effective_year"
      expr: YEAR(effective_date)
      comment: "Year the account became effective"
    - name: "effective_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', effective_date)
      comment: "Month the account became effective"
  measures:
    - name: "total_accounts"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of billing accounts"
    - name: "total_current_balance"
      expr: SUM(CAST(current_balance AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of current outstanding balances across all accounts"
    - name: "total_outstanding_premium"
      expr: SUM(CAST(outstanding_premium AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of outstanding premium amounts across all accounts"
    - name: "total_outstanding_fees"
      expr: SUM(CAST(outstanding_fees AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of outstanding fee amounts across all accounts"
    - name: "total_outstanding_taxes"
      expr: SUM(CAST(outstanding_taxes AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of outstanding tax amounts across all accounts"
    - name: "total_credit_balance"
      expr: SUM(CAST(credit_balance AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of credit balances (overpayments) across all accounts"
    - name: "total_unapplied_cash"
      expr: SUM(CAST(unapplied_cash AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of unapplied cash (payments not yet allocated) across all accounts"
    - name: "total_write_off_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(write_off_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of amounts written off across all accounts"
    - name: "avg_days_past_due"
      expr: AVG(CAST(days_past_due AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average number of days past due across all accounts"
    - name: "avg_current_balance"
      expr: AVG(CAST(current_balance AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average current balance per account"
    - name: "accounts_with_autopay"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN auto_pay_enabled = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of accounts with automatic payment enabled"
    - name: "accounts_delinquent"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN days_past_due > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of accounts with any past due balance"
$$
metric_views.description: Billing account lifecycle and balance metrics. Grain: one row per billing account.
